"""The nutrients FoodVerse reports. All source values are normalised to these keys and units,
always on a per-100 g basis. A nutrient a source does not supply is simply absent: it is never
defaulted to zero or estimated."""

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class NutrientDef:
    key: str
    label: str
    unit: str
    core: bool  # core nutrients are always shown (as "not available" when missing)
    max_per_100g: float  # sanity bound; larger values are treated as malformed source data


NUTRIENTS: tuple[NutrientDef, ...] = (
    NutrientDef("energy_kcal", "Calories", "kcal", True, 1000.0),
    NutrientDef("protein_g", "Protein", "g", True, 100.5),
    NutrientDef("carbs_g", "Carbohydrates", "g", True, 100.5),
    NutrientDef("fat_g", "Fat", "g", True, 100.5),
    NutrientDef("fiber_g", "Fibre", "g", False, 100.5),
    NutrientDef("sugars_g", "Sugars", "g", False, 100.5),
    NutrientDef("saturated_fat_g", "Saturated fat", "g", False, 100.5),
    NutrientDef("sodium_mg", "Sodium", "mg", False, 40_000.0),
)
NUTRIENT_BY_KEY: dict[str, NutrientDef] = {n.key: n for n in NUTRIENTS}

FILE: backend/app/nutrition/service.py

"""Looks foods up in the configured trusted sources. This is the only place nutrient values
enter the system: they come straight from a source record, never from a model."""

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Literal

import httpx
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import Settings
from app.nutrition.nutrients import NUTRIENTS
from app.nutrition.sources.base import NutritionSource
from app.nutrition.sources.local import LocalReferenceSource
from app.nutrition.sources.off import OpenFoodFactsSource
from app.nutrition.sources.usda import UsdaFdcSource
from app.nutrition.types import FoodCandidate, NutritionSourceError
from app.schemas.food import NutrientDefinition, NutritionStatus, SourceStatus

SourceState = Literal["ok", "not_configured", "unavailable", "rate_limited", "timeout"]
_NON_WORD = re.compile(r"[^\w\s'&-]", re.UNICODE)


def clean_query(query: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(_NON_WORD.sub(" ", query).split())[:80]


@dataclass
class SearchOutcome:
    results: list[FoodCandidate]
    sources: list[SourceStatus]


class NutritionService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        local: LocalReferenceSource,
        usda: NutritionSource | None,
        off: OpenFoodFactsSource | None,
    ) -> None:
        self._local = local
        self._usda = usda
        self._off = off

    def _not_configured(self, name: str, label: str, how: str) -> SourceStatus:
        return SourceStatus(source=name, label=label, status="not_configured", message=how)

    def status(self) -> NutritionStatus:
        records = self._local.record_count()
        sources = [
            SourceStatus(
                source="local_reference",
                label=self._local.label,
                status="ok" if records else "not_configured",
                message=None
                if records
                else "No reference table has been imported (see README: import_reference).",
            ),
            SourceStatus(source="usda_fdc", label="USDA FoodData Central", status="ok")
            if self._usda
            else self._not_configured(
                "usda_fdc", "USDA FoodData Central", "Set USDA_FDC_API_KEY to enable."
            ),
            SourceStatus(source="open_food_facts", label="Open Food Facts", status="ok")
            if self._off
            else self._not_configured(
                "open_food_facts", "Open Food Facts", "Set OPEN_FOOD_FACTS_ENABLED=true to enable."
            ),
        ]
        return NutritionStatus(
            sources=sources,
            nutrients=[
                NutrientDefinition(key=n.key, label=n.label, unit=n.unit, core=n.core)
                for n in NUTRIENTS
            ],
            any_configured=records > 0 or self._usda is not None or self._off is not None,
            local_reference_records=records,
        )

    def search(self, query: str, limit: int = 8) -> SearchOutcome:
        query = clean_query(query)
        results: list[FoodCandidate] = []
        statuses: list[SourceStatus] = []

        records = self._local.record_count()
        if records:
            results.extend(self._local.search(query, limit))
            statuses.append(
                SourceStatus(source="local_reference", label=self._local.label, status="ok")
            )
        else:
            statuses.append(
                self._not_configured(
                    "local_reference", self._local.label, "No reference table imported."
                )
            )

        for name, label, source, how in (
            ("usda_fdc", "USDA FoodData Central", self._usda, "Set USDA_FDC_API_KEY to enable."),
            ("open_food_facts", "Open Food Facts", self._off, "Set OPEN_FOOD_FACTS_ENABLED=true."),
        ):
            if source is None:
                statuses.append(self._not_configured(name, label, how))
                continue
            try:
                results.extend(source.search(query, limit))
                statuses.append(SourceStatus(source=name, label=label, status="ok"))
            except NutritionSourceError as exc:
                state: SourceState = exc.status  # type: ignore[assignment]
                statuses.append(
                    SourceStatus(source=name, label=label, status=state, message=exc.message)
                )
        return SearchOutcome(results=results, sources=statuses)

    def barcode(self, barcode: str) -> tuple[FoodCandidate | None, list[SourceStatus]]:
        if self._off is None:
            return None, [
                self._not_configured(
                    "open_food_facts", "Open Food Facts", "Set OPEN_FOOD_FACTS_ENABLED=true."
                )
            ]
        try:
            found = self._off.lookup_barcode(barcode)
        except NutritionSourceError as exc:
            state: SourceState = exc.status  # type: ignore[assignment]
            return None, [
                SourceStatus(
                    source="open_food_facts",
                    label="Open Food Facts",
                    status=state,
                    message=exc.message,
                )
            ]
        return found, [SourceStatus(source="open_food_facts", label="Open Food Facts", status="ok")]


def build_nutrition_service(
    settings: Settings, db: Session, transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None
) -> NutritionService:
    usda = None
    if settings.usda_fdc_api_key is not None:
        usda = UsdaFdcSource(
            settings.usda_fdc_api_key.get_secret_value(),
            settings.usda_fdc_base_url,
            settings.nutrition_timeout_seconds,
            transport,
        )
    off = None
    if settings.open_food_facts_enabled:
        off = OpenFoodFactsSource(
            settings.open_food_facts_base_url,
            settings.open_food_facts_user_agent,
            settings.nutrition_timeout_seconds,
            transport,
        )
    return NutritionService(LocalReferenceSource(db), usda, off)

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class FoodCandidate(BaseModel):
    """One matching food from a trusted source, with values per 100 g exactly as reported."""

    source: str  # usda_fdc | open_food_facts | local_reference
    source_label: str
    source_id: str
    name: str
    brand: str | None = None
    data_type: str | None = None
    per_100g: dict[str, float]  # only nutrients the source actually supplied
    serving_grams: float | None = None  # only when the source states a serving in grams
    serving_label: str | None = None
    attribution: str
    url: str | None = None
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)  # e.g. "Calories converted from kJ"


class NutritionSourceError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status: str, message: str, retry_after: int | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status  # unavailable | rate_limited | timeout
        self.message = message
        self.retry_after = retry_after

"""Offline reference tables imported by the operator (e.g. IFCT).

See app/nutrition/import_reference.py for how a table is imported.
"""

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models.reference import ReferenceFood
from app.nutrition.nutrients import NUTRIENT_BY_KEY
from app.nutrition.types import FoodCandidate


def normalise(text: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(text.casefold().split())


def _escape_like(token: str) -> str:
    return token.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


class LocalReferenceSource:
    name = "local_reference"
    label = "Local reference table"

    def __init__(self, db: Session) -> None:
        self._db = db

    def record_count(self) -> int:
        return self._db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(ReferenceFood)) or 0

    def search(self, query: str, limit: int) -> list[FoodCandidate]:
        tokens = normalise(query).split()
        if not tokens:
            return []
        stmt = select(ReferenceFood)
        for token in tokens:
            stmt = stmt.where(
                ReferenceFood.name_normalized.like(f"%{_escape_like(token)}%", escape="\\")
            )
        rows = self._db.scalars(
            stmt.order_by(func.length(ReferenceFood.name_normalized), ReferenceFood.name).limit(
                limit
            )
        ).all()
        results: list[FoodCandidate] = []
        for row in rows:
            per_100g = {
                k: float(v)
                for k, v in row.nutrients.items()
                if k in NUTRIENT_BY_KEY and isinstance(v, int | float)
            }
            if not per_100g:
                continue
            results.append(
                FoodCandidate(
                    source="local_reference",
                    source_label=f"{row.dataset} ({row.dataset_version})",
                    source_id=f"{row.dataset}:{row.source_id}",
                    name=row.name,
                    data_type="Reference table (offline)",
                    per_100g=per_100g,
                    attribution=f"{row.citation} {row.license_note}".strip(),
                )
            )
        return results

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/nutrition/sources/off.py

"""Open Food Facts (packaged foods; community-contributed, ODbL licensed).

Values are per 100 g as printed on packages. The data is crowd-sourced, so candidates carry a
caution. No API key is needed, but OFF asks every client to identify itself with a User-Agent,
and rate-limits searches (about 10 per minute per IP), so failures here are expected and surfaced.
Energy is taken from energy-kcal_100g; if only kJ is supplied it is converted (1 kcal = 4.184 kJ)
and the candidate says so. Sodium is reported in grams by OFF and converted to mg.
"""

import math
import re
from typing import Any

import httpx

from app.nutrition.nutrients import NUTRIENT_BY_KEY
from app.nutrition.sources.base import NutritionSource
from app.nutrition.types import FoodCandidate, NutritionSourceError

ATTRIBUTION = (
    "Open Food Facts (ODbL), community-contributed data. Check the product label if it matters."
)
_FIELDS = "code,product_name,brands,nutriments,serving_size"
_GRAMS_PER_100G_KEYS: dict[str, str] = {
    "protein_g": "proteins_100g",
    "carbs_g": "carbohydrates_100g",
    "fat_g": "fat_100g",
    "fiber_g": "fiber_100g",
    "sugars_g": "sugars_100g",
    "saturated_fat_g": "saturated-fat_100g",
}
_SERVING_GRAMS = re.compile(r"(?<![\w.])(\d{1,4}(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*g\b", re.IGNORECASE)
_BARCODE = re.compile(r"^\d{8,14}$")


def _number(value: Any) -> float | None:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int | float | str):
        return None
    try:
        number = float(str(value).replace(",", "."))
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return number if math.isfinite(number) and number >= 0 else None


def parse_product(product: dict[str, Any]) -> FoodCandidate | None:
    name = str(product.get("product_name") or "").strip()
    code = str(product.get("code") or "").strip()
    nutriments = product.get("nutriments")
    if not name or not code or not isinstance(nutriments, dict):
        return None

    values: dict[str, float] = {}
    notes: list[str] = []

    kcal = _number(nutriments.get("energy-kcal_100g"))
    if kcal is None:
        kj = _number(nutriments.get("energy-kj_100g"))
        if kj is None:
            kj = _number(nutriments.get("energy_100g"))  # OFF's generic energy key is kJ
        if kj is not None:
            kcal = round(kj / 4.184, 1)
            notes.append("Calories converted from kJ (1 kcal = 4.184 kJ).")
    if kcal is not None and kcal <= NUTRIENT_BY_KEY["energy_kcal"].max_per_100g:
        values["energy_kcal"] = kcal
    elif kcal is not None:
        notes = [n for n in notes if "converted" not in n]

    for key, off_key in _GRAMS_PER_100G_KEYS.items():
        number = _number(nutriments.get(off_key))
        if number is not None and number <= NUTRIENT_BY_KEY[key].max_per_100g:
            values[key] = number
    sodium_g = _number(nutriments.get("sodium_100g"))
    if sodium_g is not None and sodium_g * 1000 <= NUTRIENT_BY_KEY["sodium_mg"].max_per_100g:
        values["sodium_mg"] = round(sodium_g * 1000, 1)
    if not values:
        return None

    serving_label = str(product.get("serving_size") or "").strip() or None
    serving_grams: float | None = None
    if serving_label:
        match = _SERVING_GRAMS.search(serving_label)
        if match:
            grams = _number(match.group(1))
            if grams is not None and 0 < grams <= 2000:
                serving_grams = grams

    brand = str(product.get("brands") or "").split(",")[0].strip() or None
    return FoodCandidate(
        source="open_food_facts",
        source_label="Open Food Facts",
        source_id=code,
        name=name,
        brand=brand,
        data_type="Packaged product (community data)",
        per_100g=values,
        serving_grams=serving_grams,
        serving_label=serving_label,
        attribution=ATTRIBUTION,
        url=f"https://world.openfoodfacts.org/product/{code}",
        notes=notes,
    )


class OpenFoodFactsSource:
    name = "open_food_facts"
    label = "Open Food Facts"

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        user_agent: str,
        timeout_seconds: float,
        transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self._headers = {"User-Agent": user_agent}
        self._timeout = timeout_seconds
        self._transport = transport

    def _get(self, path: str, params: dict[str, str]) -> Any:
        try:
            with httpx.Client(
                timeout=self._timeout, transport=self._transport, headers=self._headers
            ) as client:
                response = client.get(f"{self._base_url}{path}", params=params)
        except httpx.TimeoutException:
            raise NutritionSourceError("timeout", "Open Food Facts timed out.") from None
        except httpx.HTTPError:
            raise NutritionSourceError("unavailable", "Open Food Facts is unreachable.") from None
        if response.status_code in (429, 503):
            raise NutritionSourceError(
                "rate_limited", "Open Food Facts is rate limiting requests. Try again shortly."
            )
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise NutritionSourceError(
                "unavailable", f"Open Food Facts returned an error (HTTP {response.status_code})."
            )
        try:
            return response.json()
        except ValueError:
            raise NutritionSourceError(
                "unavailable", "Open Food Facts returned an unexpected response."
            ) from None

    def search(self, query: str, limit: int) -> list[FoodCandidate]:
        data = self._get(
            "/cgi/search.pl",
            {
                "search_terms": query,
                "search_simple": "1",
                "action": "process",
                "json": "1",
                "page_size": str(limit),
                "fields": _FIELDS,
            },
        )
        products = data.get("products") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(products, list):
            raise NutritionSourceError(
                "unavailable", "Open Food Facts returned an unexpected response."
            )
        results = [c for p in products if isinstance(p, dict) and (c := parse_product(p))]
        return results[:limit]

    def lookup_barcode(self, barcode: str) -> FoodCandidate | None:
        if not _BARCODE.fullmatch(barcode):
            raise ValueError("A barcode is 8 to 14 digits.")
        data = self._get(f"/api/v2/product/{barcode}.json", {"fields": _FIELDS})
        product = data.get("product") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
        return parse_product(product) if isinstance(product, dict) else None


_check: type[NutritionSource] = OpenFoodFactsSource  # structural check against the Protocol

FILE: backend/app/nutrition/sources/usda.py

"""USDA FoodData Central (generic composition data).

Only the Foundation and SR Legacy data types are requested: their nutrient values are published
per 100 g of the food, which is the basis the calculator relies on. Branded foods are left to
Open Food Facts. The API key stays on the server and is sent only to the configured base URL.

The parser accepts both nutrient shapes FDC uses (search results: nutrientNumber/unitName/value;
food details: nutrient{number,unitName}/amount) and rejects anything out of range.
"""

import math
from typing import Any

import httpx

from app.nutrition.nutrients import NUTRIENT_BY_KEY
from app.nutrition.sources.base import NutritionSource
from app.nutrition.types import FoodCandidate, NutritionSourceError

# nutrient number -> (our key, expected unit)
_NUMBER_MAP: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {
    "208": ("energy_kcal", "kcal"),
    "203": ("protein_g", "g"),
    "205": ("carbs_g", "g"),
    "204": ("fat_g", "g"),
    "291": ("fiber_g", "g"),
    "269": ("sugars_g", "g"),
    "269.3": ("sugars_g", "g"),
    "606": ("saturated_fat_g", "g"),
    "307": ("sodium_mg", "mg"),
}
# Energy fallbacks (Atwater factors, kcal) used by many Foundation foods that lack nutrient 208.
_ENERGY_FALLBACK = ("958", "957")
_DATA_TYPES = "Foundation,SR Legacy"
ATTRIBUTION = "USDA FoodData Central (U.S. Department of Agriculture), https://fdc.nal.usda.gov"


def _number(value: Any) -> float | None:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int | float | str):
        return None
    try:
        number = float(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return number if math.isfinite(number) and number >= 0 else None


def _nutrient_fields(entry: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, float | None]:
    raw_nested = entry.get("nutrient")
    nested: dict[str, Any] = raw_nested if isinstance(raw_nested, dict) else {}
    number = entry.get("nutrientNumber") or nested.get("number")
    unit = entry.get("unitName") or nested.get("unitName")
    value = entry.get("value") if entry.get("value") is not None else entry.get("amount")
    return (
        str(number).strip() if number is not None else None,
        str(unit).strip().lower() if unit is not None else None,
        _number(value),
    )


def parse_food(food: dict[str, Any]) -> FoodCandidate | None:
    name = str(food.get("description") or "").strip()
    fdc_id = food.get("fdcId")
    entries = food.get("foodNutrients")
    if not name or fdc_id is None or not isinstance(entries, list):
        return None

    values: dict[str, float] = {}
    energy_fallback: dict[str, float] = {}
    for entry in entries:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        number, unit, value = _nutrient_fields(entry)
        if number is None or value is None:
            continue
        if number in _ENERGY_FALLBACK and unit == "kcal":
            energy_fallback[number] = value
            continue
        mapped = _NUMBER_MAP.get(number)
        if mapped is None or unit != mapped[1]:
            continue  # unknown nutrient, or an unexpected unit: treat as not reported
        key = mapped[0]
        if value > NUTRIENT_BY_KEY[key].max_per_100g:
            continue  # implausible per-100 g value: malformed, not reported
        values.setdefault(key, value)
    notes: list[str] = []
    if "energy_kcal" not in values:
        for number in _ENERGY_FALLBACK:
            if number in energy_fallback and energy_fallback[number] <= 1000.0:
                values["energy_kcal"] = energy_fallback[number]
                notes.append("Calories from the source's Atwater energy value.")
                break
    if not values:
        return None
    data_type = str(food.get("dataType") or "").strip() or None
    return FoodCandidate(
        source="usda_fdc",
        source_label="USDA FoodData Central",
        source_id=str(fdc_id),
        name=name,
        brand=None,
        data_type=data_type,
        per_100g=values,
        attribution=ATTRIBUTION,
        url=f"https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/fdc-app.html#/food-details/{fdc_id}/nutrients",
        notes=notes,
    )


class UsdaFdcSource:
    name = "usda_fdc"
    label = "USDA FoodData Central"

    def __init__(
        self,
        api_key: str,
        base_url: str,
        timeout_seconds: float,
        transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._api_key = api_key
        self._base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self._timeout = timeout_seconds
        self._transport = transport

    def search(self, query: str, limit: int) -> list[FoodCandidate]:
        params = {
            "api_key": self._api_key,
            "query": query,
            "pageSize": str(limit),
            "dataType": _DATA_TYPES,
        }
        try:
            with httpx.Client(timeout=self._timeout, transport=self._transport) as client:
                response = client.get(f"{self._base_url}/foods/search", params=params)
        except httpx.TimeoutException:
            raise NutritionSourceError("timeout", "USDA FoodData Central timed out.") from None
        except httpx.HTTPError:
            raise NutritionSourceError(
                "unavailable", "USDA FoodData Central is unreachable."
            ) from None

        if response.status_code == 429:
            raise NutritionSourceError(
                "rate_limited", "USDA FoodData Central is rate limiting this server's key."
            )
        if response.status_code in (400, 401, 403):
            raise NutritionSourceError(
                "unavailable", "USDA FoodData Central rejected the request or the configured key."
            )
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise NutritionSourceError(
                "unavailable",
                f"USDA FoodData Central returned an error (HTTP {response.status_code}).",
            )
        try:
            foods = response.json()["foods"]
            if not isinstance(foods, list):
                raise TypeError
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
            raise NutritionSourceError(
                "unavailable", "USDA FoodData Central returned an unexpected response."
            ) from None
        results = [c for f in foods if isinstance(f, dict) and (c := parse_food(f)) is not None]
        return results[:limit]


_check: type[NutritionSource] = UsdaFdcSource  # structural check against the Protocol

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models.cooking import CookingConversation, CookingMessage


def add(db: Session, conversation: CookingConversation) -> CookingConversation:
    db.add(conversation)
    db.flush()
    return conversation


def get_owned(
    db: Session, conversation_id: uuid.UUID, owner_id: uuid.UUID
) -> CookingConversation | None:
    return db.scalar(
        select(CookingConversation).where(
            CookingConversation.id == conversation_id,
            CookingConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
        )
    )


def list_page(db: Session, owner_id: uuid.UUID, *, limit: int, offset: int):
    base = select(CookingConversation).where(CookingConversation.owner_id == owner_id)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(base.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        base.order_by(CookingConversation.updated_at.desc(), CookingConversation.id)
        .limit(limit)
        .offset(offset)
    ).all()
    return list(rows), total


def message_count(db: Session, conversation_id: uuid.UUID) -> int:
    return (
        db.scalar(
            select(func.count())
            .select_from(CookingMessage)
            .where(CookingMessage.conversation_id == conversation_id)
        )
        or 0
    )


def recent_messages(
    db: Session, conversation_id: uuid.UUID, limit: int
) -> list[CookingMessage]:
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(CookingMessage)
        .where(CookingMessage.conversation_id == conversation_id)
        .order_by(CookingMessage.position.desc())
        .limit(limit)
    ).all()
    return list(reversed(rows))


def all_messages(db: Session, conversation_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[CookingMessage]:
    return list(
        db.scalars(
            select(CookingMessage)
            .where(CookingMessage.conversation_id == conversation_id)
            .order_by(CookingMessage.position)
        ).all()
    )


def next_position(db: Session, conversation_id: uuid.UUID) -> int:
    current = db.scalar(
        select(func.max(CookingMessage.position)).where(
            CookingMessage.conversation_id == conversation_id
        )
    )
    return int(current or 0) + 1


def add_message(db: Session, message: CookingMessage) -> CookingMessage:
    db.add(message)
    db.flush()
    return message

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import AnalysisRecord, FreshnessAssessment


def list_page(
    db: Session,
    owner_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    limit: int,
    offset: int,
    label: str | None = None,
    category: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[tuple[FreshnessAssessment, AnalysisRecord]], int]:
    where = [FreshnessAssessment.owner_id == owner_id]
    if label is not None:
        where.append(FreshnessAssessment.label == label)
    if category is not None:
        where.append(FreshnessAssessment.food_category == category)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(FreshnessAssessment).where(*where)) or 0
    rows = db.execute(
        select(FreshnessAssessment, AnalysisRecord)
        .join(AnalysisRecord, AnalysisRecord.id == FreshnessAssessment.analysis_id)
        .where(*where)
        .order_by(FreshnessAssessment.created_at.desc(), FreshnessAssessment.analysis_id)
        .limit(limit)
        .offset(offset)
    ).all()
    return [(a, r) for a, r in rows], total


def get_owned(
    db: Session, assessment_id: uuid.UUID, owner_id: uuid.UUID
) -> tuple[FreshnessAssessment, AnalysisRecord] | None:
    row = db.execute(
        select(FreshnessAssessment, AnalysisRecord)
        .join(AnalysisRecord, AnalysisRecord.id == FreshnessAssessment.analysis_id)
        .where(
            FreshnessAssessment.analysis_id == assessment_id,
            FreshnessAssessment.owner_id == owner_id,
        )
    ).first()
    return (row[0], row[1]) if row else None

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import AnalysisRecord, ModuleKey


def list_page(
    db: Session,
    owner_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    module: ModuleKey | None,
    limit: int,
    offset: int,
) -> tuple[list[AnalysisRecord], int]:
    base = select(AnalysisRecord).where(AnalysisRecord.owner_id == owner_id)
    if module is not None:
        base = base.where(AnalysisRecord.module == module)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(base.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        base.order_by(AnalysisRecord.created_at.desc(), AnalysisRecord.id)
        .limit(limit)
        .offset(offset)
    ).all()
    return list(rows), total


def get_owned(db: Session, record_id: uuid.UUID, owner_id: uuid.UUID) -> AnalysisRecord | None:
    return db.scalar(
        select(AnalysisRecord).where(
            AnalysisRecord.id == record_id, AnalysisRecord.owner_id == owner_id
        )
    )


def counts_by_module(db: Session, owner_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, int]:
    rows = db.execute(
        select(AnalysisRecord.module, func.count())
        .where(AnalysisRecord.owner_id == owner_id)
        .group_by(AnalysisRecord.module)
    ).all()
    return {str(module.value): int(n) for module, n in rows}

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import AnalysisRecord, HygieneInspection


def list_page(
    db: Session,
    owner_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    limit: int,
    offset: int,
    status: str | None = None,
    location_type: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[tuple[HygieneInspection, AnalysisRecord]], int]:
    where = [HygieneInspection.owner_id == owner_id]
    if status is not None:
        where.append(HygieneInspection.status == status)
    if location_type is not None:
        where.append(HygieneInspection.location_type == location_type)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(HygieneInspection).where(*where)) or 0
    rows = db.execute(
        select(HygieneInspection, AnalysisRecord)
        .join(AnalysisRecord, AnalysisRecord.id == HygieneInspection.analysis_id)
        .where(*where)
        .order_by(HygieneInspection.created_at.desc(), HygieneInspection.analysis_id)
        .limit(limit)
        .offset(offset)
    ).all()
    return [(h, r) for h, r in rows], total


def get_owned(
    db: Session, inspection_id: uuid.UUID, owner_id: uuid.UUID
) -> tuple[HygieneInspection, AnalysisRecord] | None:
    row = db.execute(
        select(HygieneInspection, AnalysisRecord)
        .join(AnalysisRecord, AnalysisRecord.id == HygieneInspection.analysis_id)
        .where(
            HygieneInspection.analysis_id == inspection_id,
            HygieneInspection.owner_id == owner_id,
        )
    ).first()
    return (row[0], row[1]) if row else None

import uuid
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import AnalysisRecord, MealCategory, MealLog


def list_page(
    db: Session,
    owner_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    limit: int,
    offset: int,
    category: MealCategory | None = None,
    date_from: datetime | None = None,
    date_to: datetime | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[tuple[MealLog, AnalysisRecord]], int]:
    where = [MealLog.owner_id == owner_id]
    if category is not None:
        where.append(MealLog.category == category)
    if date_from is not None:
        where.append(MealLog.eaten_at >= date_from)
    if date_to is not None:
        where.append(MealLog.eaten_at < date_to)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(MealLog).where(*where)) or 0
    rows = db.execute(
        select(MealLog, AnalysisRecord)
        .join(AnalysisRecord, AnalysisRecord.id == MealLog.analysis_id)
        .where(*where)
        .order_by(MealLog.eaten_at.desc(), MealLog.analysis_id)
        .limit(limit)
        .offset(offset)
    ).all()
    return [(m, r) for m, r in rows], total


def get_owned(
    db: Session, meal_id: uuid.UUID, owner_id: uuid.UUID
) -> tuple[MealLog, AnalysisRecord] | None:
    row = db.execute(
        select(MealLog, AnalysisRecord)
        .join(AnalysisRecord, AnalysisRecord.id == MealLog.analysis_id)
        .where(MealLog.analysis_id == meal_id, MealLog.owner_id == owner_id)
    ).first()
    return (row[0], row[1]) if row else None

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import MediaAsset


def add(db: Session, asset: MediaAsset) -> MediaAsset:
    db.add(asset)
    db.flush()
    return asset


def get_owned(db: Session, asset_id: uuid.UUID, owner_id: uuid.UUID) -> MediaAsset | None:
    """The owner filter is part of the query: another user's id simply does not exist here."""
    return db.scalar(
        select(MediaAsset).where(MediaAsset.id == asset_id, MediaAsset.owner_id == owner_id)
    )


def list_page(
    db: Session, owner_id: uuid.UUID, *, limit: int, offset: int
) -> tuple[list[MediaAsset], int]:
    base = select(MediaAsset).where(MediaAsset.owner_id == owner_id)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(base.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        base.order_by(MediaAsset.created_at.desc(), MediaAsset.id).limit(limit).offset(offset)
    ).all()
    return list(rows), total


def usage(db: Session, owner_id: uuid.UUID) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """(count, total_bytes) for one owner."""
    row = db.execute(
        select(func.count(MediaAsset.id), func.coalesce(func.sum(MediaAsset.size_bytes), 0)).where(
            MediaAsset.owner_id == owner_id
        )
    ).one()
    return int(row[0]), int(row[1])

FILE: backend/app/repositories/recipes.py

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models.cooking import Recipe, RecipeStatus


def add(db: Session, recipe: Recipe) -> Recipe:
    db.add(recipe)
    db.flush()
    return recipe


def get_owned(db: Session, recipe_id: uuid.UUID, owner_id: uuid.UUID) -> Recipe | None:
    """The owner filter is part of the query: another user's id simply does not exist here."""
    return db.scalar(
        select(Recipe).where(Recipe.id == recipe_id, Recipe.owner_id == owner_id)
    )


def _escape_like(term: str) -> str:
    return term.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


def list_page(
    db: Session,
    owner_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    limit: int,
    offset: int,
    query: str | None = None,
    favorite: bool | None = None,
    saved_only: bool = True,
):
    where = [Recipe.owner_id == owner_id]
    if saved_only:
        where.append(Recipe.status == RecipeStatus.SAVED)
    if favorite is not None:
        where.append(Recipe.favorite.is_(favorite))
    if query:
        pattern = f"%{_escape_like(query)}%"
        where.append(
            or_(
                Recipe.title.ilike(pattern, escape="\\"),
                Recipe.description.ilike(pattern, escape="\\"),
            )
        )
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Recipe).where(*where)) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(Recipe)
        .where(*where)
        .order_by(Recipe.favorite.desc(), Recipe.updated_at.desc(), Recipe.id)
        .limit(limit)
        .offset(offset)
    ).all()
    return list(rows), total


def for_conversation(db: Session, conversation_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Recipe]:
    return list(
        db.scalars(
            select(Recipe)
            .where(Recipe.conversation_id == conversation_id)
            .order_by(Recipe.created_at)
        ).all()
    )

import uuid
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import RefreshToken


def add(db: Session, *, user_id: uuid.UUID, token_hash: str, expires_at: datetime) -> RefreshToken:
    row = RefreshToken(user_id=user_id, token_hash=token_hash, expires_at=expires_at)
    db.add(row)
    db.flush()
    return row


def get_for_update(db: Session, token_hash: str) -> RefreshToken | None:
    """Row-locks the token so concurrent refreshes with the same token are serialised."""
    return db.scalar(
        select(RefreshToken).where(RefreshToken.token_hash == token_hash).with_for_update()
    )


def revoke_all_for_user(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID, now: datetime) -> None:
    db.execute(
        update(RefreshToken)
        .where(RefreshToken.user_id == user_id, RefreshToken.revoked_at.is_(None))
        .values(revoked_at=now)
    )

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import User, UserPreferences


def get_by_email(db: Session, email: str) -> User | None:
    return db.scalar(select(User).where(User.email == email))


def get_by_id(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User | None:
    return db.get(User, user_id)


def create_user(db: Session, *, email: str, password_hash: str, display_name: str) -> User:
    """Insert a user with a default preferences row. Caller commits."""
    user = User(email=email, password_hash=password_hash, display_name=display_name)
    user.preferences = UserPreferences()
    db.add(user)
    db.flush()  # raises IntegrityError on a duplicate email
    return user


def get_preferences(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> UserPreferences | None:
    return db.get(UserPreferences, user_id)

    email: EmailStr

from typing import Generic, TypeVar

from pydantic import BaseModel

T = TypeVar("T")

MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100


class Page(BaseModel, Generic[T]):  # noqa: UP046  (py3.11 target: no PEP 695 syntax)
    items: list[T]
    total: int
    page: int
    page_size: int
    pages: int

    @classmethod
    def build(cls, items: list[T], total: int, page: int, page_size: int) -> "Page[T]":
        return cls(
            items=items,
            total=total,
            page=page,
            page_size=page_size,
            pages=(total + page_size - 1) // page_size,
        )

class RecipeWrite(BaseModel):
    """Full replacement used by the edit form. Constraints are re-checked server-side."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=600)
    servings: int = Field(ge=1, le=MAX_SERVINGS)
    prep_minutes: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1440)
    cook_minutes: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=1440)
    equipment: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    ingredients: list[IngredientIn] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_INGREDIENTS)
    steps: list[StepIn] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_STEPS)
    substitutions: list[SubstitutionIn] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    dietary_tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=12)
    tips: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=12)
    beginner_notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=10)
    safety_notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=10)
    expected_revision: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1)

    @field_validator("title")
    @classmethod
    def _title(cls, value: str) -> str:
        value = " ".join(value.split())
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("Title must not be blank.")
        return value

    def to_draft(self) -> RecipeDraft:
        return RecipeDraft(
            title=self.title, description=self.description, servings=self.servings,
            prep_minutes=self.prep_minutes, cook_minutes=self.cook_minutes,
            equipment=self.equipment, ingredients=self.ingredients, steps=self.steps,
            substitutions=self.substitutions, dietary_tags=self.dietary_tags,
            allergen_warnings=[], safety_notes=self.safety_notes,
            beginner_notes=self.beginner_notes, tips=self.tips,
        )

import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator

from app.ai.vision import MAX_ITEMS, VisionProviderInfo

MAX_MEAL_ITEMS = 30
_CONTROL = re.compile(r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f]")

UNCERTAINTY_NOTE = (
    "Item names come from an image model and may be wrong. This model does not give a reliable "
    "confidence score, so none is shown: please check every item."
)
DISCLAIMER = (
    "Estimates only, calculated from the food-composition data and the portions you entered. "
    "They are not medical or dietary advice. Check labels and consult a qualified professional "
    "for allergies or medical diets."
)
CALCULATION_METHOD = "nutrient per 100 g x grams eaten / 100, summed over items"


class WeightPortion(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    kind: Literal["weight"]
    amount: float = Field(gt=0, le=100_000)
    unit: Literal["g", "kg", "oz", "lb"]


class RangePortion(BaseModel):
    """A user-supplied estimate range. Never filled in automatically."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    kind: Literal["range"]
    min_amount: float = Field(gt=0, le=100_000)
    max_amount: float = Field(gt=0, le=100_000)
    unit: Literal["g", "kg", "oz", "lb"]


class ServingsPortion(BaseModel):
    """N servings, where one serving is the gram weight stated by the food's own source."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    kind: Literal["servings"]
    count: float = Field(gt=0, le=100)


Portion = Annotated[WeightPortion | RangePortion | ServingsPortion, Field(discriminator="kind")]


def clean_name(value: str) -> str:
    value = " ".join(_CONTROL.sub(" ", value).split())
    if not value:
        raise ValueError("Name must not be blank.")
    return value


class FoodSnapshot(BaseModel):
    """The trusted source record chosen for an item, frozen at selection time (audit)."""

    source: str

    name: Annotated[str, Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)]
    food_ref: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=8000)  # from /nutrition/search
    clear_food: bool = False  # drop the previously chosen nutrition match
    portion: Portion | None = None

    @field_validator("name")
    @classmethod

        return clean_name(value)

import re
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator, model_validator

from app.ai.vision import VisionProviderInfo
from app.domain.freshness import (
    FoodCategory,
    Packaging,
    StorageCondition,
)
from app.schemas.food import VisionCapability

_CONTROL = re.compile(r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f]")
MIN_DATE = date(2000, 1, 1)

VERDICT_NOTICE = (
    "This is a description of what is visible in one image plus general food-safety guidance. "
    "It is not a statement that the food is safe, or unsafe, to eat, and there is no freshness "
    "score."
)


def _clean(value: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(_CONTROL.sub(" ", value).split())


class DurationIn(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    amount: int = Field(ge=0, le=8760)
    unit: Literal["hours", "days"]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _bounded(self) -> "DurationIn":
        if self.unit == "days" and self.amount > 365:
            raise ValueError("Storage time cannot be more than 365 days.")
        return self

    @property
    def hours(self) -> int:
        return self.amount * (24 if self.unit == "days" else 1)


class AssessmentRequest(BaseModel):
    """What the user tells us. Nothing here is a model output or a verdict."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    media_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    # False: skip the image model and give guidance from the details alone (works offline).
    analyze_image: bool = True
    food_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    food_category: FoodCategory
    storage_condition: StorageCondition = StorageCondition.UNKNOWN
    packaging: Packaging = Packaging.UNKNOWN
    storage_duration: DurationIn | None = None
    purchased_on: date | None = None
    use_by_date: date | None = None
    best_before_date: date | None = None
    assessed_on: date | None = None  # the user's local "today"; defaults to the server's UTC date
    notes: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)

    @field_validator("food_name")
    @classmethod
    def _name(cls, value: str) -> str:
        value = _clean(value)
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("Name must not be blank.")
        return value

    @field_validator("notes")
    @classmethod
    def _notes(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        return (_clean(value) or None) if value else None

    @field_validator("purchased_on", "use_by_date", "best_before_date")
    @classmethod
    def _plausible_date(cls, value: date | None) -> date | None:
        if value is not None and not (MIN_DATE <= value <= date(2100, 1, 1)):
            raise ValueError("That date is out of range.")
        return value

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _needs_photo_to_analyse(self) -> "AssessmentRequest":
        if self.analyze_image and self.media_id is None:
            raise ValueError("A photo is needed to analyse an image. Or choose guidance only.")
        return self

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Annotated

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator

from app.models import MealCategory
from app.schemas.food import MAX_MEAL_ITEMS, FoodItemInput, MealAudit


class MealWrite(BaseModel):
    """Create or fully replace a meal. Totals are never accepted from the client."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    items: list[FoodItemInput] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_MEAL_ITEMS)
    eaten_at: datetime
    category: MealCategory
    notes: Annotated[str, Field(max_length=1000)] | None = None
    media_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    scan_ref: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=20_000)
    # Updates only: reject the write if the meal was changed elsewhere in the meantime.
    expected_revision: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1)

    @field_validator("eaten_at")
    @classmethod
    def _plausible_time(cls, value: datetime) -> datetime:
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            raise ValueError("eaten_at must include a time zone offset.")
        now = datetime.now(UTC)
        if value > now + timedelta(days=1):
            raise ValueError("A meal cannot be logged more than a day in the future.")
        if value < now - timedelta(days=3650):
            raise ValueError("That date is too far in the past.")
        return value.astimezone(UTC)

    @field_validator("notes")
    @classmethod
    def _notes(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return None
        value = value.strip()
        return value or None

import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Literal, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, EmailStr, Field, field_validator

from app.models.preferences import UnitSystem

DietaryPreference = Literal[
    "vegetarian",
    "vegan",
    "eggetarian",
    "pescatarian",
    "jain",
    "halal",
    "kosher",
    "gluten_free",
    "lactose_free",
]
DIETARY_PREFERENCES: tuple[str, ...] = get_args(DietaryPreference)

MAX_ALLERGIES = 20
# Letters/digits first, then letters, digits, space, apostrophe, hyphen or slash.
_ALLERGY_RE = re.compile(r"^[^\W_][\w '\-/]*$")


class UserRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: uuid.UUID
    email: EmailStr
    display_name: str
    created_at: datetime


class PreferencesRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    unit_system: UnitSystem
    dietary_preferences: list[str]
    allergies: list[str]
    updated_at: datetime


class PreferencesUpdate(BaseModel):
    """Full replacement of the user's preferences (PUT semantics)."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    unit_system: UnitSystem
    dietary_preferences: list[DietaryPreference] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    allergies: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_ALLERGIES)

    @field_validator("dietary_preferences")
    @classmethod
    def _dedupe_dietary(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        return list(dict.fromkeys(values))

    @field_validator("allergies")
    @classmethod
    def _normalise_allergies(cls, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        cleaned: list[str] = []
        for raw in values:
            item = " ".join(raw.split()).lower()
            if not 1 <= len(item) <= 50:
                raise ValueError("Each allergy must be 1-50 characters.")
            if not _ALLERGY_RE.match(item):
                raise ValueError("Allergies may contain only letters, digits, spaces, - ' and /.")
            cleaned.append(item)
        return list(dict.fromkeys(cleaned))

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)

    @field_validator("display_name")
    @classmethod
    def _clean_name(cls, value: str) -> str:
        value = " ".join(value.split())
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("Display name must not be blank.")
        return value

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/services/account_service.py

import logging
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core import security
from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.models import User
from app.repositories import tokens as token_repo
from app.schemas.user import PasswordChange, ProfileUpdate

logger = logging.getLogger("app.account")


def update_profile(db: Session, user: User, data: ProfileUpdate) -> User:
    user.display_name = data.display_name
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    return user


def change_password(db: Session, user: User, data: PasswordChange) -> None:
    # 400, not 401: the frontend treats 401 as "session lost", which this is not.
    if not security.verify_password(user.password_hash, data.current_password):
        raise AppError("Current password is incorrect.", code="invalid_current_password")
    if data.new_password == data.current_password:
        raise AppError("Choose a different password.", code="password_unchanged")
    user.password_hash = security.hash_password(data.new_password)
    # Sign out everywhere: every refresh token is revoked. Existing access tokens expire on
    # their own (max 15 minutes), as documented in ADR 0001.
    token_repo.revoke_all_for_user(db, user.id, datetime.now(UTC))
    db.commit()
    logger.info("password_changed user_id=%s", user.id)

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/services/auth_service.py
================================================================================

"""Registration, login, refresh-token rotation and logout.

Refresh tokens are single-use. Presenting an already-used (revoked) token is treated as
possible theft: every session of that user is revoked. See docs/adr/0001-auth-session-strategy.md.
"""

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core import security
from app.core.config import Settings
from app.core.errors import AppError, ConflictError, InvalidCredentialsError, NotAuthenticatedError
from app.models import User
from app.repositories import tokens as token_repo
from app.repositories import users as user_repo
from app.schemas.auth import LoginRequest, RegisterRequest

logger = logging.getLogger("app.auth")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AuthResult:
    user: User
    access_token: str
    expires_in: int
    refresh_token: str
    refresh_max_age: int


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _issue_tokens(db: Session, settings: Settings, user: User) -> AuthResult:
    access_token, expires_in = security.create_access_token(str(user.id), settings)
    raw_refresh = security.generate_refresh_token()
    max_age = settings.refresh_token_expire_days * 86400
    token_repo.add(
        db,
        user_id=user.id,
        token_hash=security.hash_refresh_token(raw_refresh),
        expires_at=_now() + timedelta(seconds=max_age),
    )
    return AuthResult(user, access_token, expires_in, raw_refresh, max_age)


def register(db: Session, settings: Settings, data: RegisterRequest) -> AuthResult:
    email = data.email.strip().lower()
    if user_repo.get_by_email(db, email) is not None:
        raise ConflictError("An account with this email already exists.", code="email_taken")
    try:
        user = user_repo.create_user(
            db,
            email=email,
            password_hash=security.hash_password(data.password),
            display_name=data.display_name,
        )
    except IntegrityError:  # lost a race with a concurrent registration
        db.rollback()
        raise ConflictError(
            "An account with this email already exists.", code="email_taken"
        ) from None
    result = _issue_tokens(db, settings, user)
    db.commit()
    logger.info("user_registered user_id=%s", user.id)
    return result


def login(db: Session, settings: Settings, data: LoginRequest) -> AuthResult:
    email = data.email.strip().lower()
    user = user_repo.get_by_email(db, email)
    if user is None:
        security.verify_dummy_password(data.password)
        raise InvalidCredentialsError("Incorrect email or password.")
    if not security.verify_password(user.password_hash, data.password) or not user.is_active:
        logger.info("login_failed user_id=%s", user.id)
        raise InvalidCredentialsError("Incorrect email or password.")
    if security.password_needs_rehash(user.password_hash):
        user.password_hash = security.hash_password(data.password)
    result = _issue_tokens(db, settings, user)
    db.commit()
    logger.info("login_succeeded user_id=%s", user.id)
    return result


def refresh(db: Session, settings: Settings, raw_token: str | None) -> AuthResult:
    invalid = NotAuthenticatedError(
        "Session expired. Please sign in again.", code="invalid_refresh"
    )
    if not raw_token:
        raise invalid
    now = _now()
    row = token_repo.get_for_update(db, security.hash_refresh_token(raw_token))
    if row is None:
        raise invalid
    if row.revoked_at is not None:
        token_repo.revoke_all_for_user(db, row.user_id, now)
        db.commit()
        logger.warning("refresh_token_reuse_detected user_id=%s", row.user_id)
        raise invalid
    if row.expires_at <= now:
        raise invalid
    user = user_repo.get_by_id(db, row.user_id)
    if user is None or not user.is_active:
        raise invalid
    row.revoked_at = now
    result = _issue_tokens(db, settings, user)
    db.commit()
    return result


def logout(db: Session, raw_token: str | None) -> None:
    """Revoke the presented refresh token. Always succeeds from the caller's point of view."""
    if not raw_token:
        return
    row = token_repo.get_for_update(db, security.hash_refresh_token(raw_token))
    if row is not None and row.revoked_at is None:
        row.revoked_at = _now()
        db.commit()
        logger.info("logout user_id=%s", row.user_id)
    else:
        db.rollback()


__all__ = ["AppError", "AuthResult", "login", "logout", "refresh", "register"]

================================================================================

"""The conversational cooking assistant and one-shot recipe generation.

Flow: build a bounded, user-scoped prompt -> ask the configured text provider -> validate the
reply against a strict schema -> run the deterministic allergen/diet gate -> persist.
A reply whose recipe fails the gate is stored with an explicit warning and **without** the
recipe; the model's prose is never shown as if the recipe were usable.
"""

import logging
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.ai.cooking import (
    CHAT_JSON_SCHEMA, RECIPE_JSON_SCHEMA, ChatReplyDraft, RecipeDraft, build_chat_messages,
    build_recipe_prompt, parse_chat, parse_recipe,
)
from app.ai.text import ChatTurn, TextProvider, TextProviderInfo
from app.core.config import Settings
from app.core.errors import NotFoundError
from app.core.limits import limiter
from app.domain.diet_rules import DIET_LABELS, declared_but_unverifiable
from app.domain.recipes import allergy_disclosure, enforce
from app.models.cooking import CookingConversation, CookingMessage, MessageRole
from app.models import User, UserPreferences
from app.repositories import conversations as convo_repo
from app.repositories import recipes as recipe_repo
from app.schemas.common import Page
from app.schemas.cooking import (
    ChatRequest, ChatResponse, Choice, ConversationDetail, ConversationSummary,
    CookingCapabilities, GenerateRecipeRequest, MessageOut, RecipeRead, TextCapability,
)
from app.services import recipe_service
from app.services.preferences_service import get_preferences

logger = logging.getLogger("app.cooking")

MAX_REPLY_CHARS = 6000


def capabilities(settings: Settings) -> CookingCapabilities:
    if settings.text_provider == "openai_compatible":
        from app.ai.openai_vision import is_local_url

        text = TextCapability(
            configured=True, provider="openai_compatible", model=settings.text_api_model,
            external=not is_local_url(settings.text_api_base_url),
        )
    elif not settings.ollama_enabled:
        text = TextCapability(
            configured=False, provider="ollama",
            message="The cooking assistant is not enabled on this server. Recipes cannot be generated.",
        )
    elif not settings.ollama_text_model:
        text = TextCapability(
            configured=False, provider="ollama",
            message="No text model is configured on this server (OLLAMA_TEXT_MODEL).",
        )
    else:
        text = TextCapability(
            configured=True, provider="ollama", model=settings.ollama_text_model, external=False
        )
    return CookingCapabilities(
        text=text,
        diets=[Choice(value=k, label=v) for k, v in DIET_LABELS.items()],
        context_messages=settings.cooking_context_messages,
    )


def _restrictions(db: Session, user: User) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    prefs: UserPreferences = get_preferences(db, user)
    return list(prefs.allergies), list(prefs.dietary_preferences)


def _message_out(row: CookingMessage) -> MessageOut:
    return MessageOut(
        id=row.id, role=row.role.value, content=row.content, recipe_id=row.recipe_id,
        warnings=list(row.warnings or []), created_at=row.created_at,
    )


def _history(db: Session, conversation_id: uuid.UUID, settings: Settings) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    rows = convo_repo.recent_messages(db, conversation_id, settings.cooking_context_messages)
    turns: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    used = 0
    for row in rows:  # newest N messages, trimmed by characters from the oldest end
        content = row.content[:MAX_REPLY_CHARS]
        used += len(content)
        if used > settings.cooking_context_chars:
            break
        turns.append((row.role.value, content))
    return turns


def _create_conversation(db: Session, user: User, title: str) -> CookingConversation:
    return convo_repo.add(
        db, CookingConversation(owner_id=user.id, title=" ".join(title.split())[:200] or "Cooking")
    )


def _store(
    db: Session,
    user: User,
    conversation: CookingConversation,
    role: MessageRole,
    content: str,
    *,
    recipe_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    warnings: list[str] | None = None,
) -> CookingMessage:
    return convo_repo.add_message(
        db,
        CookingMessage(
            conversation_id=conversation.id,
            owner_id=user.id,
            role=role,
            content=content[:MAX_REPLY_CHARS],
            recipe_id=recipe_id,
            warnings=warnings or [],
            position=convo_repo.next_position(db, conversation.id),
        ),
    )


def chat(
    db: Session,
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    req: ChatRequest,
    make_provider: Callable[[], TextProvider],
) -> ChatResponse:
    limiter("cooking assistant", settings.cooking_rate_limit_per_minute).check(str(user.id))
    allergies, diets = _restrictions(db, user)

    if req.conversation_id is not None:
        conversation = convo_repo.get_owned(db, req.conversation_id, user.id)
        if conversation is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Conversation not found.", code="conversation_not_found")
    else:
        conversation = _create_conversation(db, user, req.message)

    provider = make_provider()  # raises a clear error when no model is configured
    history = _history(db, conversation.id, settings)
    messages = [
        ChatTurn(**m)
        for m in build_chat_messages(
            history=history, user_message=req.message, allergies=allergies, diets=diets,
            recipe_allowed=True,
        )
    ]
    logger.info("cooking_chat_started user_id=%s conversation_id=%s model=%s",
                user.id, conversation.id, provider.info.model)
    raw = provider.complete(messages, CHAT_JSON_SCHEMA)
    reply: ChatReplyDraft = parse_chat(raw)

    user_row = _store(db, user, conversation, MessageRole.USER, req.message)
    warnings = list(allergy_disclosure(
        reply.recipe, allergies
    )["warnings"]) if reply.recipe else []
    warnings += [
        f"“{d}” cannot be verified from an ingredient list; check certification yourself."
        for d in declared_but_unverifiable(diets)
    ]
    recipe_row = None
    recipe_out: RecipeRead | None = None
    if reply.recipe is not None:
        conflicts = enforce(reply.recipe, allergies, diets)
        if conflicts:
            warnings.append(
                "A suggested recipe was withheld because it conflicts with your restrictions: "
                + "; ".join(c.message for c in conflicts[:4])
            )
        else:
            recipe_row = recipe_service.create_suggested(
                db, user, reply.recipe,
                provider=provider.info, conversation_id=conversation.id,
            )
            recipe_out = recipe_service.to_read(recipe_row)

    content = reply.reply
    if reply.follow_up_questions:
        content += "\n\n" + "\n".join(f"· {q}" for q in reply.follow_up_questions)
    assistant_row = _store(
        db, user, conversation, MessageRole.ASSISTANT, content,
        recipe_id=recipe_row.id if recipe_row else None, warnings=warnings,
    )
    conversation.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user_row)
    db.refresh(assistant_row)
    logger.info("cooking_chat_finished user_id=%s conversation_id=%s recipe=%s",
                user.id, conversation.id, bool(recipe_row))
    return ChatResponse(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        user_message=_message_out(user_row),
        assistant_message=_message_out(assistant_row),
        recipe=recipe_out,
        provider=provider.info,
    )


def generate_recipe(
    db: Session,
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    req: GenerateRecipeRequest,
    make_provider: Callable[[], TextProvider],
) -> RecipeRead:
    limiter("cooking assistant", settings.cooking_rate_limit_per_minute).check(str(user.id))
    allergies, diets = _restrictions(db, user)
    if req.mode == "from_ingredients" and not req.ingredients:
        from app.core.errors import AppError

        raise AppError("List at least one ingredient.", code="invalid_input", status_code=422)

    conversation = None
    if req.conversation_id is not None:
        conversation = convo_repo.get_owned(db, req.conversation_id, user.id)
        if conversation is None:
            raise NotFoundError("Conversation not found.", code="conversation_not_found")

    provider = make_provider()
    prompt = build_recipe_prompt(
        ingredients=req.ingredients, allergies=allergies, diets=diets,
        servings=req.servings, style=req.mode,
    )
    logger.info("recipe_generate_started user_id=%s model=%s", user.id, provider.info.model)
    raw = provider.complete(
        [ChatTurn(role="system", content="You are a careful recipe writer."),
         ChatTurn(role="user", content=prompt)],
        RECIPE_JSON_SCHEMA,
    )
    draft: RecipeDraft = parse_recipe(raw)
    row = recipe_service.create_suggested(
        db, user, draft, provider=provider.info,
        conversation_id=conversation.id if conversation else None,
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    logger.info("recipe_generate_finished user_id=%s recipe_id=%s", user.id, row.id)
    return recipe_service.to_read(row)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- conversations
def _summary(db: Session, row: CookingConversation) -> ConversationSummary:
    return ConversationSummary(
        id=row.id, title=row.title, message_count=convo_repo.message_count(db, row.id),
        created_at=row.created_at, updated_at=row.updated_at,
    )


def list_conversations(db: Session, user: User, *, page: int, page_size: int) -> Page[ConversationSummary]:
    rows, total = convo_repo.list_page(db, user.id, limit=page_size, offset=(page - 1) * page_size)
    return Page.build([_summary(db, r) for r in rows], total, page, page_size)


def get_conversation(db: Session, user: User, conversation_id: uuid.UUID) -> ConversationDetail:
    row = convo_repo.get_owned(db, conversation_id, user.id)
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Conversation not found.", code="conversation_not_found")
    recipes = recipe_repo.for_conversation(db, row.id)
    base = _summary(db, row)
    return ConversationDetail(
        **base.model_dump(),
        messages=[_message_out(m) for m in convo_repo.all_messages(db, row.id)],
        recipes=[recipe_service.summary(r) for r in recipes],
    )


def delete_conversation(db: Session, user: User, conversation_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    row = convo_repo.get_owned(db, conversation_id, user.id)
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Conversation not found.", code="conversation_not_found")
    db.delete(row)  # messages cascade; suggested recipes keep their content (conversation_id null)
    db.commit()
    logger.info("conversation_deleted user_id=%s conversation_id=%s", user.id, conversation_id)


def provider_info(provider: TextProvider) -> TextProviderInfo:
    return provider.info

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import Settings
from app.models import User
from app.repositories import history as history_repo
from app.repositories import media as media_repo
from app.schemas.dashboard import DashboardSummary, HistoryUsage, MediaUsage
from app.schemas.history import HistoryItem

RECENT_LIMIT = 5


def summary(db: Session, settings: Settings, user: User) -> DashboardSummary:
    """Real counts only. A new account gets zeros and an empty list, never placeholders."""
    count, total_bytes = media_repo.usage(db, user.id)
    by_module = history_repo.counts_by_module(db, user.id)
    recent, _ = history_repo.list_page(db, user.id, module=None, limit=RECENT_LIMIT, offset=0)
    return DashboardSummary(
        media=MediaUsage(
            count=count,
            total_bytes=total_bytes,
            quota_bytes=settings.user_media_quota_bytes,
            max_upload_bytes=settings.max_upload_bytes,
        ),
        history=HistoryUsage(total=sum(by_module.values()), by_module=by_module),
        recent=[HistoryItem.model_validate(r) for r in recent],
    )
