"""Food workflow: scan a photo -> user confirms items -> deterministic nutrition calculation.

Trust boundaries, in order:
  1. The vision model only *names* candidate foods. Its output is schema-validated and signed.
  2. The user edits/confirms names and enters portions.
  3. Nutrient values come only from a trusted source record the user picked (signed server-side
     at search time); the browser can neither alter nor invent them.
  4. Totals are computed by app.domain.nutrition_calc. No model is involved.
"""

import logging
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.ai.openai_vision import is_local_url
from app.ai.vision import VisionProvider, VisionProviderInfo
from app.core.config import Settings
from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.core.limits import limiter
from app.core.signed_refs import InvalidRefError, sign_ref, verify_ref
from app.domain import nutrition_calc as calc
from app.media.storage import StorageBackend, StorageError
from app.models import MediaKind, User
from app.nutrition.nutrients import NUTRIENT_BY_KEY, NUTRIENTS
from app.nutrition.service import NutritionService
from app.nutrition.types import FoodCandidate
from app.schemas.food import (
    CalculateRequest,
    CalculationOut,
    CandidateOut,
    FoodCapabilities,
    FoodItemInput,
    FoodSnapshot,
    ItemCalcOut,
    MealAudit,
    ModelObservations,
    NutrientValueOut,
    ObservedFood,
    PortionOut,
    RangePortion,
    ScanResponse,
    ServingsPortion,
    TotalOut,
    VisionCapability,
    WeightPortion,
)
from app.services import media_service

logger = logging.getLogger("app.food")
Origin = Literal["model", "model_edited", "user_added"]
MAX_SCAN_IMAGE_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024


class InvalidPortionError(AppError):
    status_code = 422
    code = "invalid_portion"


class InvalidItemError(AppError):
    status_code = 422
    code = "invalid_item"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- capabilities
def vision_capability(settings: Settings) -> VisionCapability:
    """What is configured. This does not contact the model server (that can be slow)."""
    if settings.vision_provider == "openai_compatible":
        return VisionCapability(
            configured=True,
            provider="openai_compatible",
            model=settings.vision_api_model,
            external=not is_local_url(settings.vision_api_base_url),
        )
    if not settings.ollama_enabled:
        return VisionCapability(
            configured=False,
            provider="ollama",
            message="Photo recognition is not enabled on this server. You can add foods manually.",
        )
    if not settings.ollama_vision_model:
        return VisionCapability(
            configured=False,
            provider="ollama",
            message="No vision model is configured on this server. You can add foods manually.",
        )
    return VisionCapability(
        configured=True, provider="ollama", model=settings.ollama_vision_model, external=False
    )


def capabilities(settings: Settings, nutrition: NutritionService) -> FoodCapabilities:
    return FoodCapabilities(vision=vision_capability(settings), nutrition=nutrition.status())


def candidate_out(settings: Settings, user: User, candidate: FoodCandidate) -> CandidateOut:
    snapshot = FoodSnapshot.model_validate(candidate.model_dump())
    ref = sign_ref(settings, "food", user.id, snapshot.model_dump(mode="json"))
    return CandidateOut(**snapshot.model_dump(), food_ref=ref)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- scan
def scan(
    db: Session,
    storage: StorageBackend,
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    media_id: uuid.UUID,
    make_provider: Callable[[], VisionProvider],
) -> ScanResponse:
    limiter("photo analysis", settings.scan_rate_limit_per_minute).check(str(user.id))
    asset = media_service.get_owned_or_404(db, user, media_id)  # ownership first
    if asset.kind != MediaKind.IMAGE:
        raise InvalidItemError("Only images can be analysed.")
    provider = make_provider()  # raises a clear error if vision is not configured
    try:
        handle = storage.open(asset.storage_key)
    except StorageError:
        raise AppError(
            "The photo file is unavailable.", code="media_not_found", status_code=404
        ) from None
    with handle:
        image = handle.read(MAX_SCAN_IMAGE_BYTES + 1)
    if len(image) > MAX_SCAN_IMAGE_BYTES:
        raise InvalidItemError("That image is too large to analyse.")

    logger.info(
        "scan_started user_id=%s media_id=%s model=%s", user.id, asset.id, provider.info.model
    )
    result = provider.identify(image)  # any failure is a VisionError with a safe message
    items = [
        ObservedFood(
            observed_id=i,
            name=d.name,
            description=d.description,
            ambiguous=d.ambiguous,
            alternatives=d.alternatives,
        )
        for i, d in enumerate(result.items)
    ]
    generated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    payload = {
        "media_id": str(asset.id),
        "provider": provider.info.model_dump(),
        "items": [i.model_dump() for i in items],
        "notes": result.notes,
        "generated_at": generated_at.isoformat(),
    }
    logger.info("scan_finished user_id=%s media_id=%s items=%d", user.id, asset.id, len(items))
    return ScanResponse(
        scan_ref=sign_ref(settings, "scan", user.id, payload),
        media_id=asset.id,
        provider=provider.info,
        items=items,
        notes=result.notes,
        generated_at=generated_at,
    )


def read_scan(settings: Settings, user: User, scan_ref: str) -> ModelObservations:
    payload = verify_ref(settings, "scan", user.id, scan_ref)
    try:
        return ModelObservations(
            provider=VisionProviderInfo.model_validate(payload["provider"]),
            media_id=uuid.UUID(payload["media_id"]),
            items=[ObservedFood.model_validate(i) for i in payload["items"]],
            notes=payload.get("notes"),
            generated_at=datetime.fromisoformat(payload["generated_at"]),
        )
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, ValidationError):
        raise InvalidRefError() from None


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- calculation
@dataclass
class _Resolved:
    item_id: uuid.UUID
    name: str
    origin: Origin
    observed_name: str | None
    food: FoodSnapshot | None
    portion_input: WeightPortion | RangePortion | ServingsPortion | None


def _read_food_ref(settings: Settings, user: User, ref: str) -> FoodSnapshot:
    payload = verify_ref(settings, "food", user.id, ref)
    try:
        return FoodSnapshot.model_validate(payload)
    except ValidationError:
        raise InvalidRefError() from None


def _resolve(
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    items: list[FoodItemInput],
    observations: ModelObservations | None,
    existing: MealAudit | None,
) -> list[_Resolved]:
    existing_by_id = {i.item_id: i for i in existing.items} if existing else {}
    seen_ids: set[uuid.UUID] = set()
    resolved: list[_Resolved] = []
    for inp in items:
        base: ItemCalcOut | None = None
        if inp.item_id is not None and existing is not None:
            base = existing_by_id.get(inp.item_id)
            if base is None:
                raise InvalidItemError(f"'{inp.name}' does not belong to this meal.")
        item_id = inp.item_id or uuid.uuid4()
        if item_id in seen_ids:
            raise InvalidItemError("The same item was sent twice.")
        seen_ids.add(item_id)

        origin: Origin
        observed_name: str | None
        if base is not None:
            observed_name = base.observed_name
            origin = base.origin
            if origin == "model" and inp.name.casefold() != (observed_name or "").casefold():
                origin = "model_edited"
        elif inp.observed_id is not None:
            if observations is None:
                raise InvalidItemError("A scan reference is required for items from a photo.")
            if inp.observed_id >= len(observations.items):
                raise InvalidItemError("That detected item does not exist in the scan.")
            observed_name = observations.items[inp.observed_id].name
            origin = "model" if inp.name.casefold() == observed_name.casefold() else "model_edited"
        else:
            observed_name, origin = None, "user_added"

        food_changed = False
        food: FoodSnapshot | None
        if inp.food_ref:
            food = _read_food_ref(settings, user, inp.food_ref)
            food_changed = True
        elif inp.clear_food:
            food, food_changed = None, True
        else:
            food = base.food if base else None

        portion = inp.portion
        if portion is None and base is not None:
            portion = base.portion_input
            if food_changed and isinstance(portion, ServingsPortion):
                portion = None  # "servings" belonged to the old food's serving size
        resolved.append(_Resolved(item_id, inp.name, origin, observed_name, food, portion))
    return resolved


def _to_portion(item: _Resolved) -> calc.Portion | None:
    p = item.portion_input
    try:
        if p is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(p, WeightPortion):
            return calc.weight_portion(p.amount, p.unit)
        if isinstance(p, RangePortion):
            return calc.range_portion(p.min_amount, p.max_amount, p.unit)
        return calc.servings_portion(p.count, item.food.serving_grams if item.food else None)
    except calc.PortionError as exc:
        raise InvalidPortionError(f"{item.name}: {exc}") from None


def _f(value: Decimal) -> float:
    return float(calc.round_amount(value))


def _compute(resolved: list[_Resolved]) -> CalculationOut:
    results: list[calc.ItemResult] = []
    out_items: list[ItemCalcOut] = []
    for r in resolved:
        portion = _to_portion(r)
        result = calc.compute_item(
            calc.ItemInput(
                name=r.name, per_100g=r.food.per_100g if r.food else None, portion=portion
            )
        )
        results.append(result)
        out_items.append(
            ItemCalcOut(
                item_id=r.item_id,
                name=r.name,
                origin=r.origin,
                observed_name=r.observed_name,
                food=r.food,
                portion_input=r.portion_input,
                portion=PortionOut(
                    description=portion.description,
                    grams_low=_f(portion.grams_low),
                    grams_high=_f(portion.grams_high),
                    uncertain=portion.uncertain,
                )
                if portion
                else None,
                nutrients={
                    key: NutrientValueOut(low=_f(lo), high=_f(hi), unit=NUTRIENT_BY_KEY[key].unit)
                    for key, (lo, hi) in result.nutrients.items()
                },
                not_reported=list(result.not_reported),
                warnings=list(result.warnings),
            )
        )

    totals_raw = calc.compute_totals(results)
    totals = {
        key: TotalOut(
            key=key,
            label=NUTRIENT_BY_KEY[key].label,
            unit=NUTRIENT_BY_KEY[key].unit,
            low=_f(t.low) if t.low is not None else None,
            high=_f(t.high) if t.high is not None else None,
            complete=t.complete,
            contributing_items=t.contributing_items,
            missing_items=list(t.missing_items),
        )
        for key, t in totals_raw.items()
    }
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if any(not totals[n.key].complete for n in NUTRIENTS if n.core):
        warnings.append("incomplete_totals")
    if any(i.portion and i.portion.uncertain for i in out_items):
        warnings.append("estimated_portions")
    if all(not r.has_nutrition_data for r in results):
        warnings.append("no_nutrition_data")
    return CalculationOut(items=out_items, totals=totals, warnings=warnings)


def calculate_audit(
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    items: list[FoodItemInput],
    *,
    scan_ref: str | None,
    existing: MealAudit | None,
) -> MealAudit:
    observations = read_scan(settings, user, scan_ref) if scan_ref else None
    resolved = _resolve(settings, user, items, observations, existing)
    calculation = _compute(resolved)
    return MealAudit(
        **calculation.model_dump(),
        model_observations=observations or (existing.model_observations if existing else None),
    )


def calculate(
    db: Session,
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    request: CalculateRequest,
    load_existing: Callable[[Session, User, uuid.UUID], MealAudit],
) -> CalculationOut:
    existing = load_existing(db, user, request.meal_id) if request.meal_id else None
    audit = calculate_audit(
        settings, user, request.items, scan_ref=request.scan_ref, existing=existing
    )
    return CalculationOut.model_validate(
        audit.model_dump(exclude={"schema_version", "model_observations"})
    )


def audit_json(audit: MealAudit) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return audit.model_dump(mode="json")

================================================================================
FILE: backend/app/services/freshness_service.py

"""Freshness / spoilage-sign assessment.

Trust boundaries, in order:
  1. The vision model reports only visible *evidence* (schema-validated; verdict language is
     withheld). It never chooses the label, the advice, or any risk statement.
  2. `app.domain.freshness.assess` derives the label and the guidance with fixed rules, from that
     evidence plus the details the user entered.
  3. Everything is saved as an audit record. No failed or partial model output is ever stored.
"""

import logging
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.ai.freshness import (
    FRESHNESS_JSON_SCHEMA,
    FreshnessModelOutput,
    build_freshness_prompt,
    parse_freshness_output,
)
from app.ai.vision import VisionProvider
from app.core.config import Settings
from app.core.errors import AppError, NotFoundError
from app.core.limits import limiter
from app.domain import freshness as rules
from app.media.storage import StorageBackend, StorageError
from app.models import (
    AnalysisRecord,
    AnalysisStatus,
    FreshnessAssessment,
    MediaKind,
    ModuleKey,
    User,
)
from app.repositories import freshness as repo
from app.schemas.common import Page
from app.schemas.freshness import (
    AdviceOut,
    AssessmentOut,
    AssessmentRequest,
    Choice,
    FoodOut,
    FreshnessAudit,
    FreshnessCapabilities,
    FreshnessDetail,
    FreshnessSummary,
    ImageFindings,
    InputsOut,
    ObservationView,
    ReasonOut,
    SourceLink,
)
from app.services import food_service, media_service

logger = logging.getLogger("app.freshness")

FEATURE_LABELS: dict[rules.Feature, str] = {
    rules.Feature.DISCOLORATION: "Discolouration",
    rules.Feature.BRUISING: "Bruising",
    rules.Feature.WILTING: "Wilting",
    rules.Feature.MOLD_LIKE_GROWTH: "Mould-like growth",
    rules.Feature.SURFACE_CHANGE: "Unusual surface change",
    rules.Feature.VISIBLE_DAMAGE: "Visible damage",
    rules.Feature.OTHER: "Other visible change",
}
STORAGE_LABELS: dict[rules.StorageCondition, str] = {
    rules.StorageCondition.REFRIGERATOR: "Refrigerator",
    rules.StorageCondition.FREEZER: "Freezer",
    rules.StorageCondition.ROOM_TEMPERATURE: "Room temperature",
    rules.StorageCondition.UNKNOWN: "Not sure",
}
PACKAGING_LABELS: dict[rules.Packaging, str] = {
    rules.Packaging.SEALED_UNOPENED: "Sealed, unopened",
    rules.Packaging.OPENED: "Opened",
    rules.Packaging.UNPACKAGED: "Not packaged",
    rules.Packaging.UNKNOWN: "Not sure",
}
HEADLINES: dict[rules.AdviceLevel, str] = {
    rules.AdviceLevel.DISCARD: "Discarding it is recommended",
    rules.AdviceLevel.CAUTION: "Use caution: appearance cannot confirm safety",
    rules.AdviceLevel.GENERAL: "Appearance cannot confirm safety",
}


def capabilities(settings: Settings) -> FreshnessCapabilities:
    return FreshnessCapabilities(
        vision=food_service.vision_capability(settings),
        categories=[
            Choice(value=c.value, label=rules.CATEGORY_LABELS[c]) for c in rules.FoodCategory
        ],
        storage_conditions=[Choice(value=c.value, label=STORAGE_LABELS[c]) for c in STORAGE_LABELS],
        packaging=[Choice(value=c.value, label=PACKAGING_LABELS[c]) for c in PACKAGING_LABELS],
    )


def _invalid(message: str, code: str = "invalid_input") -> AppError:
    return AppError(message, code=code, status_code=422)


def _resolve_dates(req: AssessmentRequest) -> date:
    today = datetime.now(UTC).date()
    assessed_on = req.assessed_on or today
    if abs((assessed_on - today).days) > 1:
        raise _invalid(
            "The date on your device looks wrong. Check it and try again.", "invalid_date"
        )
    if req.purchased_on is not None and req.purchased_on > assessed_on:
        raise _invalid("The purchase date cannot be in the future.", "invalid_date")
    return assessed_on


def _evidence(out: FreshnessModelOutput) -> rules.ImageEvidence:
    return rules.ImageEvidence(
        image_quality=out.image_quality,
        food_visible=out.food_visible,
        matches_confirmed_food=out.matches_confirmed_food,
        observations=tuple(
            rules.ObservedSign(o.feature, o.description, o.location, o.severity, o.certainty)
            for o in out.observations
        ),
    )


def _findings(out: FreshnessModelOutput | None) -> ImageFindings:
    if out is None:
        return ImageFindings(analysed=False)
    return ImageFindings(
        analysed=True,
        image_quality=out.image_quality.value,
        food_visible=out.food_visible,
        matches_confirmed_food=out.matches_confirmed_food,
        observations=[
            ObservationView(
                feature=o.feature.value,
                feature_label=FEATURE_LABELS[o.feature],
                description=o.description,
                location=o.location,
                severity=o.severity,
                certainty=o.certainty,
            )
            for o in out.observations
        ],
        limitations=out.limitations,
        notes=out.notes,
        withheld_text_count=out.withheld_text_count,
    )


def _read_image(db: Session, storage: StorageBackend, user: User, media_id: uuid.UUID) -> bytes:
    asset = media_service.get_owned_or_404(db, user, media_id)  # ownership first
    if asset.kind != MediaKind.IMAGE:
        raise _invalid("Only images can be analysed.", "invalid_item")
    try:
        handle = storage.open(asset.storage_key)
    except StorageError:
        raise AppError(
            "The photo file is unavailable.", code="media_not_found", status_code=404
        ) from None
    with handle:
        image = handle.read(food_service.MAX_SCAN_IMAGE_BYTES + 1)
    if len(image) > food_service.MAX_SCAN_IMAGE_BYTES:
        raise _invalid("That image is too large to analyse.", "invalid_item")
    return image


def create_assessment(
    db: Session,
    storage: StorageBackend,
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    req: AssessmentRequest,
    make_provider: Callable[[], VisionProvider],
) -> FreshnessDetail:
    assessed_on = _resolve_dates(req)
    category = req.food_category
    media_id = req.media_id
    image: bytes | None = None
    if media_id is not None:
        if req.analyze_image:
            limiter("photo analysis", settings.scan_rate_limit_per_minute).check(str(user.id))
            image = _read_image(db, storage, user, media_id)
        else:
            media_service.get_owned_or_404(db, user, media_id)  # attach only the user's own photo

    output: FreshnessModelOutput | None = None
    provider_info = None
    if req.analyze_image and image is not None:
        provider = make_provider()  # clear error if no vision model is configured
        logger.info("freshness_started user_id=%s model=%s", user.id, provider.info.model)
        prompt = build_freshness_prompt(req.food_name, rules.CATEGORY_LABELS[category])
        raw = provider.complete_json(image, prompt, FRESHNESS_JSON_SCHEMA)
        output = parse_freshness_output(raw)  # VisionBadOutputError -> 502, nothing is saved
        provider_info = provider.info

    ctx = rules.Context(
        category=category,
        storage=req.storage_condition,
        packaging=req.packaging,
        storage_hours=req.storage_duration.hours if req.storage_duration else None,
        use_by=req.use_by_date,
        best_before=req.best_before_date,
        assessed_on=assessed_on,
    )
    result = rules.assess(_evidence(output) if output else None, ctx)

    generated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    audit = FreshnessAudit(
        food=FoodOut(
            name=req.food_name,
            category=category.value,
            category_label=rules.CATEGORY_LABELS[category],
        ),
        inputs=InputsOut(
            storage_condition=req.storage_condition.value,
            packaging=req.packaging.value,
            storage_hours=ctx.storage_hours,
            purchased_on=req.purchased_on,
            use_by_date=req.use_by_date,
            best_before_date=req.best_before_date,
            assessed_on=assessed_on,
            notes=req.notes,
        ),
        findings=_findings(output),
        assessment=AssessmentOut(
            label=result.label.value,
            label_text=rules.LABEL_TEXT[result.label],
            inconclusive_reasons=[
                ReasonOut(code=r.code, text=r.text) for r in result.inconclusive_reasons
            ],
        ),
        advice=AdviceOut(
            level=result.advice_level.value,
            headline=HEADLINES[result.advice_level],
            reasons=[ReasonOut(code=r.code, text=r.text) for r in result.advice_reasons],
            steps=list(result.steps),
            category_cautions=list(result.category_cautions),
            general_notes=list(rules.GENERAL_NOTES),
            retake_tips=list(result.retake_tips),
            sources=[SourceLink(name=n, url=u) for n, u in rules.GUIDANCE_SOURCES],
        ),
        provider=provider_info,
        generated_at=generated_at,
    )
    record = AnalysisRecord(
        owner_id=user.id,
        module=ModuleKey.FRESHNESS,
        status=AnalysisStatus.COMPLETED,
        title=f"Freshness check: {req.food_name}"[:200],
        summary=audit.assessment.label_text,
        result=audit.model_dump(mode="json"),
        media_id=media_id,
    )
    db.add(record)
    db.flush()
    row = FreshnessAssessment(
        analysis_id=record.id,
        owner_id=user.id,
        food_name=req.food_name,
        food_category=category.value,
        label=result.label.value,
        advice_level=result.advice_level.value,
        image_analysed=output is not None,
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    db.refresh(row)
    logger.info(
        "freshness_saved user_id=%s id=%s label=%s analysed=%s",
        user.id,
        record.id,
        row.label,
        row.image_analysed,
    )
    return _detail(row, record)


def _summary(row: FreshnessAssessment, record: AnalysisRecord) -> FreshnessSummary:
    return FreshnessSummary(
        id=row.analysis_id,
        food_name=row.food_name,
        food_category=row.food_category,
        category_label=rules.CATEGORY_LABELS[rules.FoodCategory(row.food_category)],
        label=row.label,
        label_text=rules.LABEL_TEXT[rules.VisualLabel(row.label)],
        advice_level=row.advice_level,
        image_analysed=row.image_analysed,
        media_id=record.media_id,
        created_at=row.created_at,
    )


def _detail(row: FreshnessAssessment, record: AnalysisRecord) -> FreshnessDetail:
    return FreshnessDetail(
        **_summary(row, record).model_dump(), result=FreshnessAudit.model_validate(record.result)
    )


def _get_or_404(
    db: Session, user: User, assessment_id: uuid.UUID
) -> tuple[FreshnessAssessment, AnalysisRecord]:
    found = repo.get_owned(db, assessment_id, user.id)
    if found is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Freshness check not found.", code="freshness_not_found")
    return found


def get_assessment(db: Session, user: User, assessment_id: uuid.UUID) -> FreshnessDetail:
    return _detail(*_get_or_404(db, user, assessment_id))


def delete_assessment(db: Session, user: User, assessment_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    _, record = _get_or_404(db, user, assessment_id)
    db.delete(record)  # the freshness_assessments row goes with it (ON DELETE CASCADE)
    db.commit()
    logger.info("freshness_deleted user_id=%s id=%s", user.id, assessment_id)


def list_assessments(
    db: Session,
    user: User,
    *,
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
    label: rules.VisualLabel | None,
    category: rules.FoodCategory | None,
) -> Page[FreshnessSummary]:
    rows, total = repo.list_page(
        db,
        user.id,
        limit=page_size,
        offset=(page - 1) * page_size,
        label=label.value if label else None,
        category=category.value if category else None,
    )
    return Page.build([_summary(a, r) for a, r in rows], total, page, page_size)

import uuid

    db: Session, user: User, *, module: ModuleKey | None, page: int, page_size: int
) -> Page[HistoryItem]:
    rows, total = history_repo.list_page(
        db, user.id, module=module, limit=page_size, offset=(page - 1) * page_size
    )

    if record is None:
        raise NotFoundError("History entry not found.", code="history_not_found")
    return record

    db.delete(get_owned_or_404(db, user, record_id))
    db.commit()

"""Hygiene inspection workflow.

The AI provider reports visible indicators only. Deterministic rules and fixed text own the
report's structure, actions, and disclosures. Failed or malformed model output never persists.
"""

import logging
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.ai.hygiene import (
    HYGIENE_JSON_SCHEMA,
    HygieneModelOutput,
    build_hygiene_prompt,
    parse_hygiene_output,
)
from app.ai.vision import VisionProvider
from app.core.config import Settings
from app.core.errors import AppError, ConflictError, NotFoundError
from app.core.limits import limiter
from app.domain import hygiene as rules
from app.models import (
    AnalysisRecord,
    AnalysisStatus,
    HygieneInspection,
    MediaKind,
    ModuleKey,
    User,
)
from app.repositories import hygiene as repo
from app.schemas.common import Page
from app.schemas.hygiene import (
    Choice,
    ChecklistItem,
    FindingInput,
    FindingOut,
    HygieneAudit,
    HygieneCapabilities,
    InspectionCreate,
    InspectionDetail,
    InspectionSummary,
    InspectionUpdate,
    LocationOut,
    StatusChange,
    category_label,
)
from app.services import food_service, media_service

logger = logging.getLogger("app.hygiene")
MAX_SCAN_IMAGE_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_PHOTOS_PER_INSPECTION = 8
MAX_FINDINGS = 80


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- capabilities
def capabilities(settings: Settings) -> HygieneCapabilities:
    return HygieneCapabilities(
        vision=food_service.vision_capability(settings),
        location_types=[Choice(value=k.value, label=v) for k, v in rules.LOCATION_TYPE_LABELS.items()],
        statuses=[Choice(value=k.value, label=v) for k, v in rules.STATUS_LABELS.items()],
        default_checklist=[ChecklistItem(**item) for item in rules.DEFAULT_CHECKLIST],
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def _invalid(message: str, code: str = "invalid_input") -> AppError:
    return AppError(message, code=code, status_code=422)


def _get_or_404(
    db: Session, user: User, inspection_id: uuid.UUID
) -> tuple[HygieneInspection, AnalysisRecord]:
    found = repo.get_owned(db, inspection_id, user.id)
    if found is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Inspection not found.", code="hygiene_inspection_not_found")
    return found


def _verify_media(db: Session, user: User, ids: list[uuid.UUID]) -> list[uuid.UUID]:
    """Every photo must belong to the user and be an image. Order preserved."""
    seen: list[uuid.UUID] = []
    for mid in ids:
        asset = media_service.get_owned_or_404(db, user, mid)  # 404 for missing/foreign
        if asset.kind != MediaKind.IMAGE:
            raise _invalid("Only images can be attached to an inspection.", "invalid_item")
        if mid not in seen:
            seen.append(mid)
    return seen


def _read_photo(storage: Any, key: str) -> bytes:
    try:
        handle = storage.open(key)
    except Exception:
        raise AppError(
            "A stored photo is unavailable.", code="media_not_found", status_code=404
        ) from None
    with handle:
        data = handle.read(MAX_SCAN_IMAGE_BYTES + 1)
    if len(data) > MAX_SCAN_IMAGE_BYTES:
        raise _invalid("A photo is too large to analyse.", "invalid_item")
    return data


def _finding_out(f: FindingInput, source: str) -> FindingOut:
    return FindingOut(
        finding_id=f.finding_id or uuid.uuid4(),
        source=source,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        category=f.category,
        category_label=category_label(f.category),
        severity=f.severity,
        severity_label=rules.SEVERITY_LABELS[f.severity],
        description=f.description,
        location=f.location,
        certainty=f.certainty,
        certainty_label=rules.CERTAINTY_LABELS[f.certainty],
        evidence_media_id=f.evidence_media_id,
        evidence_description=f.evidence_description,
        user_note=f.user_note,
        suggested_action=rules.CATEGORY_ACTIONS[f.category],
    )


def _build_findings(
    inputs: list[FindingInput], *, existing_by_id: dict[uuid.UUID, FindingOut]
) -> list[FindingOut]:
    """Preserve `model` provenance only when nothing about the finding changed.

    A finding that already exists (by `finding_id`) keeps `model` provenance when untouched;
    otherwise it becomes `user_edited`. New findings (no `finding_id`) are always `user` —
    clients cannot self-declare a finding as `model`; only the analysis path creates those.
    """
    out: list[FindingOut] = []
    for f in inputs:
        if f.finding_id and f.finding_id in existing_by_id:
            prev = existing_by_id[f.finding_id]
            unchanged = (
                prev.category == f.category
                and prev.severity == f.severity
                and prev.description == f.description
                and prev.location == f.location
                and prev.certainty == f.certainty
                and prev.evidence_media_id == f.evidence_media_id
                and prev.evidence_description == f.evidence_description
                and prev.user_note == f.user_note
            )
            source = "model" if prev.source == "model" and unchanged else "user_edited"
        else:
            source = "user"
        out.append(_finding_out(f, source))
    return out


def _checklist_or_default(items: list[ChecklistItem] | None) -> list[ChecklistItem]:
    if items is None:
        return [ChecklistItem(**d) for d in rules.DEFAULT_CHECKLIST]
    return items


def _summary_counts(findings: list[FindingOut]) -> tuple[int, str | None]:
    if not findings:
        return 0, None
    return len(findings), rules.highest_severity([f.severity.value for f in findings])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- create / update
def create_inspection(
    db: Session, user: User, data: InspectionCreate
) -> InspectionDetail:
    if len(data.media_ids) > MAX_PHOTOS_PER_INSPECTION:
        raise _invalid(
            f"An inspection can include at most {MAX_PHOTOS_PER_INSPECTION} photos.",
            "too_many_photos",
        )
    media_ids = _verify_media(db, user, data.media_ids)
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    loc = data.location_type
    findings: list[FindingOut] = []
    checklist = _checklist_or_default(None)
    audit = HygieneAudit(
        location=LocationOut(
            name=data.location_name,
            type=loc.value,
            type_label=rules.LOCATION_TYPE_LABELS[loc],
            area=data.area,
        ),
        checklist=checklist,
        findings=findings,
        notes=data.notes,
        disclosures=list(rules.DISCLOSURES),
        not_assessable=list(rules.NOT_ASSESSABLE),
        generated_at=now,
    )
    audit_dict = audit.model_dump(mode="json")
    audit_dict["media_ids"] = [str(m) for m in media_ids]
    record = AnalysisRecord(
        owner_id=user.id,
        module=ModuleKey.HYGIENE,
        status=AnalysisStatus.COMPLETED,
        title=f"Hygiene inspection: {data.location_name}"[:200],
        summary="Draft",
        result=audit_dict,
    )
    db.add(record)
    db.flush()
    row = HygieneInspection(
        analysis_id=record.id,
        owner_id=user.id,
        location_name=data.location_name,
        location_type=loc.value,
        area=data.area,
        status=rules.InspectionStatus.DRAFT.value,
        finding_count=0,
        highest_severity=None,
        photo_count=len(media_ids),
        revision=1,
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    db.refresh(row)
    logger.info("hygiene_inspection_created user_id=%s id=%s", user.id, record.id)
    return _detail(row, record)


def update_inspection(
    db: Session,
    user: User,
    inspection_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: InspectionUpdate,
) -> InspectionDetail:
    row, record = _get_or_404(db, user, inspection_id)
    if row.status == rules.InspectionStatus.APPROVED.value:
        raise ConflictError("Approved inspections are read-only.", code="inspection_locked")
    if row.status == rules.InspectionStatus.IN_REVIEW.value and data.findings is not None:
        raise ConflictError(
            "Cannot edit findings while the inspection is in review.",
            code="inspection_in_review",
        )
    if data.expected_revision is not None and data.expected_revision != row.revision:
        raise ConflictError(
            "This inspection was changed somewhere else. Reload it and try again.",
            code="inspection_revision_conflict",
        )

    audit = dict(record.result or {})
    if data.media_ids is not None:
        media_ids = _verify_media(db, user, data.media_ids)
        audit["media_ids"] = [str(m) for m in media_ids]
        row.photo_count = len(media_ids)

    if (
        data.location_name is not None
        or data.location_type is not None
        or data.area is not None
    ):
        loc_name = data.location_name if data.location_name is not None else row.location_name
        loc_type = (
            data.location_type.value if data.location_type is not None else row.location_type
        )
        area = data.area if data.area is not None else row.area
        lt = rules.LocationType(loc_type)
        audit["location"] = {
            "name": loc_name,
            "type": lt.value,
            "type_label": rules.LOCATION_TYPE_LABELS[lt],
            "area": area,
        }
        row.location_name = loc_name
        row.location_type = lt.value
        row.area = area

    if data.notes is not None:
        audit["notes"] = data.notes or None

    if data.checklist is not None:
        audit["checklist"] = [c.model_dump() for c in data.checklist]

    if data.findings is not None:
        existing_by_id: dict[uuid.UUID, FindingOut] = {}
        for f in audit.get("findings", []):
            try:
                existing_by_id[uuid.UUID(f["finding_id"])] = FindingOut.model_validate(f)
            except (KeyError, ValueError):
                continue
        new_findings = _build_findings(data.findings, existing_by_id=existing_by_id)
        audit["findings"] = [f.model_dump(mode="json") for f in new_findings]
        row.finding_count, row.highest_severity = _summary_counts(new_findings)

    audit["generated_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    record.result = audit
    row.revision += 1
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    db.refresh(row)
    logger.info(
        "hygiene_inspection_updated user_id=%s id=%s revision=%d",
        user.id, inspection_id, row.revision,
    )
    return _detail(row, record)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- AI analysis
def analyze_inspection(
    db: Session,
    storage: Any,
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    inspection_id: uuid.UUID,
    make_provider: Any,
) -> InspectionDetail:
    row, record = _get_or_404(db, user, inspection_id)
    if row.status == rules.InspectionStatus.APPROVED.value:
        raise ConflictError("Approved inspections are read-only.", code="inspection_locked")

    audit = dict(record.result or {})
    media_ids = [uuid.UUID(str(m)) for m in audit.get("media_ids", [])]
    if not media_ids:
        raise _invalid("Add at least one photo before running the analysis.", "no_photos")

    limiter("photo analysis", settings.scan_rate_limit_per_minute).check(str(user.id))
    provider: VisionProvider = make_provider()
    prompt = build_hygiene_prompt(
        rules.LOCATION_TYPE_LABELS.get(
            rules.LocationType(row.location_type), "kitchen"
        ),
        row.area,
    )

    new_findings: list[FindingOut] = []
    all_limitations: list[str] = []
    model_notes_parts: list[str] = []
    total_withheld = 0
    now = datetime.now(UTC)

    for mid in media_ids:
        asset = media_service.get_owned_or_404(db, user, mid)
        if asset.kind != MediaKind.IMAGE:
            raise _invalid("Every photo must be an image.", "invalid_item")
        image = _read_photo(storage, asset.storage_key)
        logger.info(
            "hygiene_analysis_photo user_id=%s id=%s media_id=%s model=%s",
            user.id, inspection_id, mid, provider.info.model,
        )
        raw = provider.complete_json(image, prompt, HYGIENE_JSON_SCHEMA)
        output: HygieneModelOutput = parse_hygiene_output(raw)
        total_withheld += output.withheld_text_count
        for f in output.findings:
            cat = rules.FindingCategory(f.category)
            sev = rules.Severity(f.severity)
            cert = rules.Certainty(f.certainty)
            new_findings.append(
                FindingOut(
                    finding_id=uuid.uuid4(),
                    source="model",
                    category=cat,
                    category_label=category_label(cat),
                    severity=sev,
                    severity_label=rules.SEVERITY_LABELS[sev],
                    description=f.description,
                    location=f.location,
                    certainty=cert,
                    certainty_label=rules.CERTAINTY_LABELS[cert],
                    evidence_media_id=mid,
                    evidence_description=None,
                    user_note=None,
                    suggested_action=rules.CATEGORY_ACTIONS[cat],
                )
            )
        all_limitations.extend(output.limitations)
        if output.notes:
            model_notes_parts.append(output.notes)

    # Preserve existing user-added findings; model findings are replaced by the fresh analysis.
    existing = audit.get("findings", [])
    preserved = [
        FindingOut.model_validate(f)
        for f in existing
        if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("source") == "user"
    ]
    final_findings = preserved + new_findings
    if len(final_findings) > MAX_FINDINGS:
        final_findings = final_findings[:MAX_FINDINGS]

    audit["findings"] = [f.model_dump(mode="json") for f in final_findings]
    audit["model_limitations"] = all_limitations[:12]
    audit["model_notes"] = (" ".join(model_notes_parts)[:500]) or None
    audit["withheld_text_count"] = total_withheld
    audit["provider"] = provider.info.model_dump()
    audit["analyzed_at"] = now.isoformat()
    audit["generated_at"] = now.isoformat()
    record.result = audit
    row.finding_count, row.highest_severity = _summary_counts(final_findings)
    row.revision += 1
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    db.refresh(row)
    logger.info(
        "hygiene_analysis_done user_id=%s id=%s photos=%d findings=%d",
        user.id, inspection_id, len(media_ids), len(new_findings),
    )
    return _detail(row, record)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- status flow
def submit_inspection(db: Session, user: User, inspection_id: uuid.UUID) -> InspectionDetail:
    row, record = _get_or_404(db, user, inspection_id)
    if row.status not in (
        rules.InspectionStatus.DRAFT.value,
        rules.InspectionStatus.REJECTED.value,
    ):
        raise ConflictError(
            "Only a draft or rejected inspection can be submitted.", code="invalid_status"
        )
    if row.photo_count == 0:
        raise _invalid("Add at least one photo before submitting.", "no_photos")
    row.status = rules.InspectionStatus.IN_REVIEW.value
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    db.refresh(row)
    return _detail(row, record)


def approve_inspection(
    db: Session, user: User, inspection_id: uuid.UUID, data: StatusChange
) -> InspectionDetail:
    row, record = _get_or_404(db, user, inspection_id)
    if row.status != rules.InspectionStatus.IN_REVIEW.value:
        raise ConflictError(
            "Only an inspection in review can be approved.", code="invalid_status"
        )
    row.status = rules.InspectionStatus.APPROVED.value
    row.reviewed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    if data.review_notes is not None:
        row.review_notes = data.review_notes
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    db.refresh(row)
    return _detail(row, record)


def reject_inspection(
    db: Session, user: User, inspection_id: uuid.UUID, data: StatusChange
) -> InspectionDetail:
    row, record = _get_or_404(db, user, inspection_id)
    if row.status != rules.InspectionStatus.IN_REVIEW.value:
        raise ConflictError(
            "Only an inspection in review can be rejected.", code="invalid_status"
        )
    if not data.review_notes:
        raise _invalid(
            "Rejecting requires review notes explaining what needs to change.",
            "review_notes_required",
        )
    row.status = rules.InspectionStatus.REJECTED.value
    row.review_notes = data.review_notes
    row.reviewed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    db.refresh(row)
    return _detail(row, record)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- reads
def _summary(row: HygieneInspection, record: AnalysisRecord) -> InspectionSummary:
    try:
        lt = rules.LocationType(row.location_type)
    except ValueError:
        lt = rules.LocationType.OTHER
    try:
        st = rules.InspectionStatus(row.status)
    except ValueError:
        st = rules.InspectionStatus.DRAFT
    return InspectionSummary(
        id=row.analysis_id,
        location_name=row.location_name,
        location_type=lt.value,
        location_type_label=rules.LOCATION_TYPE_LABELS[lt],
        area=row.area,
        status=st,
        status_label=rules.STATUS_LABELS[st],
        finding_count=row.finding_count,
        highest_severity=row.highest_severity,
        photo_count=row.photo_count,
        revision=row.revision,
        reviewed_at=row.reviewed_at,
        created_at=row.created_at,
        updated_at=row.updated_at,
    )


def _detail(row: HygieneInspection, record: AnalysisRecord) -> InspectionDetail:
    audit_dict = record.result or {}
    media_ids = []
    for m in audit_dict.get("media_ids", []):
        try:
            media_ids.append(uuid.UUID(str(m)))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            continue
    findings_out: list[FindingOut] = []
    for f in audit_dict.get("findings", []):
        try:
            findings_out.append(FindingOut.model_validate(f))
        except Exception:
            continue
    audit_dict = {
        **audit_dict,
        "findings": [f.model_dump(mode="json") for f in findings_out],
        "disclosures": list(rules.DISCLOSURES),
        "not_assessable": list(rules.NOT_ASSESSABLE),
    }
    audit = HygieneAudit.model_validate(audit_dict)
    return InspectionDetail(
        **_summary(row, record).model_dump(),
        media_ids=media_ids,
        notes=(record.result or {}).get("notes"),
        review_notes=row.review_notes,
        result=audit,
    )


def get_inspection(db: Session, user: User, inspection_id: uuid.UUID) -> InspectionDetail:
    return _detail(*_get_or_404(db, user, inspection_id))


def list_inspections(
    db: Session,
    user: User,
    *,
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
    status: rules.InspectionStatus | None,
    location_type: rules.LocationType | None,
) -> Page[InspectionSummary]:
    rows, total = repo.list_page(
        db,
        user.id,
        limit=page_size,
        offset=(page - 1) * page_size,
        status=status.value if status else None,
        location_type=location_type.value if location_type else None,
    )
    return Page.build([_summary(h, r) for h, r in rows], total, page, page_size)


def delete_inspection(db: Session, user: User, inspection_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    _, record = _get_or_404(db, user, inspection_id)
    db.delete(record)
    db.commit()
    logger.info("hygiene_inspection_deleted user_id=%s id=%s", user.id, inspection_id)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- report
def _esc(value: str | None) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return (
        str(value)
        .replace("&", "&amp;")
        .replace("<", "&lt;")
        .replace(">", "&gt;")
        .replace('"', "&quot;")
        .replace("'", "&#39;")
    )


def render_report_html(db: Session, user: User, inspection_id: uuid.UUID) -> str:
    """A self-contained HTML report. Print-to-PDF friendly. No external assets."""
    row, record = _get_or_404(db, user, inspection_id)
    d = _detail(row, record)
    checklist_rows = "".join(
        f"<tr><td>{'✔' if c.checked else '✗'}</td><td>{_esc(c.label)}</td>"
        f"<td>{_esc(c.note or '')}</td></tr>"
        for c in d.result.checklist
    ) or "<tr><td colspan='3'>No checklist recorded.</td></tr>"
    findings_rows = "".join(
        f"<tr>"
        f"<td>{_esc(f.category_label)}</td>"
        f"<td class='sev-{f.severity.value}'>{_esc(f.severity_label)}</td>"
        f"<td><strong>{_esc(f.description)}</strong>"
        + (f"<br/><span class='muted'>{_esc(f.location)}</span>" if f.location else "")
        + (
            f"<br/><span class='muted'>Evidence: {_esc(f.evidence_description)}</span>"
            if f.evidence_description
            else ""
        )
        + (
            f"<br/><span class='muted'>User note: {_esc(f.user_note)}</span>"
            if f.user_note
            else ""
        )
        + f"<br/><span class='source'>{_esc(f.source)}</span></td>"
        f"<td>{_esc(f.suggested_action)}</td>"
        f"</tr>"
        for f in d.result.findings
    ) or "<tr><td colspan='4'>No findings recorded.</td></tr>"
    disclosures = "".join(f"<li>{_esc(x)}</li>" for x in d.result.disclosures)
    not_assessable = "".join(f"<li>{_esc(x)}</li>" for x in d.result.not_assessable)
    generated = (
        d.result.generated_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC")
        if d.result.generated_at
        else ""
    )
    reviewed = d.reviewed_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC") if d.reviewed_at else "—"
    review_notes_html = (
        f"<p><strong>Review notes:</strong> {_esc(d.review_notes)}</p>"
        if d.review_notes
        else ""
    )
    return f"""<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/>
<title>Hygiene inspection — {_esc(d.location_name)}</title>
<style>
  :root {{ color-scheme: light; }}
  body {{ font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; color: #17261d;
         background: #fff; max-width: 900px; margin: 2rem auto; padding: 0 1rem; line-height: 1.5; }}
  h1, h2 {{ font-family: Georgia, serif; }}
  h1 {{ font-size: 1.6rem; margin: 0 0 .5rem; }}
  h2 {{ font-size: 1.1rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 .5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d4c3; padding-bottom: .3rem; }}
  .meta {{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: .25rem 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }}
  .meta dt {{ font-weight: 600; color: #526158; font-size: .9rem; }}
  .meta dd {{ margin: 0 0 .4rem; }}
  table {{ width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: .5rem 0; }}
  th, td {{ text-align: left; padding: .5rem .6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d4c3; vertical-align: top; }}
  th {{ background: #f6f3ea; font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; }}
  .sev-low {{ color: #1d6b43; }} .sev-medium {{ color: #b06a10; }} .sev-high {{ color: #a3261c; font-weight: 700; }}
  .source {{ font-size: .8rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #526158; }}
  .muted {{ color: #526158; font-size: .9rem; }}
  .disclosure {{ background: #fcebcf; padding: .75rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; margin: 1rem 0; }}
  .footer {{ margin-top: 2rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #d9d4c3; font-size: .85rem; color: #526158; }}
  @media print {{ body {{ margin: 0; }} }}
</style></head>
<body>
<h1>Hygiene inspection report</h1>
<p><strong>{_esc(d.location_name)}</strong>{(' — ' + _esc(d.area)) if d.area else ''}
   <span class="muted">({_esc(d.location_type_label)})</span></p>
<dl class="meta">
  <dt>Status</dt><dd>{_esc(d.status_label)}</dd>
  <dt>Photos</dt><dd>{d.photo_count}</dd>
  <dt>Findings</dt><dd>{d.finding_count}{f' — highest severity: {_esc(d.highest_severity)}' if d.highest_severity else ''}</dd>
  <dt>Reviewed</dt><dd>{_esc(reviewed)}</dd>
  <dt>Generated</dt><dd>{_esc(generated)}</dd>
</dl>
{review_notes_html}
<h2>Checklist (self-reported)</h2>
<table><thead><tr><th></th><th>Item</th><th>Note</th></tr></thead><tbody>{checklist_rows}</tbody></table>
<h2>Findings</h2>
<table><thead><tr><th>Category</th><th>Severity</th><th>Description &amp; evidence</th><th>Suggested action</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>{findings_rows}</tbody></table>
<div class="disclosure"><strong>What this report cannot establish</strong><ul>{disclosures}</ul>
<strong>Not assessable from photos</strong><ul>{not_assessable}</ul></div>
<div class="footer">
  This report describes only visible conditions in the supplied photos. It is not an official
  inspection, and it does not verify compliance with any law, regulation, or food-safety standard.
  Reviewed by the account owner; the app does not perform face recognition or staff surveillance.
</div>
</body></html>"""

"""Saved meals. A meal is an AnalysisRecord (full audit JSON) plus a MealLog row (queryable
facts). Totals are always recomputed server-side from the confirmed items; the client never
supplies a number that is stored."""

import logging
import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import Settings
from app.core.errors import AppError, ConflictError, NotFoundError
from app.models import (
    AnalysisRecord,
    AnalysisStatus,
    MealCategory,
    MealLog,
    MediaKind,
    ModuleKey,
    User,
)
from app.repositories import meals as meal_repo
from app.schemas.common import Page
from app.schemas.food import MealAudit
from app.schemas.meal import BriefTotal, MealDetail, MealSummary, MealWrite
from app.services import food_service, media_service

logger = logging.getLogger("app.meals")


def _get_or_404(db: Session, user: User, meal_id: uuid.UUID) -> tuple[MealLog, AnalysisRecord]:
    found = meal_repo.get_owned(db, meal_id, user.id)
    if found is None:  # same answer for "missing" and "someone else's"
        raise NotFoundError("Meal not found.", code="meal_not_found")
    return found


def load_audit(db: Session, user: User, meal_id: uuid.UUID) -> MealAudit:
    _, record = _get_or_404(db, user, meal_id)
    return MealAudit.model_validate(record.result)


def _brief(totals: dict[str, Any]) -> BriefTotal:
    energy = totals.get("energy_kcal") or {}
    return BriefTotal(
        low=energy.get("low"), high=energy.get("high"), complete=bool(energy.get("complete", False))
    )


def _summary(meal: MealLog, record: AnalysisRecord) -> MealSummary:
    return MealSummary(
        id=meal.analysis_id,
        title=record.title,
        items_label=meal.items_label,
        category=meal.category,
        eaten_at=meal.eaten_at,
        item_count=meal.item_count,
        calories=_brief(meal.totals),
        media_id=record.media_id,
        revision=meal.revision,
        created_at=record.created_at,
        updated_at=meal.updated_at,
    )


def _detail(meal: MealLog, record: AnalysisRecord) -> MealDetail:
    return MealDetail(
        **_summary(meal, record).model_dump(),
        notes=meal.notes,
        result=MealAudit.model_validate(record.result),
    )


def _summary_text(audit: MealAudit) -> str:
    energy = audit.totals["energy_kcal"]
    n = len(audit.items)
    items = f"{n} item{'s' if n != 1 else ''}"
    if energy.low is None or energy.high is None:
        return f"{items} · calories unavailable"
    if energy.low == energy.high:
        kcal = f"{energy.low:g} kcal"
    else:
        kcal = f"{energy.low:g}–{energy.high:g} kcal"
    return f"{items} · {kcal}" + ("" if energy.complete else " (incomplete)")


def _prepare(
    db: Session,
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    data: MealWrite,
    existing: MealAudit | None,
) -> tuple[MealAudit, uuid.UUID | None]:
    audit = food_service.calculate_audit(
        settings, user, data.items, scan_ref=data.scan_ref, existing=existing
    )
    media_id = data.media_id
    if media_id is None and audit.model_observations is not None:
        media_id = audit.model_observations.media_id
    if media_id is not None:
        asset = media_service.get_owned_or_404(db, user, media_id)  # must be the user's own
        if asset.kind != MediaKind.IMAGE:
            raise AppError(
                "Only an image can be attached to a meal.", code="invalid_item", status_code=422
            )
    return audit, media_id


def _labels(audit: MealAudit, category: MealCategory) -> tuple[str, str]:
    label = ", ".join(i.name for i in audit.items)
    if len(label) > 200:
        label = label[:197] + "…"
    return label, f"{category.value.capitalize()}: {label}"[:200]


def create_meal(db: Session, settings: Settings, user: User, data: MealWrite) -> MealDetail:
    audit, media_id = _prepare(db, settings, user, data, existing=None)
    items_label, title = _labels(audit, data.category)
    record = AnalysisRecord(
        owner_id=user.id,
        module=ModuleKey.FOOD_RECOGNITION,
        status=AnalysisStatus.COMPLETED,
        title=title,
        summary=_summary_text(audit),
        result=food_service.audit_json(audit),
        media_id=media_id,
    )
    db.add(record)
    db.flush()
    meal = MealLog(
        analysis_id=record.id,
        owner_id=user.id,
        eaten_at=data.eaten_at,
        category=data.category,
        notes=data.notes,
        totals={k: v.model_dump(mode="json") for k, v in audit.totals.items()},
        item_count=len(audit.items),
        revision=1,
        items_label=items_label,
    )
    db.add(meal)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    db.refresh(meal)
    logger.info("meal_created user_id=%s meal_id=%s items=%d", user.id, record.id, len(audit.items))
    return _detail(meal, record)


def update_meal(
    db: Session, settings: Settings, user: User, meal_id: uuid.UUID, data: MealWrite
) -> MealDetail:
    meal, record = _get_or_404(db, user, meal_id)
    if data.expected_revision is not None and data.expected_revision != meal.revision:
        raise ConflictError(
            "This meal was changed somewhere else. Reload it and try again.",
            code="meal_revision_conflict",
        )
    existing = MealAudit.model_validate(record.result)
    audit, media_id = _prepare(db, settings, user, data, existing=existing)
    items_label, title = _labels(audit, data.category)

    record.title = title
    record.summary = _summary_text(audit)
    record.result = food_service.audit_json(audit)
    record.media_id = media_id
    meal.eaten_at = data.eaten_at
    meal.category = data.category
    meal.notes = data.notes
    meal.totals = {k: v.model_dump(mode="json") for k, v in audit.totals.items()}
    meal.item_count = len(audit.items)
    meal.items_label = items_label
    meal.revision += 1
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    db.refresh(meal)
    logger.info("meal_updated user_id=%s meal_id=%s revision=%d", user.id, meal_id, meal.revision)
    return _detail(meal, record)


def get_meal(db: Session, user: User, meal_id: uuid.UUID) -> MealDetail:
    meal, record = _get_or_404(db, user, meal_id)
    return _detail(meal, record)


def delete_meal(db: Session, user: User, meal_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    _, record = _get_or_404(db, user, meal_id)
    db.delete(record)  # meal_logs row goes with it (ON DELETE CASCADE)
    db.commit()
    logger.info("meal_deleted user_id=%s meal_id=%s", user.id, meal_id)


def list_meals(
    db: Session,
    user: User,
    *,
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
    category: MealCategory | None,
    date_from: datetime | None,
    date_to: datetime | None,
) -> Page[MealSummary]:
    if date_from and date_to and date_from >= date_to:
        raise AppError("date_from must be before date_to.", code="invalid_range", status_code=422)
    rows, total = meal_repo.list_page(
        db,
        user.id,
        limit=page_size,
        offset=(page - 1) * page_size,
        category=category,
        date_from=date_from,
        date_to=date_to,
    )
    return Page.build([_summary(m, r) for m, r in rows], total, page, page_size)

FILE: backend/app/services/media_service.py

"""Upload, read and delete media. Every function that touches an existing asset goes through
`get_owned_or_404`, so there is no code path that reads or deletes another user's file."""

import logging
import uuid
from collections.abc import Iterator
from hashlib import sha256
from typing import BinaryIO

from fastapi import UploadFile
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import Settings
from app.core.errors import AppError, NotFoundError, PayloadTooLargeError
from app.media.storage import StorageBackend, StorageError, iter_chunks
from app.media.validation import sanitize_display_name, validate_and_process
from app.models import MediaAsset, User
from app.repositories import media as media_repo

logger = logging.getLogger("app.media")
_READ_CHUNK = 64 * 1024


def read_upload(file: UploadFile, max_bytes: int) -> bytes:
    """Read at most max_bytes (+1 to detect overflow) so a huge file never fills memory."""
    chunks: list[bytes] = []
    total = 0
    while chunk := file.file.read(_READ_CHUNK):
        total += len(chunk)
        if total > max_bytes:
            raise PayloadTooLargeError(
                f"File is too large. The maximum size is {max_bytes // (1024 * 1024)} MB."
                if max_bytes >= 1024 * 1024
                else f"File is too large. The maximum size is {max_bytes} bytes."
            )
        chunks.append(chunk)
    return b"".join(chunks)


def get_owned_or_404(db: Session, user: User, media_id: uuid.UUID) -> MediaAsset:
    asset = media_repo.get_owned(db, media_id, user.id)
    if asset is None:  # same response whether it is missing or belongs to someone else
        raise NotFoundError("Media not found.", code="media_not_found")
    return asset


def upload(
    db: Session, storage: StorageBackend, settings: Settings, user: User, file: UploadFile
) -> MediaAsset:
    raw = read_upload(file, settings.max_upload_bytes)
    processed = validate_and_process(
        raw, file.filename, file.content_type, settings.max_image_pixels
    )

    count, used = media_repo.usage(db, user.id)
    if used + len(processed.data) > settings.user_media_quota_bytes:
        raise AppError(
            "Your media storage quota is full. Delete some files and try again.",
            code="quota_exceeded",
            status_code=413,
        )

    asset_id = uuid.uuid4()
    key = f"{asset_id.hex[:2]}/{asset_id.hex}.{processed.extension}"
    asset = MediaAsset(
        id=asset_id,
        owner_id=user.id,
        kind=processed.kind,
        content_type=processed.content_type,
        display_name=sanitize_display_name(file.filename),
        storage_key=key,
        size_bytes=len(processed.data),
        sha256=sha256(processed.data).hexdigest(),
        width=processed.width,
        height=processed.height,
        duration_seconds=processed.duration_seconds,
    )
    storage.put(key, processed.data)
    try:
        media_repo.add(db, asset)
        db.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        storage.delete(key)  # never leave an unreferenced file behind
        raise
    db.refresh(asset)
    logger.info(
        "media_uploaded user_id=%s media_id=%s bytes=%s", user.id, asset.id, asset.size_bytes
    )
    return asset


def open_content(
    db: Session, storage: StorageBackend, user: User, media_id: uuid.UUID
) -> tuple[MediaAsset, Iterator[bytes]]:
    asset = get_owned_or_404(db, user, media_id)
    try:
        handle: BinaryIO = storage.open(asset.storage_key)
    except StorageError:
        logger.error("media_content_missing media_id=%s", asset.id)
        raise NotFoundError("Media content is unavailable.", code="media_not_found") from None
    return asset, iter_chunks(handle)


def delete(db: Session, storage: StorageBackend, user: User, media_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    asset = get_owned_or_404(db, user, media_id)
    key = asset.storage_key
    db.delete(asset)
    db.commit()
    try:
        storage.delete(key)
    except (OSError, StorageError):
        logger.error("media_file_delete_failed media_id=%s", media_id)  # row is gone; file orphaned

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import User, UserPreferences
from app.repositories import users as user_repo
from app.schemas.user import PreferencesUpdate


def get_preferences(db: Session, user: User) -> UserPreferences:
    prefs = user_repo.get_preferences(db, user.id)
    if prefs is None:  # defensive: every user is created with a row
        prefs = UserPreferences(user_id=user.id)
        db.add(prefs)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(prefs)
    return prefs


def update_preferences(db: Session, user: User, data: PreferencesUpdate) -> UserPreferences:
    prefs = get_preferences(db, user)
    prefs.unit_system = data.unit_system
    prefs.dietary_preferences = list(data.dietary_preferences)
    prefs.allergies = list(data.allergies)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(prefs)
    return prefs

"""Recipe persistence, scaling, editing and verified-nutrition linking.

Nothing here trusts a client with numbers or with a model's claims:
  * totals are computed by `app.domain.nutrition_calc` from signed `food_ref`s;
  * every write re-runs the deterministic allergen/diet gate.
"""

import logging
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.ai.cooking import RecipeDraft
from app.ai.text import TextProviderInfo
from app.core.config import Settings
from app.core.errors import AppError, ConflictError, NotFoundError
from app.core.signed_refs import InvalidRefError, verify_ref
from app.domain import nutrition_calc as calc  # noqa: F401  (kept for type parity with food_service)
from app.domain.recipes import (
    RecipeError,
    allergy_disclosure,
    divide_totals,
    enforce,
    scale_recipe,
)
from app.models import AnalysisRecord, AnalysisStatus, ModuleKey, User
from app.models.cooking import Recipe, RecipeStatus
from app.repositories import recipes as repo
from app.schemas.common import Page
from app.schemas.cooking import (
    AttachNutritionRequest,
    Ingredient,
    NutritionAttachment,
    RecipeRead,
    RecipeSummary,
    RecipeWrite,
    Step,
    Substitution,
)
from app.schemas.food import (
    CalculationOut,
    FoodItemInput,
    FoodSnapshot,
)
from app.services import food_service
from app.services.preferences_service import get_preferences

logger = logging.getLogger("app.cooking")


class DietaryConflictError(AppError):
    status_code = 422
    code = "dietary_conflict"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- row <-> draft
def draft_to_row_values(draft: RecipeDraft) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "title": draft.title,
        "description": draft.description,
        "servings": draft.servings,
        "prep_minutes": draft.prep_minutes,
        "cook_minutes": draft.cook_minutes,
        "equipment": list(draft.equipment),
        "ingredients": [i.model_dump() for i in draft.ingredients],
        "steps": [
            {
                "number": n,
                "instruction": s.instruction,
                "duration_minutes": s.duration_minutes,
            }
            for n, s in enumerate(draft.steps, start=1)
        ],
        "substitutions": [s.model_dump() for s in draft.substitutions],
        "dietary_tags": list(draft.dietary_tags),
        "allergen_warnings": list(draft.allergen_warnings),
        "safety_notes": list(draft.safety_notes),
        "tips": list(draft.tips),
        "beginner_notes": list(draft.beginner_notes),
    }


def draft_from_row(recipe: Recipe) -> RecipeDraft:
    return RecipeDraft(
        title=recipe.title,
        description=recipe.description,
        servings=recipe.servings,
        prep_minutes=recipe.prep_minutes,
        cook_minutes=recipe.cook_minutes,
        equipment=list(recipe.equipment or []),
        ingredients=list(recipe.ingredients or []),
        steps=[
            {
                "instruction": s.get("instruction", ""),
                "duration_minutes": s.get("duration_minutes"),
            }
            for s in (recipe.steps or [])
        ],
        substitutions=list(recipe.substitutions or []),
        dietary_tags=list(recipe.dietary_tags or []),
        allergen_warnings=list(recipe.allergen_warnings or []),
        safety_notes=list(recipe.safety_notes or []),
        beginner_notes=list(recipe.beginner_notes or []),
        tips=list(recipe.tips or []),
    )


def to_read(recipe: Recipe, draft: RecipeDraft | None = None) -> RecipeRead:
    d = draft or draft_from_row(recipe)
    provider = (
        TextProviderInfo.model_validate(recipe.provider) if recipe.provider else None
    )
    nutrition = (
        NutritionAttachment.model_validate(recipe.nutrition) if recipe.nutrition else None
    )
    return RecipeRead(
        id=recipe.id,
        title=d.title,
        description=d.description,
        servings=d.servings,
        prep_minutes=d.prep_minutes,
        cook_minutes=d.cook_minutes,
        total_minutes=d.total_minutes,
        equipment=list(d.equipment),
        ingredients=[Ingredient(**i.model_dump()) for i in d.ingredients],
        steps=[
            Step(number=n, instruction=s.instruction, duration_minutes=s.duration_minutes)
            for n, s in enumerate(d.steps, start=1)
        ],
        substitutions=[Substitution(**s.model_dump()) for s in d.substitutions],
        dietary_tags=list(d.dietary_tags),
        allergen_warnings=list(d.allergen_warnings),
        safety_notes=list(d.safety_notes),
        beginner_notes=list(d.beginner_notes),
        tips=list(d.tips),
        status=recipe.status.value,
        favorite=recipe.favorite,
        revision=recipe.revision,
        provider=provider,
        nutrition=nutrition,
        generated_at=recipe.generated_at,
        created_at=recipe.created_at,
        updated_at=recipe.updated_at,
    )


def summary(recipe: Recipe) -> RecipeSummary:
    total = None
    if recipe.prep_minutes is not None or recipe.cook_minutes is not None:
        total = (recipe.prep_minutes or 0) + (recipe.cook_minutes or 0)
    return RecipeSummary(
        id=recipe.id,
        title=recipe.title,
        servings=recipe.servings,
        total_minutes=total,
        status=recipe.status.value,
        favorite=recipe.favorite,
        dietary_tags=list(recipe.dietary_tags or []),
        ingredient_count=len(recipe.ingredients or []),
        updated_at=recipe.updated_at,
    )


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- gate
def get_owned_or_404(db: Session, user: User, recipe_id: uuid.UUID) -> Recipe:
    recipe = repo.get_owned(db, recipe_id, user.id)
    if recipe is None:  # identical answer for "missing" and "someone else's"
        raise NotFoundError("Recipe not found.", code="recipe_not_found")
    return recipe


def assert_allowed(draft: RecipeDraft, allergies: list[str], diets: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    conflicts = enforce(draft, allergies, diets)
    if conflicts:
        raise DietaryConflictError(
            "That recipe conflicts with your declared allergies or diet, so it was not kept.",
            details=[{"field": "ingredients", "message": c.message} for c in conflicts],
        )
    disclosure = allergy_disclosure(draft, allergies)
    return list(disclosure["warnings"])


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
def create_suggested(
    db: Session,
    user: User,
    draft: RecipeDraft,
    *,
    provider: TextProviderInfo | None,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> Recipe:
    """Persist a validated, allowed suggestion. Not listed until the user keeps it."""
    prefs = get_preferences(db, user)
    warnings = assert_allowed(draft, prefs.allergies, prefs.dietary_preferences)
    row = Recipe(
        owner_id=user.id,
        conversation_id=conversation_id,
        status=RecipeStatus.SUGGESTED,
        provider=provider.model_dump() if provider else None,
        generated_at=datetime.now(UTC),
        allergen_warnings=list(draft.allergen_warnings) + warnings,
        **draft_to_row_values(draft),
    )
    return repo.add(db, row)


def _audit_snapshot(recipe: Recipe) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """JSON-safe snapshot of the persisted recipe, for the linked AnalysisRecord."""
    return to_read(recipe).model_dump(mode="json")


def save_recipe(db: Session, user: User, recipe_id: uuid.UUID) -> RecipeRead:
    recipe = get_owned_or_404(db, user, recipe_id)
    if recipe.status is RecipeStatus.SAVED:
        return to_read(recipe)

    prefs = get_preferences(db, user)
    draft = draft_from_row(recipe)
    assert_allowed(draft, prefs.allergies, prefs.dietary_preferences)

    recipe.status = RecipeStatus.SAVED
    recipe.analysis_id = recipe.id
    db.flush()
    db.refresh(recipe)  # so `updated_at` etc. reflect the change before we build the audit

    record = AnalysisRecord(
        id=recipe.id,
        owner_id=user.id,
        module=ModuleKey.COOKING,
        status=AnalysisStatus.COMPLETED,
        title=recipe.title[:200],
        summary=f"{len(draft.ingredients)} ingredients · serves {draft.servings}",
        result={"schema_version": 1, "recipe": _audit_snapshot(recipe)},
    )
    db.add(record)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(recipe)
    logger.info("recipe_saved user_id=%s recipe_id=%s", user.id, recipe.id)
    return to_read(recipe)


def set_favorite(
    db: Session, user: User, recipe_id: uuid.UUID, favorite: bool
) -> RecipeRead:
    recipe = get_owned_or_404(db, user, recipe_id)
    recipe.favorite = favorite
    if favorite:
        recipe.status = RecipeStatus.SAVED  # favouriting keeps it
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(recipe)
    return to_read(recipe)


def update_recipe(
    db: Session, user: User, recipe_id: uuid.UUID, data: RecipeWrite
) -> RecipeRead:
    recipe = get_owned_or_404(db, user, recipe_id)
    if data.expected_revision is not None and data.expected_revision != recipe.revision:
        raise ConflictError(
            "This recipe was changed somewhere else. Reload it and try again.",
            code="recipe_revision_conflict",
        )
    prefs = get_preferences(db, user)
    draft = data.to_draft()
    warnings = assert_allowed(draft, prefs.allergies, prefs.dietary_preferences)

    for field, value in draft_to_row_values(draft).items():
        setattr(recipe, field, value)
    recipe.allergen_warnings = list(draft.allergen_warnings) + warnings
    recipe.revision += 1
    db.flush()
    db.refresh(recipe)

    if recipe.status is RecipeStatus.SAVED:
        record = db.get(AnalysisRecord, recipe.id)
        if record is not None:
            record.title = recipe.title[:200]
            record.result = {"schema_version": 1, "recipe": _audit_snapshot(recipe)}

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(recipe)
    logger.info(
        "recipe_updated user_id=%s recipe_id=%s rev=%s",
        user.id,
        recipe_id,
        recipe.revision,
    )
    return to_read(recipe)


def delete_recipe(db: Session, user: User, recipe_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    recipe = get_owned_or_404(db, user, recipe_id)
    record = db.get(AnalysisRecord, recipe.id) if recipe.analysis_id else None
    db.delete(recipe)
    if record is not None:
        db.delete(record)
    db.commit()
    logger.info("recipe_deleted user_id=%s recipe_id=%s", user.id, recipe_id)


def list_recipes(
    db: Session,
    user: User,
    *,
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
    query: str | None,
    favorite: bool | None,
) -> Page[RecipeSummary]:
    cleaned = " ".join((query or "").split())[:80] or None
    rows, total = repo.list_page(
        db,
        user.id,
        limit=page_size,
        offset=(page - 1) * page_size,
        query=cleaned,
        favorite=favorite,
    )
    return Page.build([summary(r) for r in rows], total, page, page_size)


def scaled(recipe: Recipe, servings: int) -> RecipeRead:
    draft = draft_from_row(recipe)
    try:
        return to_read(recipe, scale_recipe(draft, servings))
    except RecipeError as exc:
        raise AppError(str(exc), code="invalid_servings", status_code=422) from None


def attach_nutrition(
    db: Session,
    settings: Settings,
    user: User,
    recipe_id: uuid.UUID,
    req: AttachNutritionRequest,
) -> RecipeRead:
    recipe = get_owned_or_404(db, user, recipe_id)
    ingredients = list(recipe.ingredients or [])
    items: list[FoodItemInput] = []
    seen: set[int] = set()
    for link in req.links:
        if link.ingredient_index in seen:
            raise AppError(
                "Each ingredient can be linked once.", code="invalid_link", status_code=422
            )
        seen.add(link.ingredient_index)
        if link.ingredient_index >= len(ingredients):
            raise AppError(
                "That ingredient does not exist.", code="invalid_link", status_code=422
            )
        try:
            payload = verify_ref(settings, "food", user.id, link.food_ref)
            FoodSnapshot.model_validate(payload)  # validate shape; service recomputes below
        except (InvalidRefError, ValidationError):
            raise AppError(
                "A nutrition reference is invalid or has expired.",
                code="invalid_reference",
                status_code=422,
            ) from None
        items.append(
            FoodItemInput(
                name=str(ingredients[link.ingredient_index].get("name", "ingredient"))[:80],
                food_ref=link.food_ref,
                portion={"kind": "weight", "amount": link.grams, "unit": "g"},
            )
        )

    audit = food_service.calculate_audit(
        settings, user, items, scan_ref=None, existing=None
    )
    whole = CalculationOut.model_validate(
        audit.model_dump(exclude={"schema_version", "model_observations"})
    )
    attachment = NutritionAttachment(
        whole_recipe=whole,
        per_serving=divide_totals(whole.totals, recipe.servings),
        basis="whole recipe, from food-composition records the user linked",
        servings=recipe.servings,
        linked_items=len(items),
    )
    recipe.nutrition = attachment.model_dump(mode="json")
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(recipe)
    logger.info(
        "recipe_nutrition_linked user_id=%s recipe_id=%s items=%d",
        user.id,
        recipe_id,
        len(items),
    )
    return to_read(recipe)
