    assert dash["history"]["total"] == 0 and dash["recent"] == []


def test_only_implemented_modules_claim_to_be_available(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    mods = client.get("/api/v1/modules", headers=auth_headers(registered["token"])).json()
    assert [m["key"] for m in mods] == [
        "food_recognition",
        "freshness",
        "hygiene",
        "cooking",
        "meal_planning",
    ]
    # A module is only marked available once its backend exists (Phase 3 food, Phase 4 freshness).
    assert {m["key"]: m["available"] for m in mods} == {
        "food_recognition": True,
        "freshness": True,
        "hygiene": False,
        "cooking": False,
        "meal_planning": False,
    }

    assert {m["key"]: m["available"] for m in mods} == {
    "food_recognition": True,
    "freshness": True,
    "hygiene": True,
    "cooking": False,
    "meal_planning": False,
    }


def test_history_pagination_filter_and_order(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    h = auth_headers(registered["token"])
    owner = _user_id(client, registered["token"])
    _seed(owner, 7, ModuleKey.FRESHNESS)
    _seed(owner, 3, ModuleKey.COOKING, prefix="Recipe")
    p1 = client.get("/api/v1/history?page=1&page_size=4", headers=h).json()
    p3 = client.get("/api/v1/history?page=3&page_size=4", headers=h).json()
    assert (p1["total"], p1["pages"], len(p1["items"]), len(p3["items"])) == (10, 3, 4, 2)
    only = client.get("/api/v1/history?module=cooking", headers=h).json()
    assert only["total"] == 3 and {i["module"] for i in only["items"]} == {"cooking"}
    beyond = client.get("/api/v1/history?page=99", headers=h).json()
    assert beyond["items"] == [] and beyond["total"] == 10

def test_history_detail_and_delete_with_ownership(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    alice = registered["token"]
    bob = register_user(client, "bob@example.com")
    rid = str(_seed(_user_id(client, alice), 1)[0])
    ha, hb = auth_headers(alice), auth_headers(bob)

    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/history/{rid}", headers=ha).json()["result"] == {"k": 0}
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/history/{rid}", headers=hb).status_code == 404
    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/history/{rid}", headers=hb).status_code == 404
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/history/{rid}", headers=ha).status_code == 200
    assert (
        client.delete(
            f"/api/v1/history/{rid}", headers={"Authorization": ha["Authorization"]}
        ).status_code
        == 403
    )
    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/history/{rid}", headers=ha).status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/history/{rid}", headers=ha).status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/api/v1/history", headers=hb).json()["total"] == 0

def test_deleting_media_keeps_history_but_clears_the_link(

        rec = AnalysisRecord(

def test_profile_update(client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    h = auth_headers(registered["token"])
    r = client.patch("/api/v1/users/me", headers=h, json={"display_name": "  Asha   K  "})
    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["display_name"] == "Asha K"
    assert client.get("/api/v1/users/me", headers=h).json()["display_name"] == "Asha K"
    for bad in ({"display_name": "  "}, {"display_name": "x" * 81}, {"email": "x@y.co"}, {}):
        assert client.patch("/api/v1/users/me", headers=h, json=bad).status_code == 422
    no_csrf = client.patch(
        "/api/v1/users/me",
        headers={"Authorization": h["Authorization"]},
        json={"display_name": "Z"},
    )
    assert no_csrf.status_code == 403


def test_change_password_revokes_sessions(client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    h = auth_headers(registered["token"])
    wrong = client.post(
        "/api/v1/users/me/password",
        headers=h,
        json={"current_password": "nope-nope-nope", "new_password": "a brand new passphrase"},
    )
    assert wrong.status_code == 400 and wrong.json()["error"]["code"] == "invalid_current_password"
    same = client.post(
        "/api/v1/users/me/password",
        headers=h,
        json={"current_password": USER["password"], "new_password": USER["password"]},
    )
    assert same.status_code == 400 and same.json()["error"]["code"] == "password_unchanged"
    short = client.post(
        "/api/v1/users/me/password",
        headers=h,
        json={"current_password": USER["password"], "new_password": "short"},
    )
    assert short.status_code == 422

    ok = client.post(
        "/api/v1/users/me/password",
        headers=h,
        json={"current_password": USER["password"], "new_password": "a brand new passphrase"},
    )
    assert ok.status_code == 204
    assert (
        client.post(
            "/api/v1/auth/refresh", headers={"X-Requested-With": "FoodVerseWeb"}
        ).status_code
        == 401
    )
    old = client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login", json={"email": "asha@example.com", "password": USER["password"]}
    )
    new = client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"email": "asha@example.com", "password": "a brand new passphrase"},
    )
    assert old.status_code == 401 and new.status_code == 200

import json
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.ai.hygiene import WITHHELD_TEXT
from app.ai.vision import (
    VisionBadOutputError, VisionRateLimitedError, VisionTimeoutError, VisionUnavailableError,
)
from app.domain import hygiene as rules
from tests.conftest import CSRF, auth_headers, register_user
from tests.food_helpers import FakeVision, install, upload_photo

Make = Callable[..., TestClient]
URL = "/api/v1/hygiene/inspections"


def model_json(**over: Any) -> str:
    base: dict[str, Any] = {
        "findings": [
            {
                "category": "surface_cleanliness",
                "description": "Greasy film on the cutting board",
                "location": "left side",
                "severity": "medium",
                "certainty": "clearly_visible",
            }
        ],
        "limitations": ["Cannot see inside the fridge"],
        "notes": None,
    }
    base.update(over)
    return json.dumps(base)


def world(make_client: Make, raw: str | None = None, **kw: Any) -> tuple[TestClient, str, str, FakeVision]:
    fake = FakeVision(raw=raw if raw is not None else model_json(), **kw)
    c = make_client()
    install(c, vision=fake, use_usda=False)
    return c, register_user(c, "alice@example.com"), register_user(c, "bob@example.com"), fake


def body(media_ids: list[str], **over: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "location_name": "Main kitchen",
        "location_type": "restaurant_kitchen",
        "area": "Prep station",
        "media_ids": media_ids,
        "notes": None,
    }
    payload.update(over)
    return payload


def post(c: TestClient, tok: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
    return c.post(URL, headers=auth_headers(tok), json=payload)


# ---------------- capabilities + auth ----------------
def test_capabilities_lists_choices_and_vision_state(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c = make_client()
    tok = register_user(c, "a@example.com")
    r = c.get("/api/v1/hygiene/capabilities", headers=auth_headers(tok)).json()
    assert r["vision"]["configured"] is False and r["vision"]["message"]
    assert {x["value"] for x in r["location_types"]} >= {"restaurant_kitchen", "home_kitchen"}
    assert {x["value"] for x in r["statuses"]} == {"draft", "in_review", "approved", "rejected"}
    assert any(item["item_id"] == "handwashing" for item in r["default_checklist"])
    assert r["max_photos"] == 8

        ("post", f"{URL}/{some}/submit"),
        ("post", f"{URL}/{some}/approve"),
        ("post", f"{URL}/{some}/reject"),
        ("delete", f"{URL}/{some}"),
        ("get", f"{URL}/{some}/report"),
    ):

def test_create_lists_and_reads_a_draft(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _, _ = world(make_client)
    photo = upload_photo(c, alice)
    r = post(c, alice, body([photo], notes="routine check"))
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    d = r.json()

    assert d["location_name"] == "Main kitchen" and d["area"] == "Prep station"
    assert d["photo_count"] == 1 and d["finding_count"] == 0
    assert d["media_ids"] == [photo]
    assert d["result"]["checklist"] and any(x["item_id"] == "handwashing" for x in d["result"]["checklist"])
    assert len(d["result"]["disclosures"]) >= 3
    assert any("pathogen" in x.lower() for x in d["result"]["disclosures"])
    assert len(d["result"]["not_assessable"]) >= 3

    listed = c.get(URL, headers=auth_headers(alice)).json()
    assert listed["total"] == 1 and listed["items"][0]["id"] == d["id"]

    got = c.get(f"{URL}/{d['id']}", headers=auth_headers(alice)).json()
    assert got == d

def test_update_draft_edits_location_notes_and_findings(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _, _ = world(make_client)
    photo = upload_photo(c, alice)
    made = post(c, alice, body([photo])).json()
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    upd = c.put(f"{URL}/{made['id']}", headers=h, json={
        "expected_revision": 1,
        "location_name": "Back kitchen",
        "area": "Dish station",
        "notes": "evening shift",
        "findings": [{
            "source": "user", "category": "tool_cleanliness", "severity": "high",
            "description": "Knife left on dirty board", "location": "middle",
            "certainty": "clearly_visible",
            "evidence_media_id": photo, "user_note": "Board is unwashed",
        }],
    })
    assert upd.status_code == 200, upd.text
    d = upd.json()
    assert d["location_name"] == "Back kitchen" and d["area"] == "Dish station"
    assert d["revision"] == 2 and d["finding_count"] == 1 and d["highest_severity"] == "high"
    f = d["result"]["findings"][0]
    assert f["source"] == "user" and f["category_label"] == "Tool cleanliness"
    assert f["suggested_action"]  # derived from fixed rules, not the client
    # Stale revision is rejected
    stale = c.put(f"{URL}/{made['id']}", headers=h, json={"expected_revision": 1, "notes": "x"})
    assert stale.status_code == 409
    assert stale.json()["error"]["code"] == "inspection_revision_conflict"

def test_analyze_produces_labelled_model_findings_only(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _, fake = world(make_client)
    photo = upload_photo(c, alice)
    made = post(c, alice, body([photo])).json()
    r = c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/analyze", headers=auth_headers(alice))
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    d = r.json()
    findings = d["result"]["findings"]
    assert len(findings) == 1
    f = findings[0]
    assert f["source"] == "model" and f["evidence_media_id"] == photo
    assert f["category_label"] == "Surface cleanliness"
    assert f["suggested_action"]
    assert d["result"]["provider"]["model"] == "fake-vision-1"
    assert d["result"]["model_limitations"] == ["Cannot see inside the fridge"]
    # No compliance/safety claims anywhere in the payload.
    flat = json.dumps(d).lower()
    for forbidden in ("compliant", "violation", "score:", "grade"):
        assert forbidden not in flat
    assert fake.calls == 1 and fake.images[0][:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"

@pytest.mark.parametrize("reply", [
    "", "not json", "[]", "{}", '{"findings": "x"}',
    json.dumps({"findings": [{"category": "bogus", "description": "x", "severity": "low", "certainty": "clearly_visible"}]}),
    json.dumps({"findings": [{"category": "surface_cleanliness", "description": "x", "severity": "critical", "certainty": "clearly_visible"}]}),
    json.dumps({"findings": [{"category": "surface_cleanliness", "description": "", "severity": "low", "certainty": "clearly_visible"}]}),
])
def test_bad_model_output_is_502_and_saves_nothing(make_client: Make, reply: str) -> None:

    photo = upload_photo(c, alice)
    made = post(c, alice, body([photo])).json()
    r = c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/analyze", headers=auth_headers(alice))

    # Nothing persisted; status still draft, findings still empty.
    after = c.get(f"{URL}/{made['id']}", headers=auth_headers(alice)).json()
    assert after["result"]["findings"] == []

# ---------------- review workflow ----------------
def test_full_lifecycle_draft_to_approved(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _, _ = world(make_client)
    photo = upload_photo(c, alice)
    made = post(c, alice, body([photo])).json()
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    # cannot submit without photos -> we have one, but let's verify submit works
    s = c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/submit", headers=h)
    assert s.status_code == 200 and s.json()["status"] == "in_review"
    # cannot edit findings while in review
    edit = c.put(f"{URL}/{made['id']}", headers=h, json={"findings": []})
    assert edit.status_code == 409 and edit.json()["error"]["code"] == "inspection_in_review"
    a = c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/approve", headers=h, json={"review_notes": None})
    assert a.status_code == 200 and a.json()["status"] == "approved"
    assert a.json()["reviewed_at"]
    # approved is read-only
    locked = c.put(f"{URL}/{made['id']}", headers=h, json={"notes": "x"})
    assert locked.status_code == 409 and locked.json()["error"]["code"] == "inspection_locked"


def test_reject_requires_notes_and_allows_rework(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _, _ = world(make_client)
    photo = upload_photo(c, alice)
    made = post(c, alice, body([photo])).json()
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/submit", headers=h)
    no_notes = c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/reject", headers=h, json={"review_notes": None})
    assert no_notes.status_code == 422 and no_notes.json()["error"]["code"] == "review_notes_required"
    rej = c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/reject", headers=h, json={"review_notes": "Add kitchen-area photo"})
    assert rej.status_code == 200 and rej.json()["status"] == "rejected"
    assert rej.json()["review_notes"] == "Add kitchen-area photo"
    # rejected is editable again
    edit = c.put(f"{URL}/{made['id']}", headers=h, json={"findings": [{
        "source": "user", "category": "waste_management", "severity": "high",
        "description": "Open bin next to prep", "location": "back",
        "certainty": "clearly_visible",
    }]})
    assert edit.status_code == 200 and edit.json()["finding_count"] == 1


def test_approved_cannot_be_rejected(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _, _ = world(make_client)
    photo = upload_photo(c, alice)
    made = post(c, alice, body([photo])).json()
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/submit", headers=h)
    c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/approve", headers=h, json={"review_notes": None})
    r = c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/reject", headers=h, json={"review_notes": "late"})
    assert r.status_code == 409

def test_list_filters_and_pagination(make_client: Make) -> None:

    only_home = c.get(f"{URL}?location_type=home_kitchen", headers=h).json()

    draft = c.get(f"{URL}?status=draft", headers=h).json()
    assert draft["total"] == 1 and draft["items"][0]["id"] == b["id"]


def test_report_html_is_self_contained_and_has_disclosures(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _, _ = world(make_client)
    photo = upload_photo(c, alice)
    made = post(c, alice, body([photo], notes="hello")).json()
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    c.post(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/analyze", headers=h)
    r = c.get(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/report", headers=h)

    body = r.text
    assert "<html" in body and "<style" in body and "@media print" in body
    assert "Hygiene inspection report" in body and "Main kitchen" in body
    assert "What this report cannot establish" in body
    assert "Pathogen presence" in body
    assert "not an official inspection" in body
    # No inline <script> or external assets (self-contained).

    # Owner-only.
    bob = register_user(c, "bob@example.com")
    assert c.get(f"{URL}/{made['id']}/report", headers=auth_headers(bob)).status_code == 404

    assert c.delete(f"{URL}/{made['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 403

================================================================================

import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.ai.vision import DetectedFood
from tests.conftest import auth_headers, register_user
from tests.food_helpers import FakeVision, install, search_food, upload_photo, usda_food, weight

Make = Callable[..., TestClient]


def now_iso(hours_ago: float = 1) -> str:
    return (datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(hours=hours_ago)).isoformat()


def world(make_client: Make, **kw: Any) -> tuple[TestClient, str, str]:
    c = make_client()
    install(c, usda=[usda_food()], **kw)
    return c, register_user(c, "alice@example.com"), register_user(c, "bob@example.com")


def body(ref: str | None, grams: float = 150, **extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    item: dict[str, Any] = {"name": "Apple", "portion": weight(grams)}
    if ref:
        item["food_ref"] = ref
    return {"items": [item], "eaten_at": now_iso(), "category": "snack", **extra}


def save(c: TestClient, tok: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    r = c.post("/api/v1/meals", headers=auth_headers(tok), json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    return dict(r.json())


def test_save_persists_full_audit_and_server_side_totals(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    ref = search_food(c, alice)[0]["food_ref"]
    meal = save(c, alice, body(ref, notes="  lunch box  "))
    assert meal["revision"] == 1 and meal["notes"] == "lunch box" and meal["category"] == "snack"
    assert meal["calories"] == {"low": 78.0, "high": 78.0, "complete": True}
    audit = meal["result"]
    assert audit["items"][0]["food"]["source"] == "usda_fdc"
    assert audit["items"][0]["food"]["per_100g"]["energy_kcal"] == 52.0
    assert audit["method"] and audit["unit_basis"] and audit["disclaimer"]
    again = c.get(f"/api/v1/meals/{meal['id']}", headers=auth_headers(alice)).json()
    assert again["result"] == audit


def test_client_cannot_supply_totals(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    payload = body(None)
    payload["totals"] = {"energy_kcal": {"low": 1, "high": 1}}
    assert c.post("/api/v1/meals", headers=auth_headers(alice), json=payload).status_code == 422
    payload = body(None)
    payload["items"][0]["per_100g"] = {"energy_kcal": 1}
    assert c.post("/api/v1/meals", headers=auth_headers(alice), json=payload).status_code == 422


def test_meal_without_nutrition_data_is_saved_honestly(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    meal = save(c, alice, body(None))
    assert meal["calories"] == {"low": None, "high": None, "complete": False}
    assert "no_nutrition_data" in meal["result"]["items"][0]["warnings"]


def test_save_creates_history_entry_and_delete_removes_it(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    meal = save(c, alice, body(None))
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    hist = c.get("/api/v1/history?module=food_recognition", headers=h).json()
    assert hist["total"] == 1 and hist["items"][0]["id"] == meal["id"]
    assert c.delete(f"/api/v1/meals/{meal['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
    assert c.get(f"/api/v1/meals/{meal['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 404
    assert c.get("/api/v1/history", headers=h).json()["total"] == 0
    assert c.get("/api/v1/meals", headers=h).json()["total"] == 0


def test_deleting_through_history_removes_the_meal_too(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    meal = save(c, alice, body(None))
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    assert c.delete(f"/api/v1/history/{meal['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
    assert c.get("/api/v1/meals", headers=h).json()["total"] == 0


def test_ownership_isolation(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, bob = world(make_client)
    meal = save(c, alice, body(None))
    hb = auth_headers(bob)
    mid = meal["id"]
    assert c.get(f"/api/v1/meals/{mid}", headers=hb).status_code == 404
    assert c.put(f"/api/v1/meals/{mid}", headers=hb, json=body(None)).status_code == 404
    assert c.delete(f"/api/v1/meals/{mid}", headers=hb).status_code == 404
    assert c.get("/api/v1/meals", headers=hb).json() == {
        "items": [],
        "total": 0,
        "page": 1,
        "page_size": 10,
        "pages": 0,
    }
    assert (
        c.get(f"/api/v1/meals/{mid}", headers=auth_headers(alice)).status_code == 200
    )  # untouched
    assert c.get(f"/api/v1/meals/{uuid.uuid4()}", headers=hb).status_code == 404

def test_scan_audit_keeps_model_output_labelled_and_links_photo(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(
        make_client, vision=FakeVision([DetectedFood(name="Apple", ambiguous=True)])
    )
    photo = upload_photo(c, alice)
    scan = c.post("/api/v1/food/scan", headers=auth_headers(alice), json={"media_id": photo}).json()
    ref = search_food(c, alice)[0]["food_ref"]
    payload = body(ref, scan_ref=scan["scan_ref"])
    payload["items"][0]["observed_id"] = 0
    meal = save(c, alice, payload)
    assert meal["media_id"] == photo
    obs = meal["result"]["model_observations"]
    assert obs["items"][0]["name"] == "Apple" and obs["provider"]["model"] == "fake-vision-1"
    assert meal["result"]["items"][0]["origin"] == "model"
    # deleting the photo keeps the meal and its audit
    assert c.delete(f"/api/v1/media/{photo}", headers=auth_headers(alice)).status_code == 204
    kept = c.get(f"/api/v1/meals/{meal['id']}", headers=auth_headers(alice)).json()
    assert kept["media_id"] is None and kept["result"]["model_observations"]


def test_update_recomputes_and_bumps_revision(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    ref = search_food(c, alice)[0]["food_ref"]
    meal = save(c, alice, body(ref, 100))
    item_id = meal["result"]["items"][0]["item_id"]
    edit = body(None, 300, expected_revision=1)
    edit["items"][0]["item_id"] = item_id  # keeps the chosen food, changes the portion only
    edit["category"] = "dinner"
    r = c.put(f"/api/v1/meals/{meal['id']}", headers=h, json=edit)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    out = r.json()
    assert out["revision"] == 2 and out["category"] == "dinner"
    assert out["calories"]["low"] == 156.0
    assert out["result"]["items"][0]["food"]["source_id"] == "171688"
    hist = c.get(f"/api/v1/history/{meal['id']}", headers=h).json()
    assert hist["title"].startswith("Dinner")


def test_update_can_clear_food_and_rename(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    ref = search_food(c, alice)[0]["food_ref"]
    meal = save(c, alice, body(ref))
    edit = body(None)
    edit["items"][0].update(
        item_id=meal["result"]["items"][0]["item_id"], clear_food=True, name="Mystery"
    )
    out = c.put(f"/api/v1/meals/{meal['id']}", headers=auth_headers(alice), json=edit).json()
    item = out["result"]["items"][0]
    assert item["food"] is None and item["nutrients"] == {} and out["calories"]["low"] is None
    assert item["origin"] == "user_added" and item["name"] == "Mystery"


def test_update_rejects_foreign_item_ids_and_stale_revision(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    meal = save(c, alice, body(None))
    other = save(c, alice, body(None))
    bad = body(None)
    bad["items"][0]["item_id"] = other["result"]["items"][0]["item_id"]
    assert c.put(f"/api/v1/meals/{meal['id']}", headers=h, json=bad).status_code == 422
    ok = c.put(f"/api/v1/meals/{meal['id']}", headers=h, json=body(None, expected_revision=1))
    assert ok.status_code == 200
    stale = c.put(f"/api/v1/meals/{meal['id']}", headers=h, json=body(None, expected_revision=1))
    assert stale.status_code == 409 and stale.json()["error"]["code"] == "meal_revision_conflict"


def test_list_filters_pagination_and_order(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    h = auth_headers(alice)
    for i, cat in enumerate(["breakfast", "lunch", "lunch", "dinner", "snack"]):
        p = body(None)
        p["category"], p["eaten_at"] = cat, now_iso(hours_ago=10 - i)
        save(c, alice, p)
    page = c.get("/api/v1/meals?page_size=2", headers=h).json()
    assert (page["total"], page["pages"], len(page["items"])) == (5, 3, 2)
    assert page["items"][0]["category"] == "snack"  # newest eaten_at first
    lunch = c.get("/api/v1/meals?category=lunch", headers=h).json()
    assert lunch["total"] == 2
    cutoff = now_iso(hours_ago=7.5)
    recent = c.get("/api/v1/meals", headers=h, params={"date_from": cutoff}).json()
    assert recent["total"] == 2  # the 7 h and 6 h old meals
    assert (
        c.get(
            "/api/v1/meals", headers=h, params={"date_from": now_iso(1), "date_to": now_iso(5)}
        ).status_code
        == 422
    )
    for q in ("category=brunch", "page=0", "page_size=101"):
        assert c.get(f"/api/v1/meals?{q}", headers=h).status_code == 422


def test_write_validation(make_client: Make) -> None:
    c, alice, _ = world(make_client)
    h = auth_headers(alice)

    def post(**over: Any) -> int:
        status: int = c.post("/api/v1/meals", headers=h, json={**body(None), **over}).status_code
        return status

    assert post(eaten_at="2026-01-01T12:00:00") == 422  # no timezone
    assert post(eaten_at=(datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(days=3)).isoformat()) == 422
    assert post(eaten_at="1990-01-01T00:00:00+00:00") == 422
    assert post(category="brunch") == 422
    assert post(notes="x" * 1001) == 422
    assert post(items=[]) == 422
    assert post(media_id="not-a-uuid") == 422
    no_csrf = c.post("/api/v1/meals", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {alice}"}, json=body(None))
    assert no_csrf.status_code == 403

import io
import os
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from httpx import Response
from PIL import Image

from app.media.storage import LocalStorage, StorageError
from tests.conftest import CSRF, auth_headers, register_user
from tests.imgs import jpeg_with_exif, make_image, noise_png, upload_files

MEDIA_ROOT = Path(os.environ["MEDIA_ROOT"])


def _upload(client: TestClient, token: str, content: bytes, name: str, mime: str) -> Response:
    response: Response = client.post(
        "/api/v1/media", headers=auth_headers(token), files=upload_files(content, name, mime)
    )
    return response


def _stored_files() -> list[Path]:
    return [p for p in MEDIA_ROOT.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("fmt", "name", "mime", "ctype"),
    [
        ("PNG", "meal.png", "image/png", "image/png"),
        ("JPEG", "meal.JPG", "image/jpeg", "image/jpeg"),
        ("JPEG", "meal.jpeg", "image/jpeg", "image/jpeg"),
        ("WEBP", "meal.webp", "image/webp", "image/webp"),
    ],
)
def test_valid_images_are_accepted_and_described(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str], fmt: str, name: str, mime: str, ctype: str
) -> None:
    r = _upload(client, registered["token"], make_image(fmt, (64, 48)), name, mime)
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert body["kind"] == "image" and body["content_type"] == ctype
    assert (body["width"], body["height"]) == (64, 48)
    assert body["size_bytes"] > 0 and body["duration_seconds"] is None
    assert "storage_key" not in body and "owner_id" not in body and "sha256" not in body


def test_stored_file_is_reencoded_and_metadata_stripped(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    original = jpeg_with_exif()
    assert Image.open(io.BytesIO(original)).getexif().get_ifd(0x8825)  # sanity: GPS present
    r = _upload(client, registered["token"], original, "photo.jpg", "image/jpeg")
    assert r.status_code == 201
    stored = client.get(
        f"/api/v1/media/{r.json()['id']}/content", headers=auth_headers(registered["token"])
    )
    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(stored.content))
    assert not img.getexif().get_ifd(0x8825), "GPS data must be removed"
    assert 0x0112 not in img.getexif(), "orientation tag is baked in, then dropped"
    assert img.size == (20, 40)  # 40x20 rotated by the orientation flag
    assert (r.json()["width"], r.json()["height"]) == (20, 40)
    assert stored.content != original


def test_trailing_payload_is_not_preserved(client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    sneaky = make_image("PNG") + b"<script>alert(1)</script>PAYLOAD"
    r = _upload(client, registered["token"], sneaky, "a.png", "image/png")
    assert r.status_code == 201
    stored = client.get(
        f"/api/v1/media/{r.json()['id']}/content", headers=auth_headers(registered["token"])
    )
    assert b"PAYLOAD" not in stored.content and b"<script>" not in stored.content


def test_client_filename_never_reaches_the_filesystem(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    r = _upload(
        client, registered["token"], make_image("PNG"), "../../../etc/passwd/..\\x.png", "image/png"
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.json()["display_name"] == "x.png"
    files = _stored_files()
    assert len(files) == 1 and files[0].resolve().is_relative_to(MEDIA_ROOT.resolve())
    assert "passwd" not in str(files[0]) and files[0].suffix == ".png"
    assert oct(files[0].stat().st_mode & 0o777) == "0o600"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("content", "name", "mime", "status", "code"),
    [
        (b"just some text", "notes.png", "image/png", 415, "unsupported_media_type"),
        (
            b"<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><script>1</script></svg>",
            "x.svg",
            "image/svg+xml",
            415,
            "unsupported_media_type",
        ),
        (b"<html><body>hi</body></html>", "x.jpg", "image/jpeg", 415, "unsupported_media_type"),
        (b"MZ\x90\x00 fake exe", "x.png", "image/png", 415, "unsupported_media_type"),
        (b"GIF89a\x01\x00\x01\x00", "x.gif", "image/gif", 415, "unsupported_media_type"),
        (b"", "empty.png", "image/png", 422, "empty_file"),
    ],
)
def test_non_images_are_rejected(
    client: TestClient,
    registered: dict[str, str],
    content: bytes,
    name: str,
    mime: str,
    status: int,
    code: str,
) -> None:
    r = _upload(client, registered["token"], content, name, mime)
    assert r.status_code == status, r.text
    assert r.json()["error"]["code"] == code
    assert _stored_files() == []


def test_extension_and_declared_type_must_match_the_real_format(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    png = make_image("PNG")
    for name, mime in [
        ("a.jpg", "image/png"),
        ("a.png", "image/jpeg"),
        ("a.png", "text/html"),
        ("a.png", "application/octet-stream"),
        ("a", "image/png"),
        ("a.exe", "image/png"),
    ]:
        r = _upload(client, registered["token"], png, name, mime)
        assert r.status_code == 415, (name, mime, r.text)
        assert r.json()["error"]["code"] == "media_type_mismatch"
    assert _stored_files() == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "name", ["clip.mp4", "clip.mov", "song.mp3", "voice.wav", "a.webm", "a.m4a"]
)
def test_video_and_audio_are_explicitly_not_enabled(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str], name: str
) -> None:
    r = _upload(
        client, registered["token"], b"\x00\x00\x00\x18ftypmp42" + b"0" * 40, name, "video/mp4"
    )
    assert r.status_code == 415
    assert r.json()["error"]["code"] == "media_kind_not_enabled"


def test_corrupt_and_truncated_images_are_rejected(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    good = make_image("PNG", (200, 200))
    for broken in (
        good[: len(good) // 2],
        good[:8] + b"\x00" * 50,
        b"\xff\xd8\xff" + b"\x00" * 100,
    ):
        r = _upload(
            client,
            registered["token"],
            broken,
            "a.png" if broken[:1] != b"\xff" else "a.jpg",
            "image/png" if broken[:1] != b"\xff" else "image/jpeg",
        )
        assert r.status_code == 422, r.text
        assert r.json()["error"]["code"] == "invalid_image"
    assert _stored_files() == []


def test_decompression_bomb_style_dimensions_are_rejected(
    make_client: Callable[..., TestClient],
) -> None:
    c = make_client(max_image_pixels=1_000_000)
    token = register_user(c, "bomb@example.com")
    big = make_image("PNG", (1500, 1500))  # ~2.2 MP but only a few KB on disk
    assert len(big) < 100_000
    r = _upload(c, token, big, "big.png", "image/png")
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert r.json()["error"]["code"] == "image_dimensions_too_large"
    assert (
        _upload(c, token, make_image("PNG", (900, 900)), "ok.png", "image/png").status_code == 201
    )


def test_upload_size_limit_is_enforced(make_client: Callable[..., TestClient]) -> None:
    c = make_client(max_upload_bytes=50_000)
    token = register_user(c, "limit@example.com")
    r = _upload(c, token, noise_png(150), "big.png", "image/png")  # ~67 KB
    assert r.status_code == 413
    assert r.json()["error"]["code"] == "file_too_large"
    assert _stored_files() == []
    ok = _upload(c, token, noise_png(60), "small.png", "image/png")  # ~11 KB
    assert ok.status_code == 201


def test_body_over_the_limit_is_rejected_even_if_the_client_lies_about_length(
    make_client: Callable[..., TestClient],
) -> None:
    c = make_client(max_upload_bytes=10_000)
    token = register_user(c, "liar@example.com")
    boundary = "xxBOUNDARYxx"
    body = (
        (
            f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="a.png"\r\n'
            f"Content-Type: image/png\r\n\r\n"
        ).encode()
        + b"A" * 200_000
        + f"\r\n--{boundary}--\r\n".encode()
    )
    headers = {**auth_headers(token), "Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}"}
    r = c.post("/api/v1/media", headers=headers, content=body)  # honest Content-Length
    assert r.status_code == 413 and r.json()["error"]["code"] == "file_too_large"

    def chunks() -> Iterator[bytes]:  # no Content-Length: chunked transfer
        yield body[:100_000]
        yield body[100_000:]

    r2 = c.post("/api/v1/media", headers=headers, content=chunks())
    assert r2.status_code == 413
    assert _stored_files() == []


def test_per_user_quota(make_client: Callable[..., TestClient]) -> None:
    c = make_client(user_media_quota_bytes=150_000)
    token = register_user(c, "quota@example.com")
    first = _upload(c, token, noise_png(150), "a.png", "image/png")  # ~67 KB
    second = _upload(c, token, noise_png(150), "b.png", "image/png")
    third = _upload(c, token, noise_png(150), "c.png", "image/png")
    assert first.status_code == second.status_code == 201
    assert third.status_code == 413 and third.json()["error"]["code"] == "quota_exceeded"
    assert len(_stored_files()) == 2
    # deleting frees quota
    assert (
        c.delete(f"/api/v1/media/{first.json()['id']}", headers=auth_headers(token)).status_code
        == 204
    )
    assert _upload(c, token, noise_png(150), "d.png", "image/png").status_code == 201


def test_upload_requires_auth_and_csrf_header(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    files = upload_files(make_image("PNG"), "a.png", "image/png")
    assert client.post("/api/v1/media", headers=CSRF, files=files).status_code == 401
    assert client.post("/api/v1/media", files=files).status_code in (401, 403)  # never succeeds
    no_csrf = client.post(
        "/api/v1/media", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {registered['token']}"}, files=files
    )
    assert no_csrf.status_code == 403
    assert (
        client.post("/api/v1/media", headers=auth_headers(registered["token"])).status_code == 422
    )  # no file
    assert _stored_files() == []

def test_local_storage_rejects_unsafe_keys(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    store = LocalStorage(tmp_path)
    good = "ab/" + "c" * 32 + ".png"
    store.put(good, b"x")
    assert store.exists(good) and store.open(good).read() == b"x"
    for bad in (
        "../x.png",
        "ab/../../etc/passwd",
        "/etc/passwd",
        "ab/" + "c" * 32 + ".php",
        "ab/" + "c" * 31 + ".png",
        "AB/" + "c" * 32 + ".png",
        "ab\\" + "c" * 32 + ".png",
        "",
    ):
        with pytest.raises(StorageError):
            store.put(bad, b"x")
        with pytest.raises(StorageError):
            store.open(bad)
    store.delete(good)
    assert not store.exists(good)
    store.delete(good)  # idempotent


def test_csrf_header_constant_is_used_on_state_changes(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    assert CSRF["X-Requested-With"]  # documents the header the mutating routes require

import os
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from tests.conftest import auth_headers, register_user
from tests.imgs import make_image, upload_files

MEDIA_ROOT = Path(os.environ["MEDIA_ROOT"])


def _setup(client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    alice = registered["token"]
    bob = register_user(client, "bob@example.com", "Bob")
    r = client.post(
        "/api/v1/media",
        headers=auth_headers(alice),
        files=upload_files(make_image("PNG"), "private.png", "image/png"),
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    return alice, bob, r.json()["id"]


def test_other_users_cannot_read_metadata_content_or_delete(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    alice, bob, mid = _setup(client, registered)
    hb = auth_headers(bob)
    for path in (
        f"/api/v1/media/{mid}",
        f"/api/v1/media/{mid}/content",
        f"/api/v1/media/{mid}/content?download=true",
    ):
        r = client.get(path, headers=hb)
        assert r.status_code == 404 and r.json()["error"]["code"] == "media_not_found", path
    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/media/{mid}", headers=hb).status_code == 404
    # ...and the owner is unaffected
    assert (
        client.get(f"/api/v1/media/{mid}/content", headers=auth_headers(alice)).status_code == 200
    )
    assert len([p for p in MEDIA_ROOT.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]) == 1


def test_missing_and_foreign_ids_are_indistinguishable(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    _, bob, mid = _setup(client, registered)
    foreign = client.get(f"/api/v1/media/{mid}", headers=auth_headers(bob))
    missing = client.get(
        "/api/v1/media/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000", headers=auth_headers(bob)
    )
    assert foreign.status_code == missing.status_code == 404
    assert foreign.json()["error"]["message"] == missing.json()["error"]["message"]


def test_listing_only_shows_own_media(client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    alice, bob, _ = _setup(client, registered)
    assert client.get("/api/v1/media", headers=auth_headers(bob)).json()["total"] == 0
    assert client.get("/api/v1/media", headers=auth_headers(alice)).json()["total"] == 1


def test_unauthenticated_access_is_rejected_everywhere(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    _, _, mid = _setup(client, registered)
    client.cookies.clear()
    for method, path in [
        ("GET", "/api/v1/media"),
        ("GET", f"/api/v1/media/{mid}"),
        ("GET", f"/api/v1/media/{mid}/content"),
        ("DELETE", f"/api/v1/media/{mid}"),
    ]:
        r = client.request(method, path, headers={"X-Requested-With": "FoodVerseWeb"})
        assert r.status_code == 401, (method, path)


def test_malformed_ids_are_validation_errors(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    h = auth_headers(registered["token"])
    for bad in ("not-a-uuid", "../../etc/passwd", "1"):
        assert client.get(f"/api/v1/media/{bad}", headers=h).status_code in (404, 422)
        assert client.get(f"/api/v1/media/{bad}/content", headers=h).status_code in (404, 422)


def test_deleting_an_account_row_removes_media_rows(
    client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    """Rows cascade with the user; documents that file cleanup is a separate (future) job."""
    from sqlalchemy import text

    from app.db.session import get_session_factory

    _setup(client, registered)
    with get_session_factory()() as db:
        db.execute(text("DELETE FROM users"))
        db.commit()
        assert db.execute(text("SELECT count(*) FROM media_assets")).scalar() == 0

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from app.domain.nutrition_calc import (
    ItemInput,
    PortionError,
    compute_item,
    compute_totals,
    range_portion,
    servings_portion,
    weight_portion,
)

APPLE = {"energy_kcal": 52.0, "protein_g": 0.26, "carbs_g": 13.8, "fat_g": 0.17}


def test_weight_scales_per_100g() -> None:
    r = compute_item(ItemInput("apple", APPLE, weight_portion(150, "g")))
    assert r.nutrients["energy_kcal"] == (Decimal("78.0"), Decimal("78.0"))
    assert r.nutrients["carbs_g"][0] == Decimal("20.7")
    assert r.warnings == ()
    assert not r.uncertain


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("amount", "unit", "grams"),
    [(1, "kg", "1000"), (2, "oz", "56.699"), (1, "lb", "453.592"), (250, "g", "250")],
)
def test_unit_conversion(amount: float, unit: str, grams: str) -> None:
    p = weight_portion(amount, unit)
    assert p.grams_low == p.grams_high
    assert abs(p.grams_low - Decimal(grams)) < Decimal("0.01")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("unit", ["cup", "ml", "tbsp", "slice", "piece"])
def test_volume_and_count_units_are_rejected(unit: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(PortionError):
        weight_portion(1, unit)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [0, -5, 0.01, 6000])
def test_out_of_range_weights_rejected(amount: float) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(PortionError):
        weight_portion(amount, "g")


def test_range_gives_low_high_and_flags_uncertain() -> None:
    r = compute_item(ItemInput("rice", {"energy_kcal": 130.0}, range_portion(100, 200, "g")))
    assert r.nutrients["energy_kcal"] == (Decimal("130.0"), Decimal("260.0"))
    assert r.uncertain and "portion_is_estimate" in r.warnings


def test_range_must_be_ordered() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(PortionError):
        range_portion(200, 100, "g")
    with pytest.raises(PortionError):
        range_portion(100, 100, "g")


def test_servings_need_a_source_serving_weight() -> None:
    assert servings_portion(2, 30).grams_low == Decimal("60")
    with pytest.raises(PortionError):
        servings_portion(2, None)
    with pytest.raises(PortionError):
        servings_portion(2, 0)


def test_missing_nutrient_is_absent_not_zero() -> None:
    r = compute_item(ItemInput("x", {"energy_kcal": 100.0}, weight_portion(100, "g")))
    assert "protein_g" not in r.nutrients
    assert "protein_g" in r.not_reported
    assert "partial_nutrients" in r.warnings


def test_zero_reported_by_source_is_kept_as_zero() -> None:
    r = compute_item(ItemInput("x", {**APPLE, "fat_g": 0.0}, weight_portion(100, "g")))
    assert r.nutrients["fat_g"] == (Decimal("0.0"), Decimal("0.0"))


def test_no_source_or_no_portion_gives_no_numbers() -> None:
    nosrc = compute_item(ItemInput("mystery", None, weight_portion(100, "g")))
    assert nosrc.nutrients == {} and "no_nutrition_data" in nosrc.warnings
    noport = compute_item(ItemInput("apple", APPLE, None))
    assert noport.nutrients == {} and "portion_missing" in noport.warnings


def test_totals_sum_and_flag_incomplete() -> None:
    a = compute_item(ItemInput("a", APPLE, weight_portion(100, "g")))
    b = compute_item(ItemInput("b", {"protein_g": 10.0}, weight_portion(100, "g")))
    c = compute_item(ItemInput("unknown", None, weight_portion(100, "g")))
    t = compute_totals([a, b, c])
    assert t["energy_kcal"].low == Decimal("52.0")
    assert not t["energy_kcal"].complete
    assert set(t["energy_kcal"].missing_items) == {"b", "unknown"}
    assert t["protein_g"].low == Decimal("10.26")
    assert t["fiber_g"].low is None  # nobody reported it: not 0


def test_totals_complete_when_all_items_contribute() -> None:
    a = compute_item(ItemInput("a", APPLE, weight_portion(100, "g")))
    b = compute_item(ItemInput("b", APPLE, range_portion(100, 200, "g")))
    t = compute_totals([a, b])["energy_kcal"]
    assert t.complete and (t.low, t.high) == (Decimal("104.0"), Decimal("156.0"))


def test_empty_meal_is_never_complete() -> None:
    assert not compute_totals([])["energy_kcal"].complete


def test_decimal_math_has_no_float_drift() -> None:
    r = compute_item(ItemInput("x", {"energy_kcal": 0.1}, weight_portion(300, "g")))
    assert r.nutrients["energy_kcal"][0] == Decimal("0.3")

def test_usda_rejects_wrong_units_and_implausible_values() -> None:
    food = usda_food(nutrients={"208": 52.0})
    food["foodNutrients"].append(
        {"nutrientNumber": "203", "unitName": "MG", "value": 5}
    )  # wrong unit
    food["foodNutrients"].append(
        {"nutrientNumber": "204", "unitName": "G", "value": 900}
    )  # > 100 g/100 g
    food["foodNutrients"].append({"nutrientNumber": "205", "unitName": "G", "value": -3})

    assert c is not None and set(c.per_100g) == {"energy_kcal"}

def test_usda_search_sends_key_only_as_query_param_to_configured_host() -> None:
    seen: list[httpx.Request] = []

    def handler(req: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        seen.append(req)
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"foods": [usda_food()]})

    out = _usda(handler).search("apple", 5)
    assert len(out) == 1
    assert seen[0].url.host == "fdc.test" and seen[0].url.params["api_key"] == "secret-key"
    assert "Foundation" in seen[0].url.params["dataType"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("response", "status"),
    [
        (httpx.Response(429), "rate_limited"),
        (httpx.Response(403), "unavailable"),
        (httpx.Response(500), "unavailable"),
        (httpx.Response(200, text="<html>"), "unavailable"),
        (httpx.Response(200, json={"foods": "nope"}), "unavailable"),
        (httpx.Response(200, json={}), "unavailable"),
    ],
)
def test_usda_errors_are_typed_and_never_leak_the_key(
    response: httpx.Response, status: str
) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(NutritionSourceError) as exc:
        _usda(lambda r: response).search("apple", 5)
    assert exc.value.status == status and "secret-key" not in exc.value.message


def test_usda_timeout_and_network_failure() -> None:
    def slow(req: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        raise httpx.ReadTimeout("t", request=req)

    def down(req: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        raise httpx.ConnectError("c", request=req)

    with pytest.raises(NutritionSourceError) as t:
        _usda(slow).search("a", 5)
    with pytest.raises(NutritionSourceError) as d:
        _usda(down).search("a", 5)
    assert (t.value.status, d.value.status) == ("timeout", "unavailable")


def test_usda_key_is_not_written_to_logs(caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture) -> None:
    from app.core.logging import configure_logging

    configure_logging("INFO")
    caplog.set_level(logging.DEBUG)
    _usda(lambda r: httpx.Response(200, json={"foods": []})).search("apple", 5)
    assert "secret-key" not in caplog.text

# ---- local reference table + importer ----
def _csv(tmp_path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
    p = tmp_path / "ref.csv"
    p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return p


META = {
    "dataset": "TEST-DS",
    "version": "1",
    "citation": "Test citation",
    "license_note": "Test licence",
}


def test_import_empty_cell_means_not_reported_and_rows_are_traceable(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    from app.nutrition.sources.local import LocalReferenceSource

    path = _csv(tmp_path, "source_id,name,energy_kcal,protein_g,fat_g\nA1,Test dal,350,22,\n")
    with get_session_factory()() as db:
        res = import_csv(db, path, **META)
        assert (res.inserted, res.errors) == (1, [])
        src = LocalReferenceSource(db)
        assert src.record_count() == 1
        hit = src.search("dal", 5)[0]
    assert hit.per_100g == {"energy_kcal": 350.0, "protein_g": 22.0}  # fat absent, not 0
    assert "TEST-DS" in hit.source_label and hit.source_id == "TEST-DS:A1"
    assert "Test citation" in hit.attribution


def test_import_skips_bad_rows_and_is_idempotent(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _csv(
        tmp_path,
        "source_id,name,energy_kcal\nA1,Good,100\nA2,Negative,-5\nA3,Text,abc\nA4,Huge,99999\n,NoId,1\n",
    )
    with get_session_factory()() as db:
        first = import_csv(db, path, **META)
        second = import_csv(db, path, **META)
    assert first.inserted == 1 and len(first.errors) == 4
    assert second.inserted == 0 and second.updated == 1


def test_import_requires_provenance_and_known_columns(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = _csv(tmp_path, "source_id,name,energy_kcal\nA1,X,1\n")
    with get_session_factory()() as db:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            import_csv(db, path, **{**META, "citation": " "})
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            import_csv(db, _csv(tmp_path, "source_id,name,vitamin_zz\nA,B,1\n"), **META)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            import_csv(db, _csv(tmp_path, "name,energy_kcal\nB,1\n"), **META)

import httpx
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import text

from app.ai.ollama import OllamaClient
from app.core.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db.session import get_session_factory
from tests.conftest import auth_headers


def test_health_is_ok(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r = client.get("/api/v1/health")
    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "ok"


def test_ready_checks_database_and_migrations(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r = client.get("/api/v1/ready")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == {"status": "ok", "checks": {"database": "ok", "migrations": "ok"}}


def test_ready_reports_unavailable_when_migrations_are_behind(client: TestClient) -> None:
    with get_session_factory()() as db:
        original = db.execute(text("SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version")).scalar()
        try:
            db.execute(text("UPDATE alembic_version SET version_num = 'stale'"))
            db.commit()
            r = client.get("/api/v1/ready")
        finally:
            db.execute(text("UPDATE alembic_version SET version_num = :v"), {"v": original})
            db.commit()
    assert r.status_code == 503
    assert r.json()["checks"]["migrations"] == "not_up_to_date"


def test_cors_allows_configured_origin_only(client: TestClient) -> None:
    allowed = get_settings().cors_origins[0]
    ok = client.options(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        headers={"Origin": allowed, "Access-Control-Request-Method": "POST"},
    )
    assert ok.headers["access-control-allow-origin"] == allowed
    assert ok.headers["access-control-allow-credentials"] == "true"
    bad = client.options(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        headers={"Origin": "https://evil.example", "Access-Control-Request-Method": "POST"},
    )
    assert "access-control-allow-origin" not in bad.headers


def test_ai_status_when_ollama_disabled(client: TestClient, registered: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    r = client.get("/api/v1/ai/status", headers=auth_headers(registered["token"]))
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["ollama"]["enabled"] is False and body["ollama"]["reachable"] is None
    assert body["fallback_policy"] == "none" and body["external_providers_allowed"] is False


def _settings(**over: object) -> Settings:
    base = {
        "database_url": "postgresql://u:p@localhost/db_test",
        "jwt_secret_key": "k" * 40,
        "ollama_enabled": True,
        "ollama_text_model": "llama3.2:3b",
        "ollama_vision_model": "vision-model",
    }
    return Settings(_env_file=None, **{**base, **over})  # type: ignore[arg-type]


def test_ollama_client_reports_installed_models() -> None:
    def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        assert request.url.path == "/api/tags"
        return httpx.Response(
            200, json={"models": [{"name": "llama3.2:3b"}, {"name": "other:latest"}]}
        )

    status = OllamaClient(_settings(), transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler)).status().ollama
    assert status.reachable is True
    assert status.text_model.installed is True
    assert status.vision_model.installed is False  # configured but not pulled; nothing downloaded

        raise httpx.ConnectError("refused")

    status = OllamaClient(_settings(), transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler)).status().ollama
    assert status.reachable is False and status.error
    assert status.text_model.installed is None

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from tests.conftest import USER, auth_headers


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "patch",
    [
        {"email": "not-an-email"},
        {"password": "short"},
        {"password": "x" * 129},
        {"display_name": "   "},
        {"display_name": ""},
        {"display_name": "n" * 81},
        {"unexpected": "field"},
    ],
)
def test_register_validation_errors(client: TestClient, patch: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    r = client.post("/api/v1/auth/register", json={**USER, **patch})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    err = r.json()["error"]
    assert err["code"] == "validation_error" and err["details"]


def test_validation_errors_never_echo_the_password(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r = client.post("/api/v1/auth/register", json={**USER, "password": "short-pw"})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    assert "short-pw" not in r.text


def test_register_missing_fields(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.post("/api/v1/auth/register", json={}).status_code == 422


def test_login_validation(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert (
        client.post("/api/v1/auth/login", json={"email": "bad", "password": "x"}).status_code == 422
    )
    assert (
        client.post("/api/v1/auth/login", json={"email": "a@b.co", "password": ""}).status_code
        == 422
    )

import json
import uuid
from datetime import timedelta

import httpx
import pytest

from app.ai.vision import (
    VisionBadOutputError,
    VisionModelMissingError,
    VisionProvider,
    VisionRateLimitedError,
    VisionTimeoutError,
    VisionUnavailableError,
    parse_vision_output,
)
from app.core.config import Settings
from app.core.signed_refs import InvalidRefError, sign_ref, verify_ref


def test_valid_output_is_normalised() -> None:
    raw = json.dumps(
        {
            "items": [
                {
                    "name": " * Apple ",
                    "description": "red",
                    "alternatives": ["apple", "Pear", "Pear"],
                },
                {"name": "apple"},
            ],
            "notes": "ok",
            "extra": 1,
        }
    )
    out = parse_vision_output(raw)
    assert [i.name for i in out.items] == ["Apple"]  # duplicate dropped
    assert out.items[0].alternatives == ["Pear"]
    assert not hasattr(out.items[0], "confidence")


def test_fenced_json_is_accepted() -> None:
    assert (
        parse_vision_output('```json\n{"items": [{"name": "Rice"}]}\n```').items[0].name == "Rice"
    )


def test_empty_items_is_a_valid_answer() -> None:
    assert parse_vision_output('{"items": []}').items == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "raw",
    [
        None,
        "",
        "   ",
        "not json",
        "[1,2]",
        '"str"',
        "{}",
        '{"items": "apple"}',
        '{"items": [{"name": ""}]}',
        '{"items": [{"description": "x"}]}',
        '{"items": [{"name": 5}]}',
        json.dumps({"items": [{"name": f"f{i}"} for i in range(16)]}),
        json.dumps({"items": [{"name": "x" * 200}]}),
    ],
)
def test_bad_output_is_rejected_not_repaired(raw: object) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(VisionBadOutputError):
        parse_vision_output(raw)


def test_control_characters_are_stripped() -> None:
    out = parse_vision_output(json.dumps({"items": [{"name": "Dal\u0000\n tadka"}]}))
    assert out.items[0].name == "Dal tadka"

def test_ollama_success_and_never_asks_for_numbers() -> None:
    seen: dict[str, object] = {}

    def handler(req: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        seen.update(json.loads(req.content))
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"message": {"content": '{"items":[{"name":"Idli"}]}'}})

    p = _ollama(httpx.MockTransport(handler))
    assert p.identify(_png()).items[0].name == "Idli"
    assert p.info.external is False
    prompt = json.dumps(seen).lower()
    assert "do not estimate weights" in prompt  # the model is told not to guess quantities
    assert seen["stream"] is False


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("response", "error"),
    [
        (httpx.Response(404, json={"error": "model not found"}), VisionModelMissingError),
        (httpx.Response(429), VisionRateLimitedError),
        (httpx.Response(500), VisionUnavailableError),
        (httpx.Response(200, json={"message": {"content": "banana"}}), VisionBadOutputError),
        (httpx.Response(200, json={"unexpected": 1}), VisionBadOutputError),
        (httpx.Response(200, text="<html>"), VisionBadOutputError),
    ],
)
def test_ollama_errors_map_to_typed_errors(
    response: httpx.Response, error: type[Exception]
) -> None:
    p = _ollama(httpx.MockTransport(lambda r: response))
    with pytest.raises(error):
        p.identify(_png())


def test_ollama_timeout_and_connection_errors() -> None:
    def timeout(req: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        raise httpx.ReadTimeout("slow", request=req)

    def refused(req: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        raise httpx.ConnectError("down", request=req)

    with pytest.raises(VisionTimeoutError):
        _ollama(httpx.MockTransport(timeout)).identify(_png())
    with pytest.raises(VisionUnavailableError):
        _ollama(httpx.MockTransport(refused)).identify(_png())


def test_not_enabled_or_no_model_means_unavailable_and_no_fallback() -> None:
    from app.ai.factory import build_vision_provider

    with pytest.raises(VisionUnavailableError):
        build_vision_provider(Settings())
    with pytest.raises(VisionUnavailableError):
        build_vision_provider(Settings(ollama_enabled=True))


def test_external_provider_needs_explicit_opt_in() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="(?i)external"):
        Settings(
            vision_provider="openai_compatible",
            vision_api_base_url="https://api.example.com/v1",
            vision_api_model="m",
        )


def _openai(
    handler: httpx.MockTransport, base: str = "https://api.example.com/v1"
) -> VisionProvider:
    from app.ai.factory import build_vision_provider

    s = Settings(
        vision_provider="openai_compatible",
        allow_external_ai_providers=True,
        vision_api_base_url=base,
        vision_api_model="m",
        vision_api_key="sk-test-secret",
    )
    return build_vision_provider(s, transport=handler)


def test_openai_compatible_sends_key_and_flags_external() -> None:
    seen: dict[str, str] = {}

    def handler(req: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        seen["auth"] = req.headers.get("authorization", "")
        return httpx.Response(
            200, json={"choices": [{"message": {"content": '{"items":[{"name":"Roti"}]}'}}]}
        )

    p = _openai(httpx.MockTransport(handler))
    assert p.identify(_png()).items[0].name == "Roti"
    assert seen["auth"] == "Bearer sk-test-secret"
    assert p.info.external is True
    local = _openai(httpx.MockTransport(handler), "http://localhost:8080/v1")
    assert local.info.external is False

# ---- signed references ----
def _settings() -> Settings:
    return Settings()


def test_ref_round_trip_and_user_binding() -> None:
    s, u = _settings(), uuid.uuid4()
    token = sign_ref(s, "scan", u, {"a": 1})
    assert verify_ref(s, "scan", u, token) == {"a": 1}
    with pytest.raises(InvalidRefError):
        verify_ref(s, "scan", uuid.uuid4(), token)  # someone else's
    with pytest.raises(InvalidRefError):
        verify_ref(s, "food", u, token)  # wrong kind


def test_tampered_or_garbage_refs_rejected() -> None:
    s, u = _settings(), uuid.uuid4()
    token = sign_ref(s, "food", u, {"v": 100})
    body, _, sig = token.rpartition(".")
    for bad in (body + "." + sig[::-1], "x." + sig, "", "nodot", token[:-3] + "AAA"):
        with pytest.raises(InvalidRefError):
            verify_ref(s, "food", u, bad)


def test_expired_ref_rejected() -> None:
    s, u = _settings(), uuid.uuid4()
    short = s.model_copy(update={"signed_ref_ttl_minutes": -1})
    token = sign_ref(short, "scan", u, {"a": 1})
    with pytest.raises(InvalidRefError):
        verify_ref(short, "scan", u, token)
    _ = timedelta

FILE: docs/adr/0001-auth-session-strategy.md
================================================================================

# ADR 0001: Authentication and session strategy

Status: accepted (Phase 1)

## Decision
- **Access token**: signed JWT (HS256), 15 minutes, held **only in browser memory** and sent as
  `Authorization: Bearer`. It is never written to localStorage/sessionStorage.
- **Refresh token**: random 48-byte opaque value in an **HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure**
  cookie (`fv_refresh`), scoped to `Path=/api/v1/auth`, so the browser sends it only to the auth
  endpoints. 14 days. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored (`refresh_tokens`).
- **Rotation and reuse detection**: every refresh revokes the old token and issues a new one.
  Presenting an already-used token revokes all of that user's refresh tokens.
- **Page reload**: the app calls `POST /auth/refresh` on start to restore the session.
- **Logout**: revokes the presented refresh token and clears the cookie.
- **Passwords**: Argon2id (argon2-cffi defaults), rehash on login when parameters change.
  Login runs a dummy hash for unknown emails and returns one error for all failures.
- **CSRF**: cookie-authenticated endpoints (`refresh`, `logout`) require the custom header
  `X-Requested-With: FoodVerseWeb`. Foreign origins cannot send it without a CORS preflight,
  which the exact-origin allow-list rejects. SameSite=Strict is a second layer. Data endpoints
  use the bearer header, which the cookie cannot satisfy.
- **Development**: Vite proxies `/api` to FastAPI so the cookie is same-origin.

## Why not localStorage JWTs / server sessions
localStorage tokens are readable by any injected script and live for their whole lifetime.
Pure server sessions would work, but the short-lived bearer keeps data endpoints stateless and
leaves room for non-browser clients later.

## Known limitations
- An access token cannot be revoked before it expires (max 15 minutes).
- XSS could still call the API while a page is open; a CSP and dependency hygiene are needed
  (Phase 8). Memory-only storage limits theft, not misuse.
- No rate limiting or lockout yet (Phase 8). Registration reveals whether an email exists (409).
- No email verification or password reset yet.
- No "sign out everywhere" control in the UI (reuse detection does it automatically).
- Expired/revoked refresh rows are not purged yet.

FILE: docs/adr/0002-media-storage.md
================================================================================

# ADR 0002: Media upload and storage

Status: accepted (Phase 2)

## Decisions
- **Images only for now** (JPEG, PNG, WebP). Audio/video are recognised by extension so the
  error says "not enabled yet", but are never accepted until Phase 7 adds their own signature
  checks, decoders and duration probing.
- **Nothing the client sends is trusted.** The file signature (magic bytes) decides the format;
  the extension and declared Content-Type must both agree with it or the upload is rejected.
  The filename is reduced to a display label and is never used in a path.
- **Re-encode, don't store the original.** Pillow fully decodes the image (corrupt or truncated
  files fail), applies EXIF orientation, then re-encodes. EXIF/GPS data and any appended or
  polyglot payload are dropped. Dimensions are checked from the header before decoding
  (`MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS`) to stop decompression bombs.
- **Size limits are enforced while streaming**: a body-size middleware rejects by
  Content-Length up front and counts bytes as they arrive, so a lying or chunked client cannot
  fill memory or temp disk. Per-user quota (`USER_MEDIA_QUOTA_BYTES`) bounds total storage.
- **Storage names are server-generated** (`ab/<uuid>.<ext>`); `LocalStorage` re-validates each
  key against a strict pattern and checks the resolved path stays under its root. Writes are
  atomic (temp file + rename), directories 0700, files 0600.
- **Location**: `MEDIA_ROOT` (default `~/.foodverse/media`) is outside the repository and is
  never served statically. Files are only reachable through the API.
- **Ownership**: every read, download, metadata fetch and delete goes through
  `get_owned_or_404`. Another user's or a missing id returns the same 404.
- **Delivery**: `GET /media/{id}/content` requires the bearer token, so the UI fetches bytes
  with `fetch` and shows them via object URLs. Responses carry the detected content type,
  `nosniff`, `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and a sandboxing CSP.
- **Abstraction**: services depend on the `StorageBackend` protocol (put/open/delete/exists).
  An S3-compatible backend can implement it later without touching routes or services.
- **Metadata** (`media_assets`): owner, kind, content type, storage key, size, SHA-256,
  width/height, duration (null for images), display name, created time.
- **History** (`analysis_records`): module, status, title, optional media link
  (`ON DELETE SET NULL`), JSON result. No code creates records yet; nothing is seeded.

## Known limitations
- Deleting a user row cascades to `media_assets` but does not delete files (no account
  deletion feature yet). A cleanup job/endpoint is needed when that ships.
- If the process dies between the file write and the database commit, an orphan file can remain
  (normal failures are cleaned up). A periodic orphan sweep is not implemented.
- No antivirus scanning; re-encoding is the mitigation for images.
- Upload progress is not shown (plain `fetch`).

FILE: docs/adr/0003-food-recognition-and-nutrition.md
================================================================================

# ADR 0003: Food recognition and nutrition analysis

Status: accepted (Phase 3)

## Principle
**The model identifies candidates; the user confirms them; trusted data supplies nutrient values;
deterministic code calculates totals.** No language or vision model ever produces, estimates or
adjusts a nutrition number, a portion weight or a confidence score.

## Flow
1. `POST /food/scan` sends one of the user's own stored photos to the configured vision provider.
   The prompt forbids weights, calories and guessing; output must match a JSON schema.
2. `parse_vision_output` validates the reply. Anything malformed (bad JSON, wrong shape, too many
   items, empty names) is **rejected, never repaired**, and the user gets a 502.
3. The response carries `scan_ref`, an HMAC-signed, user-bound, expiring token that holds what the
   model actually said. The browser cannot alter it, and it is what gets stored for the audit trail.
4. The user edits the list (rename, add, remove), searches `GET /nutrition/search`, and picks a
   match. Each candidate is returned with a signed `food_ref` (frozen source record, per 100 g).
5. `POST /food/calculate` accepts only `{name, observed_id?, food_ref?, portion}` per item. Client
   supplied nutrient numbers are rejected (`extra=forbid`); a tampered, expired or foreign
   `food_ref`/`scan_ref` returns 422 `invalid_reference`.
6. `POST /meals` repeats the calculation server-side and stores the complete audit JSON
   (items, source records with attribution, portions, per-item and total values, warnings, model
   observations) as an `analysis_records` row plus a `meal_logs` row that shares its primary key,
   so meals appear in History and deleting either deletes both.

## Vision providers
Exactly one, chosen by configuration, with **no fallback**: Ollama (`OLLAMA_ENABLED`,
`OLLAMA_VISION_MODEL`) or an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` server (`VISION_PROVIDER=
openai_compatible`, refused unless `ALLOW_EXTERNAL_AI_PROVIDERS=true`). The UI discloses when a
photo would leave the machine (`external`). Nothing is downloaded automatically.

## Nutrition sources (per 100 g, all optional)
- **USDA FoodData Central** (`USDA_FDC_API_KEY`): Foundation + SR Legacy only, because those are
  published per 100 g. The key stays server-side; the httpx logger is pinned to WARNING so the
  key in the query string is never logged.
- **Open Food Facts** (`OPEN_FOOD_FACTS_ENABLED=true`): packaged foods and barcode lookup. kJ-only
  energy is converted (1 kcal = 4.184 kJ) and the conversion is noted; sodium g -> mg.
- **Local reference table** (`reference_foods`): empty by default. Operators import a CSV they
  are licensed to use (`python -m app.nutrition.import_reference`), which requires dataset,
  version, citation and licence note for every row. An empty cell means *not reported*, not 0.
  No IFCT values are bundled or typed from memory.

A nutrient a source does not supply is absent everywhere (never defaulted to 0). Values outside
plausible bounds are treated as malformed and dropped. Each source reports a status
(`ok | not_configured | unavailable | rate_limited | timeout`), so partial outages are visible.

## Calculation (`app/domain/nutrition_calc.py`)
`Decimal` arithmetic: `nutrient_per_100g x grams / 100`, rounded half-up to 2 dp once at output.
Units: g, kg, oz, lb. Volumes (cup, ml) are **rejected** because they depend on density. A range
portion gives low-high and is flagged as an estimate; "servings" are accepted only when the
source states a serving weight in grams. Totals sum only items that reported the nutrient and
state `complete=false` plus the missing item names otherwise.

## Limits and abuse controls
Per-user in-process sliding windows (scan 6/min, search 30/min); a size cap on images sent to the
model; item caps (15 detected, 30 per meal); 5000 g per item. Limits reset on restart and are not
shared between workers (a shared store is planned for Phase 9).

## Consequences
- Accuracy depends on the chosen vision model and on the user's portion entries; the UI says so.
- Saved meals keep the source record they were calculated from, so later changes upstream do not
  silently rewrite history; editing a meal can re-pick a source.
- Barcode lookup exists in the API but has no UI yet.

FILE: docs/adr/0004-freshness-assessment.md
================================================================================

# ADR 0004: Freshness and spoilage-sign assessment

Status: accepted (Phase 4)

## Context
Users want to know whether food that looks off is still fine to eat. A photo cannot answer that:
microbes, toxins and many spoilage processes are invisible, and a vision model can be wrong or
swayed by text in the image. Telling a user "this is safe" would be the most harmful possible output.

## Decision
**The model reports evidence only; fixed code decides the label and the advice.**

1. **Model contract.** The vision provider is asked (same configurable provider as Phase 3, via
   `complete_json`) for: image quality, whether food is visible, whether it matches the food the
   user confirmed, and a list of visible observations (feature, description, location, severity,
   certainty), plus limitations and a short note. The schema is strict. Malformed output is a 502
   and nothing is saved. There is no score or percentage anywhere.
2. **Verdict filter.** Free text from the model containing safety-verdict language (safe, unsafe,
   edible, "ok to eat", percentages, "score") is replaced with a fixed placeholder and counted
   (`withheld_text_count`), which the UI discloses.
3. **Label (deterministic, `app/domain/freshness.py`).** `inconclusive` if there is no analysis,
   no food visible, an unusable image, or the image does not match the confirmed food;
   `visible concern observed` if any observation exists; `no obvious visible concern in this image`
   only for a clear, matching image with no observations. These describe one image; none means safe.
4. **Advice (deterministic, fixed reviewed text).** Levels `discard_recommended`, `use_caution`,
   `general_caution`. Discard is triggered by mold-like growth, any concern on high-risk food
   (meat/poultry, fish/seafood, dairy/eggs, cooked food), more than 2 h at room temperature for
   high-risk food, cooked food in the fridge over 96 h, or a passed use-by date on high-risk food.
   Every result carries the reminder that spoilage can be invisible. Sources are linked
   (foodsafety.gov, fsis.usda.gov). Rules are commonly published advice and differ by country.
5. **Offline mode.** `analyze_image=false` never contacts a model, so guidance works when the AI
   provider is down or unconfigured. The record states that the photo was not analysed.
6. **Persistence.** One `analysis_records` row (audit JSON, module `freshness`) plus a
   `freshness_assessments` row sharing its primary key. Owner-only access (404 otherwise),
   deletion cascades, history lists and filters by label.
7. **Classifier.** No trained freshness classifier is shipped or configurable. Only a `Protocol`
   and a documentation gate exist; one could be added if a model with published validation
   evidence is found. `classifier_result` is always null.

## Consequences / residual risks
- Text embedded in a photo could try to steer the model. Mitigations: the prompt tells it to ignore
  such text, the output schema is strict, verdict language is withheld, and the label and advice
  never depend on model prose. A manipulated model could still under-report observations; the
  guidance and "cannot show safety" notes are shown regardless.
- Not tested against a real vision model in this phase.
- Rate limiting is in-process and shared with scan; cancelling in the browser does not stop
  server-side processing.

import { Navigate, Route, Routes } from "react-router-dom";
import { Layout } from "./components/Layout";
import { ProtectedRoute, PublicOnlyRoute } from "./auth/ProtectedRoute";
import { DashboardPage } from "./pages/DashboardPage";
import { FoodPage } from "./pages/FoodPage";
import { FreshnessDetailPage } from "./pages/FreshnessDetailPage";
import { FreshnessHistoryPage } from "./pages/FreshnessHistoryPage";
import { FreshnessPage } from "./pages/FreshnessPage";
import { HistoryPage } from "./pages/HistoryPage";
import { LoginPage } from "./pages/LoginPage";
import { MealDetailPage, MealEditPage } from "./pages/MealDetailPage";
import { MealsPage } from "./pages/MealsPage";
import { MediaPage } from "./pages/MediaPage";
import { ModuleDetailPage, ModulesPage } from "./pages/ModulesPage";
import { RegisterPage } from "./pages/RegisterPage";
import { SettingsPage } from "./pages/SettingsPage";
import { HygienePage } from "./pages/HygienePage";
import { HygieneHistoryPage } from "./pages/HygieneHistoryPage";
import { HygieneDetailPage } from "./pages/HygieneDetailPage";
import { CookingPage } from "./pages/CookingPage";
import { RecipesPage } from "./pages/RecipesPage";
import { RecipeDetailPage } from "./pages/RecipeDetailPage";


export function App() {
  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route element={<PublicOnlyRoute />}>
        <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
        <Route path="/register" element={<RegisterPage />} />
      </Route>
      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute />}>
        <Route element={<Layout />}>
          <Route index element={<DashboardPage />} />
          <Route path="/modules" element={<ModulesPage />} />
          <Route path="/cooking" element={<CookingPage />} />
          <Route path="/recipes" element={<RecipesPage />} />
          <Route path="/recipes/:id" element={<RecipeDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="/modules/:key" element={<ModuleDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="/food" element={<FoodPage />} />
          <Route path="/freshness" element={<FreshnessPage />} />
          <Route path="/freshness/history" element={<FreshnessHistoryPage />} />
          <Route path="/freshness/:id" element={<FreshnessDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="/meals" element={<MealsPage />} />
          <Route path="/meals/:id" element={<MealDetailPage />} />
          <Route path="/meals/:id/edit" element={<MealEditPage />} />
          <Route path="/history" element={<HistoryPage />} />
          <Route path="/media" element={<MediaPage />} />
          <Route path="/settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
          <Route path="/preferences" element={<Navigate to="/settings" replace />} />
          <Route path="/hygiene" element={<HygienePage />} />
          <Route path="/hygiene/history" element={<HygieneHistoryPage />} />
          <Route path="/hygiene/:id" element={<HygieneDetailPage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>
      <Route path="*" element={<p className="center-note">Page not found.</p>} />
    </Routes>
  );
}
