import type { AuthResponse } from "./types";

/**
 * API client.
 *
 * Session strategy (see docs/adr/0001-auth-session-strategy.md): the short-lived access token
 * lives only in this module's memory; the long-lived refresh token is an HttpOnly cookie that
 * JavaScript can never read. Nothing secret is written to localStorage or sessionStorage.
 */

const API_PREFIX = "/api/v1";
const CSRF_HEADERS = { "X-Requested-With": "FoodVerseWeb" };

export interface ApiErrorDetail {
  field: string;
  message: string;
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number;
  code: string;
  details: ApiErrorDetail[] | null;
  requestId: string | null;

  constructor(
    status: number,
    code: string,
    message: string,
    details: ApiErrorDetail[] | null = null,
    requestId: string | null = null,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
    this.details = details;
    this.requestId = requestId;
  }
}

let accessToken: string | null = null;
let refreshInFlight: Promise<AuthResponse | null> | null = null;
let onSessionLost: (() => void) | null = null;

export function setAccessToken(token: string | null): void {
  accessToken = token;
}

export function setSessionLostHandler(handler: (() => void) | null): void {
  onSessionLost = handler;
}

interface RequestOptions {
  method?: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "PATCH" | "DELETE";
  /** A plain object is sent as JSON; a FormData is sent as multipart (browser sets the boundary). */
  body?: unknown;
  /** Attach the access token and refresh once on 401. Auth endpoints pass false. */
  authenticated?: boolean;
  /** Lets the caller cancel a slow request (e.g. a photo analysis). */
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

async function send(path: string, options: RequestOptions, token: string | null): Promise<Response> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { ...CSRF_HEADERS };
  const isForm = options.body instanceof FormData;
  if (options.body !== undefined && !isForm) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  if (token && options.authenticated !== false) headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  let body: BodyInit | undefined;
  if (options.body !== undefined) body = isForm ? (options.body as FormData) : JSON.stringify(options.body);
  return fetch(`${API_PREFIX}${path}`, {
    method: options.method ?? "GET",
    headers,
    credentials: "include",
    body,
    signal: options.signal,
  });
}

async function toApiError(response: Response): Promise<ApiError> {
  try {
    const data = (await response.json()) as {
      error?: { code?: string; message?: string; details?: ApiErrorDetail[] | null; request_id?: string | null };
    };
    const err = data.error;
    if (err) {
      return new ApiError(
        response.status,
        err.code ?? "http_error",
        err.message ?? "Request failed.",
        err.details ?? null,
        err.request_id ?? null,
      );
    }
  } catch {
    // fall through: body was not JSON
  }
  return new ApiError(response.status, "http_error", "Request failed.");
}

/** Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token. Concurrent callers share one request. */
export function refreshSession(): Promise<AuthResponse | null> {
  if (!refreshInFlight) {
    refreshInFlight = (async () => {
      try {
        const response = await send("/auth/refresh", { method: "POST", authenticated: false }, null);
        if (!response.ok) {
          accessToken = null;
          return null;
        }
        const data = (await response.json()) as AuthResponse;
        accessToken = data.access_token;
        return data;
      } catch {
        accessToken = null;
        return null;
      } finally {
        refreshInFlight = null;
      }
    })();
  }
  return refreshInFlight;
}

/** Send a request, refreshing the session once on 401. Resolves only for 2xx responses. */
async function execute(path: string, options: RequestOptions): Promise<Response> {
  let response = await send(path, options, accessToken);

  if (response.status === 401 && options.authenticated !== false) {
    const refreshed = await refreshSession();
    if (!refreshed) {
      onSessionLost?.();
      throw await toApiError(response);
    }
    response = await send(path, options, accessToken);
  }

  if (!response.ok) throw await toApiError(response);
  return response;
}

export async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  const response = await execute(path, options);
  if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T;
  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

/** Fetch a protected binary (e.g. an image). <img src> cannot send the bearer token. */
export async function requestBlob(path: string): Promise<Blob> {
  return (await execute(path, {})).blob();
}

function xhrUpload<T>(
  path: string,
  form: FormData,
  token: string | null,
  onProgress: (fraction: number) => void,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<{ status: number; body: T | null; error: ApiError | null }> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open("POST", `${API_PREFIX}${path}`);
    xhr.withCredentials = true;
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(CSRF_HEADERS)) xhr.setRequestHeader(name, value);
    if (token) xhr.setRequestHeader("Authorization", `Bearer ${token}`);
    xhr.upload.onprogress = (e) => {
      if (e.lengthComputable && e.total > 0) onProgress(e.loaded / e.total);
    };
    xhr.onerror = () => reject(new TypeError("network error"));
    xhr.onabort = () => reject(new DOMException("Upload cancelled", "AbortError"));
    xhr.onload = () => {
      let parsed: unknown = null;
      try {
        parsed = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
      } catch {
        // not JSON
      }
      if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
        resolve({ status: xhr.status, body: parsed as T, error: null });
        return;
      }
      const err = (parsed as { error?: { code?: string; message?: string; details?: ApiErrorDetail[] | null; request_id?: string | null } } | null)?.error;
      resolve({
        status: xhr.status,
        body: null,
        error: new ApiError(xhr.status, err?.code ?? "http_error", err?.message ?? "Request failed.", err?.details ?? null, err?.request_id ?? null),
      });
    };
    signal?.addEventListener("abort", () => xhr.abort(), { once: true });
    xhr.send(form);
  });
}

/**
 * Multipart upload with real byte-level progress (fetch cannot report upload progress).
 * Same session rules as request(): bearer token, one refresh on 401.
 */
export async function requestUpload<T>(
  path: string,
  form: FormData,
  onProgress: (fraction: number) => void,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<T> {
  let result = await xhrUpload<T>(path, form, accessToken, onProgress, signal);
  if (result.status === 401) {
    const refreshed = await refreshSession();
    if (!refreshed) {
      onSessionLost?.();
      throw result.error ?? new ApiError(401, "not_authenticated", "Please sign in again.");
    }
    result = await xhrUpload<T>(path, form, accessToken, onProgress, signal);
  }
  if (result.error) throw result.error;
  return result.body as T;
}

export async function requestText(path: string): Promise<string> {
  const response = await execute(path, {});
  return response.text();
}

export async function login(email: string, password: string): Promise<AuthResponse> {
  const data = await request<AuthResponse>("/auth/login", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { email, password },
    authenticated: false,
  });
  setAccessToken(data.access_token);
  return data;
}

export async function register(
  displayName: string,
  email: string,
  password: string,
): Promise<AuthResponse> {
  const data = await request<AuthResponse>("/auth/register", {
    method: "POST",
    body: { display_name: displayName, email, password },
    authenticated: false,
  });
  setAccessToken(data.access_token);
  return data;
}

export async function logout(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await request<void>("/auth/logout", { method: "POST", authenticated: false });
  } finally {
    setAccessToken(null);
  }
}

FILE: frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx
================================================================================

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import * as api from "../api/endpoints";
import { refreshSession, setAccessToken, setSessionLostHandler } from "../api/client";
import type { User } from "../api/types";

type AuthState =
  | { status: "loading"; user: null }
  | { status: "anonymous"; user: null }
  | { status: "authenticated"; user: User };

interface AuthContextValue {
  state: AuthState;
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  register: (displayName: string, email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  /** Replace the signed-in user's details after a profile edit. */
  updateUser: (user: User) => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<AuthState>({ status: "loading", user: null });

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setSessionLostHandler(() => setState({ status: "anonymous", user: null }));
    // Restore an existing session from the HttpOnly refresh cookie (no token is persisted).
    void refreshSession().then((result) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      setState(
        result
          ? { status: "authenticated", user: result.user }
          : { status: "anonymous", user: null },
      );
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      setSessionLostHandler(null);
    };
  }, []);

  const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
    const data = await api.login(email, password);
    setState({ status: "authenticated", user: data.user });
  }, []);

  const register = useCallback(async (displayName: string, email: string, password: string) => {
    const data = await api.register(displayName, email, password);
    setState({ status: "authenticated", user: data.user });
  }, []);

  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await api.logout();
    } catch {
      // The server could not be reached, so the refresh cookie may still be valid until it
      // expires. The user is still signed out locally below.
    } finally {
      setAccessToken(null);
      setState({ status: "anonymous", user: null });
    }
  }, []);

  const updateUser = useCallback((user: User) => setState({ status: "authenticated", user }), []);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ state, login, register, logout, updateUser }),
    [state, login, register, logout, updateUser],
  );
  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useAuth must be used inside <AuthProvider>");
  return ctx;
}

import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "./AuthContext";

export function ProtectedRoute() {
  const { state } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  if (state.status === "loading") return <p className="center-note" role="status">Loading…</p>;
  if (state.status === "anonymous") {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: location.pathname }} />;
  }
  return <Outlet />;
}

export function PublicOnlyRoute() {
  const { state } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  if (state.status === "loading") return <p className="center-note" role="status">Loading…</p>;
  if (state.status === "authenticated") {
    const from = (location.state as { from?: string } | null)?.from;
    return <Navigate to={from && from.startsWith("/") ? from : "/"} replace />;
  }
  return <Outlet />;
}

import { useCallback } from "react";
import { getMediaBlob } from "../api/endpoints";
import { useBlobUrl } from "../hooks/useBlobUrl";

/** <img> for a protected media file: fetched with the bearer token, shown via an object URL. */
export function AuthImage({ mediaId, alt, className }: { mediaId: string; alt: string; className?: string }) {
  const load = useCallback(() => getMediaBlob(mediaId), [mediaId]);
  const { url, failed } = useBlobUrl(load);
  if (failed) return <div className={`img-fallback ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={`${alt} (could not be loaded)`}>Unavailable</div>;
  if (!url) return <div className={`img-skeleton ${className ?? ""}`} aria-hidden="true" />;
  return <img src={url} alt={alt} className={className} loading="lazy" />;
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/ConfirmDialog.tsx
================================================================================

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  confirmLabel: string;
  /** Runs when confirmed. The dialog stays open (and disabled) until it settles. */
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void> | void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

/**
 * Accessible modal confirmation: focus moves to the safe (Cancel) button, Tab is trapped,
 * Escape cancels, and focus returns to whatever opened it.
 */
export function ConfirmDialog({ open, title, message, confirmLabel, onConfirm, onCancel }: Props) {
  const titleId = useId();
  const descId = useId();
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const cancelRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const opener = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    cancelRef.current?.focus();
    return () => opener?.focus?.();
  }, [open]);

  if (!open) return null;

  function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && !busy) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      onCancel();
      return;
    }
    if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
    const focusable = dialogRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("button:not([disabled])");
    if (!focusable || focusable.length === 0) return;
    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
      e.preventDefault();
      last.focus();
    } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
      e.preventDefault();
      first.focus();
    }
  }

  async function confirm() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await onConfirm();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="overlay" onMouseDown={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && !busy && onCancel()}>
      <div ref={dialogRef} className="dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby={titleId} aria-describedby={descId} onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
        <h2 id={titleId}>{title}</h2>
        <p id={descId}>{message}</p>
        <div className="dialog-actions">
          <button ref={cancelRef} type="button" className="secondary" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="button" className="danger" onClick={confirm} disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? "Working…" : confirmLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/FormError.tsx

import { ApiError } from "../api/client";

/** Turn any thrown error into a user-facing message without leaking internals. */
export function errorMessage(err: unknown): string {
  if (err instanceof ApiError) {
    if (err.code === "validation_error" && err.details?.length) {
      return err.details.map((d) => `${d.field ? d.field + ": " : ""}${d.message}`).join(" ");
    }
    return err.message;
  }
  return "Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.";
}

export function FormError({ message }: { message: string | null }) {
  if (!message) return null;
  return (
    <p className="alert error" role="alert">
      {message}
    </p>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/PhotoPicker.tsx

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ChangeEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { FormError } from "./FormError";
import { formatBytes } from "../lib/format";

export const ALLOWED_PHOTO_TYPES = ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"];

/**
 * Choose, capture, preview, replace and remove one photo. Validation here is fast feedback only:
 * the server re-checks the real file content. Remount it (change `key`) to reset it.
 */
export function PhotoPicker({
  onChange,
  disabled = false,
  hint,
}: {
  onChange: (file: File | null) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  hint?: ReactNode;
}) {
  const [photo, setPhotoState] = useState<{ file: File; url: string } | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const photoRef = useRef(photo);
  const libraryRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const cameraRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // The preview object URL is created in the event handler (not an effect) and revoked on
  // replace/unmount.
  function setPhoto(next: File | null) {
    if (photoRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(photoRef.current.url);
    const value = next ? { file: next, url: URL.createObjectURL(next) } : null;
    photoRef.current = value;
    setPhotoState(value);
    onChange(next);
  }

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (photoRef.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(photoRef.current.url);
    },
    [],
  );

  function onPick(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const picked = e.target.files?.[0] ?? null;
    e.target.value = ""; // allow re-picking the same file after removing it
    if (!picked) return;
    setError(null);
    if (!ALLOWED_PHOTO_TYPES.includes(picked.type)) {
      setPhoto(null);
      setError("Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.");
      return;
    }
    if (picked.size === 0) {
      setPhoto(null);
      setError("That file is empty.");
      return;
    }
    setPhoto(picked);
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {photo ? (
        <figure className="preview">
          <img src={photo.url} alt="Preview of the selected photo" />
          <figcaption className="small-text muted">
            {photo.file.name} · {formatBytes(photo.file.size)}
          </figcaption>
        </figure>
      ) : (
        <p className="muted">No photo selected.</p>
      )}
      <div className="row wrap">
        <input ref={libraryRef} type="file" accept={ALLOWED_PHOTO_TYPES.join(",")} onChange={onPick}
          className="visually-hidden" aria-label="Choose a photo" disabled={disabled} />
        <input ref={cameraRef} type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment" onChange={onPick}
          className="visually-hidden" aria-label="Take a photo" disabled={disabled} />
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => libraryRef.current?.click()}>
          {photo ? "Replace photo" : "Choose a photo"}
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => cameraRef.current?.click()}>
          Take a photo
        </button>
        {photo && (
          <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => { setError(null); setPhoto(null); }}>
            Remove photo
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {hint && <p className="hint">{hint}</p>}
      <FormError message={error} />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/PreferencesForm.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { getPreferenceOptions, getPreferences, updatePreferences } from "../api/endpoints";
import type { PreferenceOptions, UnitSystem } from "../api/types";
import { FormError, errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { Card, Loading } from "../components/ui";

const LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  gluten_free: "Gluten-free",
  lactose_free: "Lactose-free",
};
const label = (v: string) => LABELS[v] ?? v.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + v.slice(1);

export function PreferencesForm() {
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<PreferenceOptions | null>(null);
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState<UnitSystem>("metric");
  const [diet, setDiet] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [allergies, setAllergies] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [newAllergy, setNewAllergy] = useState("");
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    Promise.all([getPreferenceOptions(), getPreferences()])
      .then(([opts, prefs]) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setOptions(opts);
        setUnit(prefs.unit_system);
        setDiet(prefs.dietary_preferences);
        setAllergies(prefs.allergies);
      })
      .catch((e) => !cancelled && setLoadError(errorMessage(e)));
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const toggle = (list: string[], value: string) =>
    list.includes(value) ? list.filter((x) => x !== value) : [...list, value];

  function addAllergy() {
    const value = newAllergy.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ").toLowerCase();
    if (value && !allergies.includes(value)) setAllergies([...allergies, value]);
    setNewAllergy("");
    setSaved(false);
  }

  async function handleSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaveError(null);
    setSaved(false);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const result = await updatePreferences({
        unit_system: unit,
        dietary_preferences: diet,
        allergies,
      });
      setUnit(result.unit_system);
      setDiet(result.dietary_preferences);
      setAllergies(result.allergies);
      setSaved(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setSaveError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (loadError) return <p className="alert error" role="alert">{loadError}</p>;
  if (!options) return <Loading label="Loading preferences…" />;

  const suggestions = options.common_allergens.filter((a) => !allergies.includes(a));

  return (
    <Card title="Food preferences" headingId="prefs-heading">
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} onChange={() => setSaved(false)}>
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Units</legend>
          {options.unit_systems.map((u) => (
            <label key={u} className="inline">
              <input type="radio" name="unit" value={u} checked={unit === u}
                onChange={() => setUnit(u)} />
              {label(u)}
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset>
          <legend>Dietary preferences</legend>
          {options.dietary_preferences.map((d) => (
            <label key={d} className="inline">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={diet.includes(d)}
                onChange={() => setDiet(toggle(diet, d))} />
              {label(d)}
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset>
          <legend>Allergies</legend>
          <p className="hint">
            Declared by you and used only to flag foods. Always check packaging and ask when eating
            out; this app cannot guarantee a food is allergen-free.
          </p>
          <ul className="chips" aria-label="Your allergies">
            {allergies.length === 0 && <li className="hint">None added</li>}
            {allergies.map((a) => (
              <li key={a}>
                {a}
                <button type="button" className="chip-remove" aria-label={`Remove ${a}`}
                  onClick={() => { setAllergies(allergies.filter((x) => x !== a)); setSaved(false); }}>
                  ×
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <div className="row">
            <label htmlFor="new-allergy" className="visually-hidden">Add an allergy</label>
            <input id="new-allergy" value={newAllergy} maxLength={50} placeholder="e.g. peanut"
              onChange={(e) => setNewAllergy(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); addAllergy(); } }} />
            <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={addAllergy}>Add</button>
          </div>
          {suggestions.length > 0 && (
            <p className="hint">
              Common:{" "}
              {suggestions.map((s) => (
                <button key={s} type="button" className="link"
                  onClick={() => { setAllergies([...allergies, s]); setSaved(false); }}>
                  {s}
                </button>
              ))}
            </p>
          )}
        </fieldset>

        <FormError message={saveError} />
        {saved && <p className="alert ok" role="status">Preferences saved.</p>}
        <button type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Saving…" : "Save preferences"}</button>
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/Toast.tsx

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

interface ToastItem {
  id: number;
  tone: "success" | "error";
  message: string;
}

interface ToastApi {
  success: (message: string) => void;
  error: (message: string) => void;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastApi | null>(null);

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ToastItem[]>([]);
  const nextId = useRef(1);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id: number) => setItems((cur) => cur.filter((t) => t.id !== id)), []);

  const push = useCallback(
    (tone: ToastItem["tone"], message: string) => {
      const id = nextId.current++;
      setItems((cur) => [...cur.slice(-3), { id, tone, message }]);
      // Successes fade on their own; errors stay until dismissed so they are not missed.
      if (tone === "success") window.setTimeout(() => dismiss(id), 5000);
    },
    [dismiss],
  );

  const api = useMemo<ToastApi>(
    () => ({ success: (m) => push("success", m), error: (m) => push("error", m) }),
    [push],
  );

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={api}>
      {children}
      <div className="toasts" aria-label="Notifications">
        {items.map((t) => (
          <div key={t.id} className={`toast ${t.tone}`} role={t.tone === "error" ? "alert" : "status"}>
            <span>{t.message}</span>
            <button type="button" className="toast-close" aria-label="Dismiss notification" onClick={() => dismiss(t.id)}>
              ×
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast(): ToastApi {
  const ctx = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useToast must be used inside <ToastProvider>");
  return ctx;
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { errorMessage } from "./FormError";

export function PageHeader({
  title,
  description,
  actions,
}: {
  title: string;
  description?: ReactNode;
  actions?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <header className="page-header">
      <div>
        <h1>{title}</h1>
        {description && <p className="lede">{description}</p>}
      </div>
      {actions && <div className="page-actions">{actions}</div>}
    </header>
  );
}

export function Card({
  title,
  headingId,
  children,
  className = "",
}: {
  title?: string;
  headingId?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <section className={`card ${className}`.trim()} aria-labelledby={title ? headingId : undefined}>
      {title && <h2 id={headingId}>{title}</h2>}
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

export function Badge({ tone = "neutral", children }: { tone?: "neutral" | "ok" | "warn"; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <span className={`badge badge-${tone}`}>{children}</span>;
}

export function EmptyState({
  title,
  description,
  action,
}: {
  title: string;
  description?: ReactNode;
  action?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="empty" role="status">
      <p className="empty-title">{title}</p>
      {description && <p className="muted">{description}</p>}
      {action}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ErrorState({ error, onRetry }: { error: unknown; onRetry?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="alert error" role="alert">
      <p>{errorMessage(error)}</p>
      {onRetry && (
        <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={onRetry}>
          Try again
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Loading({ label = "Loading…" }: { label?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="loading" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
      <span>{label}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Pagination({
  page,
  pages,
  onChange,
}: {
  page: number;
  pages: number;
  onChange: (page: number) => void;
}) {
  if (pages <= 1) return null;
  return (
    <nav className="pagination" aria-label="Pagination">
      <button type="button" className="secondary small" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => onChange(page - 1)}>
        Previous
      </button>
      <span aria-live="polite">
        Page {page} of {pages}
      </span>
      <button type="button" className="secondary small" disabled={page >= pages} onClick={() => onChange(page + 1)}>
        Next
      </button>
    </nav>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { favoriteRecipe, saveRecipe } from "../../api/endpoints";
import type { Recipe } from "../../api/types";
import { useToast } from "../Toast";
import { errorMessage } from "../FormError";
import { Badge, Card } from "../ui";

export function RecipeView({
  recipe, onSaved, onDeleted,
}: {
  recipe: Recipe;
  onSaved: (next: Recipe) => void;
  onDeleted: () => void;
}) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<"save" | "favorite" | null>(null);

  async function doSave() {
    setBusy("save");
    try {
      onSaved(await saveRecipe(recipe.id));
      toast.success("Recipe saved.");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }
  async function doFavorite(next: boolean) {
    setBusy("favorite");
    try {
      onSaved(await favoriteRecipe(recipe.id, next));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }
  void onDeleted;

  return (
    <Card title={recipe.title} headingId={`recipe-${recipe.id}`}>
      <p className="small-text muted">
        {recipe.description}
      </p>
      <p className="small-text">
        <Badge tone={recipe.status === "saved" ? "ok" : "neutral"}>
          {recipe.status === "saved" ? "Saved" : "Suggestion (not saved yet)"}
        </Badge>
        {" "}
        <Badge>{recipe.servings} servings</Badge>
        {recipe.total_minutes !== null && <>{" "}<Badge>{recipe.total_minutes} min total</Badge></>}
        {recipe.provider && <>{" "}<Badge>Generated by {recipe.provider.model}</Badge></>}
      </p>

      <p className="alert info" role="note">{recipe.context_note}</p>
      {recipe.allergen_warnings.length > 0 && (
        <div className="alert warn">
          <p><strong>Allergen and cross-contact warnings</strong></p>
          <ul className="plain-list">{recipe.allergen_warnings.map((w, i) => <li key={i}>{w}</li>)}</ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {recipe.dietary_tags.length > 0 && (
        <p className="small-text">Tags: {recipe.dietary_tags.join(", ")}. <span className="muted">{recipe.allergy_note}</span></p>
      )}

      {recipe.equipment.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <h3>Equipment</h3>
          <ul className="plain-list">{recipe.equipment.map((e, i) => <li key={i}>{e}</li>)}</ul>
        </>
      )}

      <h3>Ingredients</h3>
      <ul className="plain-list">
        {recipe.ingredients.map((ing, i) => (
          <li key={i}>
            {ing.quantity !== null && <strong>{ing.quantity} {ing.unit ?? ""}</strong>}{" "}
            {ing.name}
            {ing.note ? <> <span className="muted">({ing.note})</span></> : null}
            {ing.optional ? <> <em className="muted">— optional</em></> : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>

      <h3>Method</h3>
      <ol className="plain-list">
        {recipe.steps.map((s) => (
          <li key={s.number}>
            {s.instruction}
            {s.duration_minutes !== null && <> <span className="muted">({s.duration_minutes} min)</span></>}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>

      {recipe.substitutions.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <h3>Substitutions</h3>
          <ul className="plain-list">
            {recipe.substitutions.map((s, i) => (
              <li key={i}>{s.ingredient} → {s.alternative}{s.note ? ` (${s.note})` : ""}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </>
      )}

      {recipe.safety_notes.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <h3>Safety notes</h3>
          <ul className="plain-list">{recipe.safety_notes.map((n, i) => <li key={i}>{n}</li>)}</ul>
        </>
      )}
      {recipe.beginner_notes.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <h3>Beginner notes</h3>
          <ul className="plain-list">{recipe.beginner_notes.map((n, i) => <li key={i}>{n}</li>)}</ul>
        </>
      )}
      {recipe.tips.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <h3>Tips</h3>
          <ul className="plain-list">{recipe.tips.map((t, i) => <li key={i}>{t}</li>)}</ul>
        </>
      )}

      {recipe.nutrition ? (
        <section aria-label="Nutrition (verified)">
          <h3>Nutrition (linked to verified food data)</h3>
          <p className="small-text muted">{recipe.nutrition.basis}. {recipe.nutrition.note}</p>
          <table className="nutrient-table compact">
            <caption className="visually-hidden">Per serving</caption>
            <tbody>
              {Object.values(recipe.nutrition.per_serving).map((t) =>
                t.low === null || t.high === null ? null : (
                  <tr key={t.key}>
                    <th scope="row">{t.label}</th>
                    <td>{t.low === t.high ? `${t.low} ${t.unit}` : `${t.low}–${t.high} ${t.unit}`}</td>
                  </tr>
                ),
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          <p className="small-text">
            <Link to={`/recipes/${recipe.id}`}>Open this recipe</Link> for the full nutrient breakdown and to link more ingredients.
          </p>
        </section>
      ) : (
        <p className="small-text muted">
          No nutrition numbers are shown: the model does not estimate them. Open the saved recipe to link
          ingredients to verified food data.
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="stacked-actions">
        {recipe.status === "suggested" && (
          <button type="button" onClick={doSave} disabled={busy !== null}>
            {busy === "save" ? "Saving…" : "Save this recipe"}
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          className="secondary"
          onClick={() => doFavorite(!recipe.favorite)}
          disabled={busy !== null}
        >
          {recipe.favorite ? "Unfavorite" : "Favorite"}
        </button>
        <Link className="button-link secondary" to={`/recipes/${recipe.id}`}>Open</Link>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/food/FoodSearch.tsx

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { searchFoods } from "../../api/endpoints";
import type { FoodCandidate, NutritionSearchResponse } from "../../api/types";
import { FormError, errorMessage } from "../FormError";

const STATE_TEXT: Record<string, string> = {
  not_configured: "not set up on this server",
  unavailable: "unavailable right now",
  rate_limited: "rate limited, try again shortly",
  timeout: "timed out",
};

function summary(c: FoodCandidate): string {
  const bits: string[] = [];
  const v = c.per_100g;
  if (v.energy_kcal !== undefined) bits.push(`${v.energy_kcal} kcal`);
  if (v.protein_g !== undefined) bits.push(`${v.protein_g} g protein`);
  if (v.carbs_g !== undefined) bits.push(`${v.carbs_g} g carbs`);
  if (v.fat_g !== undefined) bits.push(`${v.fat_g} g fat`);
  return bits.length ? `Per 100 g: ${bits.join(", ")}` : "No core nutrients reported";
}

export function FoodSearch({
  initialQuery,
  onPick,
  onClose,
}: {
  initialQuery: string;
  onPick: (candidate: FoodCandidate) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialQuery);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<NutritionSearchResponse | null>(null);
  const latest = useRef(0);

  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const q = query.trim();
    if (q.length < 2) {
      setError("Enter at least two letters.");
      return;
    }
    const mine = ++latest.current;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await searchFoods(q);
      if (mine === latest.current) setResult(data);
    } catch (err) {
      if (mine === latest.current) {
        setResult(null);
        setError(errorMessage(err));
      }
    } finally {
      if (mine === latest.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const problems = result?.sources.filter((s) => s.status !== "ok") ?? [];
  return (
    <div className="food-search" role="group" aria-label="Find nutrition data">
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="row" noValidate>
        <label className="visually-hidden" htmlFor="food-q">Search food composition data</label>
        <input id="food-q" value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. cooked white rice" />
        <button type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Searching…" : "Search"}</button>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={onClose}>Close</button>
      </form>
      <FormError message={error} />
      {problems.map((s) => (
        <p key={s.source} className="hint">
          {s.label}: {s.message ?? STATE_TEXT[s.status] ?? s.status}
        </p>
      ))}
      {result && result.results.length === 0 && (
        <p className="alert info" role="status">
          No matching foods in the sources that responded. Try a simpler name, or keep this food without
          nutrition data. Nothing is guessed.
        </p>
      )}
      {result && result.results.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="candidates">
          {result.results.map((c) => (
            <li key={c.food_ref}>
              <div>
                <p className="candidate-name">
                  {c.name}
                  {c.brand ? <span className="muted"> · {c.brand}</span> : null}
                </p>
                <p className="small-text muted">
                  {c.source_label}
                  {c.data_type ? ` · ${c.data_type}` : ""}
                  {c.serving_label ? ` · serving: ${c.serving_label}` : ""}
                </p>
                <p className="small-text">{summary(c)}</p>
                {c.notes.map((n) => (
                  <p key={n} className="small-text muted">{n}</p>
                ))}
              </div>
              <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => onPick(c)} aria-label={`Use ${c.name}`}>
                Use this
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useId, useState } from "react";
import type { FoodCandidate } from "../../api/types";
import { UNITS } from "../../lib/food";
import type { PortionDraft, PortionMode } from "../../lib/food";
import type { ItemDraft } from "./drafts";
import { FoodSearch } from "./FoodSearch";
import type { WeightUnit } from "../../api/types";

interface Props {
  item: ItemDraft;
  index: number;
  onChange: (next: ItemDraft) => void;
  onRemove: () => void;
}

function PortionFields({
  value,
  servingGrams,
  servingLabel,
  onChange,
  name,
}: {
  value: PortionDraft;
  servingGrams: number | null;
  servingLabel: string | null;
  onChange: (p: PortionDraft) => void;
  name: string;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const set = (patch: Partial<PortionDraft>) => onChange({ ...value, ...patch });
  const unit = (
    <select aria-label={`Unit for ${name}`} value={value.unit} onChange={(e) => set({ unit: e.target.value as WeightUnit })}>
      {UNITS.map((u) => <option key={u} value={u}>{u}</option>)}
    </select>
  );
  return (
    <fieldset className="portion">
      <legend>How much did you eat?</legend>
      <label htmlFor={`${id}-mode`}>Portion type</label>
      <select id={`${id}-mode`} value={value.mode} onChange={(e) => set({ mode: e.target.value as PortionMode })}>
        <option value="weight">I know the weight</option>
        <option value="range">I can only estimate a range</option>
        <option value="servings" disabled={!servingGrams}>
          Servings{servingGrams ? ` (1 serving = ${servingGrams} g)` : " (needs a serving size from the data source)"}
        </option>
      </select>
      {value.mode === "weight" && (
        <div className="row">
          <label className="visually-hidden" htmlFor={`${id}-amount`}>Weight of {name}</label>
          <input id={`${id}-amount`} inputMode="decimal" placeholder="Weight" value={value.amount}
            onChange={(e) => set({ amount: e.target.value })} />
          {unit}
        </div>
      )}
      {value.mode === "range" && (
        <>
          <div className="row">
            <label className="visually-hidden" htmlFor={`${id}-min`}>Smallest likely weight of {name}</label>
            <input id={`${id}-min`} inputMode="decimal" placeholder="Min" value={value.min}
              onChange={(e) => set({ min: e.target.value })} />
            <span aria-hidden="true">to</span>
            <label className="visually-hidden" htmlFor={`${id}-max`}>Largest likely weight of {name}</label>
            <input id={`${id}-max`} inputMode="decimal" placeholder="Max" value={value.max}
              onChange={(e) => set({ max: e.target.value })} />
            {unit}
          </div>
          <p className="hint">Totals will be shown as a range and marked as an estimate.</p>
        </>
      )}
      {value.mode === "servings" && (
        <div className="row">
          <label className="visually-hidden" htmlFor={`${id}-count`}>Servings of {name}</label>
          <input id={`${id}-count`} inputMode="decimal" value={value.count} onChange={(e) => set({ count: e.target.value })} />
          <span className="small-text muted">× {servingLabel ?? `${servingGrams} g`}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

export function ItemRow({ item, index, onChange, onRemove }: Props) {
  const [searching, setSearching] = useState(false);
  const nameId = useId();
  const label = item.name.trim() || `food ${index + 1}`;

  function pick(c: FoodCandidate) {
    const portion =
      item.portion.mode === "servings" && !c.serving_grams ? { ...item.portion, mode: "weight" as const } : item.portion;
    onChange({ ...item, food: c, foodRef: c.food_ref, clearFood: false, portion });
    setSearching(false);
  }

  return (
    <li className="item-row">
      <div className="item-head">
        <div className="grow">
          <label htmlFor={nameId}>Food {index + 1}</label>
          <input id={nameId} value={item.name} maxLength={80} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...item, name: e.target.value })} />
        </div>
        <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={onRemove} aria-label={`Remove ${label}`}>
          Remove
        </button>
      </div>

      {item.hint && (
        <div className="hint-box">
          <p className="small-text">
            <strong>Model said:</strong> {item.hint.name}
            {item.hint.ambiguous && <> · <em>the model was unsure</em></>}
            {item.hint.description && <> — {item.hint.description}</>}
          </p>
          {item.hint.alternatives.length > 0 && (
            <p className="small-text">
              Other possibilities:{" "}
              {item.hint.alternatives.map((alt) => (
                <button key={alt} type="button" className="link" onClick={() => onChange({ ...item, name: alt })}>
                  {alt}
                </button>
              ))}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="match">
        {item.food ? (
          <p className="small-text">
            <strong>Data:</strong> {item.food.name}
            {item.food.brand ? ` (${item.food.brand})` : ""} · {item.food.source_label}{" "}
            <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => setSearching(true)}>Change</button>{" "}
            <button type="button" className="link"
              onClick={() => onChange({ ...item, food: null, foodRef: undefined, clearFood: true })}>
              Clear
            </button>
          </p>
        ) : (
          <p className="small-text">
            <span className="muted">No nutrition data chosen yet.</span>{" "}
            <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => setSearching(true)}
              disabled={item.name.trim().length < 2} aria-label={`Find nutrition data for ${label}`}>
              Find nutrition data
            </button>
          </p>
        )}
        {searching && <FoodSearch initialQuery={item.name} onPick={pick} onClose={() => setSearching(false)} />}
      </div>

      <PortionFields value={item.portion} name={label} servingGrams={item.food?.serving_grams ?? null}
        servingLabel={item.food?.serving_label ?? null} onChange={(portion) => onChange({ ...item, portion })} />
    </li>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/food/MealBuilder.tsx
================================================================================

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { calculateMeal, createMeal, updateMeal } from "../../api/endpoints";
import type { Calculation, MealCategory, MealDetail } from "../../api/types";
import { CATEGORIES, toLocalInput } from "../../lib/food";
import { FormError, errorMessage } from "../FormError";
import { useToast } from "../Toast";
import { Card } from "../ui";
import { blankItem, toPayload } from "./drafts";
import type { ItemDraft } from "./drafts";
import { ItemRow } from "./ItemRow";
import { NutritionResults } from "./NutritionResults";

export interface ScanContext {
  scanRef: string;
  mediaId: string;
  notes: string | null;
  uncertaintyNote: string;
  model: string;
}

interface Props {
  initialItems: ItemDraft[];
  scan?: ScanContext | null;
  /** Present when editing a saved meal. */
  meal?: MealDetail;
}

/** Confirm/correct foods, enter portions, preview the deterministic result, then save. */
export function MealBuilder({ initialItems, scan = null, meal }: Props) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ItemDraft[]>(initialItems);
  const [calc, setCalc] = useState<Calculation | null>(null);
  const [calcError, setCalcError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [calculating, setCalculating] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<MealCategory>(meal?.category ?? "lunch");
  const [eatenAt, setEatenAt] = useState(toLocalInput(meal ? new Date(meal.eaten_at) : new Date()));
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(meal?.notes ?? "");
  const resultRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Any edit makes the previewed numbers stale, so they are hidden rather than left misleading.
  function edit(next: ItemDraft[]) {
    setItems(next);
    setCalc(null);
    setCalcError(null);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (calc) resultRef.current?.focus();
  }, [calc]);

  async function onCalculate() {
    const { payload, error } = toPayload(items);
    if (items.length === 0) return setCalcError("Add at least one food first.");
    if (error) return setCalcError(error);
    setCalculating(true);
    setCalcError(null);
    try {
      setCalc(await calculateMeal(payload, scan?.scanRef ?? null, meal?.id));
    } catch (err) {
      setCalc(null);
      setCalcError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setCalculating(false);
    }
  }

  async function onSave(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const { payload, error } = toPayload(items);
    if (error) return setSaveError(error);
    const when = new Date(eatenAt);
    if (Number.isNaN(when.getTime())) return setSaveError("Enter when you ate this.");
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveError(null);
    try {
      const body = {
        items: payload,
        eaten_at: when.toISOString(),
        category,
        notes: notes.trim() || null,
        scan_ref: scan?.scanRef ?? null,
        media_id: scan?.mediaId ?? meal?.media_id ?? null,
        ...(meal ? { expected_revision: meal.revision } : {}),
      };
      const saved = meal ? await updateMeal(meal.id, body) : await createMeal(body);
      toast.success(meal ? "Meal updated." : "Meal saved.");
      navigate(`/meals/${saved.id}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setSaveError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      {scan && (
        <div className="alert info" role="note">
          <p>
            <strong>Check every item.</strong> {scan.uncertaintyNote}
          </p>
          {scan.notes && <p className="small-text">Model note: {scan.notes}</p>}
          <p className="small-text muted">Model-generated suggestions from “{scan.model}”. Not nutrition data.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <Card title="1. Confirm your foods and portions" headingId="items-heading">
        <p className="hint">
          Rename, add or remove foods. A photo cannot reveal weight, so enter what you ate, or give a range
          if you are unsure.
        </p>
        {items.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="muted" role="status">
            {scan ? "The model did not find any food in this photo. " : ""}Add a food to begin.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="item-list">
            {items.map((item, i) => (
              <ItemRow key={item.key} item={item} index={i}
                onChange={(next) => edit(items.map((x) => (x.key === item.key ? next : x)))}
                onRemove={() => edit(items.filter((x) => x.key !== item.key))} />
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        <div className="row">
          <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => edit([...items, blankItem()])}>
            Add a food
          </button>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="2. Calculate" headingId="calc-heading">
        <p className="hint">
          Values come from the food-composition sources you selected and are calculated by fixed arithmetic.
          No AI model produces or estimates nutrition numbers.
        </p>
        <FormError message={calcError} />
        <button type="button" onClick={onCalculate} disabled={calculating || items.length === 0}>
          {calculating ? "Calculating…" : "Calculate nutrition"}
        </button>
        {calc && (
          <div ref={resultRef} tabIndex={-1} className="result-focus" aria-label="Nutrition results">
            <NutritionResults calc={calc} />
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {calc && (
        <Card title={meal ? "3. Save changes" : "3. Save to your meal log"} headingId="save-heading">
          <form onSubmit={onSave} noValidate>
            <div className="grid-2">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="meal-category">Meal</label>
                <select id="meal-category" value={category} onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value as MealCategory)}>
                  {CATEGORIES.map((c) => <option key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="meal-time">When did you eat?</label>
                <input id="meal-time" type="datetime-local" value={eatenAt} onChange={(e) => setEatenAt(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <label htmlFor="meal-notes">Notes (optional)</label>
            <textarea id="meal-notes" rows={2} maxLength={1000} value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} />
            <FormError message={saveError} />
            <button type="submit" disabled={saving}>{saving ? "Saving…" : meal ? "Save changes" : "Save meal"}</button>
          </form>
        </Card>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import type { Calculation, ItemCalculation } from "../../api/types";
import { SUMMARY_WARNING_TEXT, WARNING_TEXT, formatAmount } from "../../lib/food";
import { Badge } from "../ui";

const ORIGIN: Record<ItemCalculation["origin"], string> = {
  model: "Suggested by the photo model, confirmed by you",
  model_edited: "Suggested by the photo model, renamed by you",
  user_added: "Added by you",
};

const CORE = ["energy_kcal", "protein_g", "carbs_g", "fat_g"];

function Totals({ calc }: { calc: Calculation }) {
  const rows = Object.values(calc.totals).filter((t) => CORE.includes(t.key) || t.low !== null);
  return (
    <table className="nutrient-table">
      <caption>Meal total</caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Nutrient</th>
          <th scope="col">Amount</th>
          <th scope="col">Coverage</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        {rows.map((t) => (
          <tr key={t.key}>
            <th scope="row">{t.label}</th>
            <td>
              {t.low === null || t.high === null ? (
                <span className="muted">Not available</span>
              ) : (
                <strong>{formatAmount(t.low, t.high, t.unit)}</strong>
              )}
            </td>
            <td className="small-text">
              {t.low === null ? (
                "No food reported this"
              ) : t.complete ? (
                "All foods included"
              ) : (
                <span className="partial">Partial: excludes {t.missing_items.join(", ")}</span>
              )}
            </td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

function ItemResult({ item }: { item: ItemCalculation }) {
  const keys = Object.keys(item.nutrients);
  const shown = [...new Set([...CORE, ...keys])].filter((k) => CORE.includes(k) || keys.includes(k));
  const labelFor = (key: string) => key.replace(/_(kcal|g|mg)$/, "").replace(/_/g, " ");
  return (
    <article className="result-item">
      <header className="result-item-head">
        <h4>{item.name}</h4>
        <Badge>{ORIGIN[item.origin]}</Badge>
      </header>
      {item.food ? (
        <p className="small-text">
          Data: <strong>{item.food.name}</strong>
          {item.food.brand ? ` (${item.food.brand})` : ""} · {item.food.source_label} · ID {item.food.source_id}
          <br />
          <span className="muted">{item.food.attribution}</span>
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p className="small-text muted">No nutrition source chosen.</p>
      )}
      {item.portion && (
        <p className="small-text">
          Portion: {item.portion.description} ={" "}
          {formatAmount(item.portion.grams_low, item.portion.grams_high, "g")}{" "}
          {item.portion.uncertain && <Badge tone="warn">Estimate</Badge>}
        </p>
      )}
      {item.portion && item.food && (
        <table className="nutrient-table compact">
          <caption className="visually-hidden">Nutrients for {item.name}</caption>
          <tbody>
            {shown.map((k) => {
              const v = item.nutrients[k];
              return (
                <tr key={k}>
                  <th scope="row">{labelFor(k)}</th>
                  <td>{v ? formatAmount(v.low, v.high, v.unit) : <span className="muted">Not reported by source</span>}</td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      )}
      {item.warnings.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="plain-list small-text">
          {item.warnings.map((w) => (
            <li key={w}>{WARNING_TEXT[w] ?? w}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

/** Per-item and total estimates with their basis, sources and gaps. Pure display. */
export function NutritionResults({ calc }: { calc: Calculation }) {
  return (
    <div className="results">
      {calc.warnings.map((w) => (
        <p key={w} className="alert warn" role="note">
          {SUMMARY_WARNING_TEXT[w] ?? w}
        </p>
      ))}
      <Totals calc={calc} />
      <div className="result-items">
        {calc.items.map((item) => (
          <ItemResult key={item.item_id} item={item} />
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="small-text muted">
        <strong>Basis:</strong> source values are {calc.unit_basis}. <strong>Method:</strong> {calc.method}.
      </p>
      <p className="small-text muted">{calc.disclaimer}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/components/food/drafts.ts

import type { FoodItemPayload, FoodSnapshot, ItemCalculation, ObservedFood } from "../../api/types";
import { draftFromPortion, emptyPortion, portionFromDraft } from "../../lib/food";
import type { PortionDraft } from "../../lib/food";

/** One food as the user is editing it. Nutrient numbers never live here: only a signed reference. */
export interface ItemDraft {
  key: string;
  itemId?: string; // existing item of a saved meal
  observedId?: number; // index in the scan result
  name: string;
  hint?: ObservedFood; // what the model said, shown beside the editable name
  food: FoodSnapshot | null;
  foodRef?: string; // set only when the user picked a (new) match this session
  clearFood: boolean;
  portion: PortionDraft;
}

let counter = 0;
export const newKey = () => `item-${++counter}`;

export const blankItem = (): ItemDraft => ({ key: newKey(), name: "", food: null, clearFood: false, portion: emptyPortion() });

export const draftFromObserved = (o: ObservedFood): ItemDraft => ({
  key: newKey(),
  observedId: o.observed_id,
  name: o.name,
  hint: o,
  food: null,
  clearFood: false,
  portion: emptyPortion(),
});

export const draftFromSaved = (i: ItemCalculation): ItemDraft => ({
  key: newKey(),
  itemId: i.item_id,
  name: i.name,
  food: i.food,
  clearFood: false,
  portion: draftFromPortion(i.portion_input),
});

/** Convert drafts to the API payload, or return the first problem to show the user. */
export function toPayload(items: ItemDraft[]): { payload: FoodItemPayload[]; error: string | null } {
  const payload: FoodItemPayload[] = [];
  for (const d of items) {
    const name = d.name.trim();
    if (!name) return { payload: [], error: "Every food needs a name. Remove empty rows or fill them in." };
    const { portion, error } = portionFromDraft(d.portion);
    if (error) return { payload: [], error: `${name}: ${error}` };
    const p: FoodItemPayload = { name };
    if (d.itemId) p.item_id = d.itemId;
    if (d.observedId !== undefined) p.observed_id = d.observedId;
    if (d.foodRef) p.food_ref = d.foodRef;
    else if (d.clearFood) p.clear_food = true;
    if (portion) p.portion = portion;
    payload.push(p);
  }
  return { payload, error: null };
}

import type { FreshnessDetail } from "../../api/types";

function Detail({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | null }) {

}

/**

 * fixed rules (advice). The label describes one image and is never presented as a safety verdict.
 */
export function FreshnessResult({ detail }: { detail: FreshnessDetail }) {

                      {SEVERITY_TEXT[o.severity]} · {CERTAINTY_TEXT[o.certainty]} (the model’s own wording)
                    </p>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : (

                The model did not report any visible changes in this image
                {r.assessment.label === "inconclusive" ? ", but the image was not good enough to rely on that" : ""}.
              </p>
            )}
            {f.limitations.length > 0 && (

            )}
            {f.notes && <p className="small-text">Model note: {f.notes}</p>}

          ? `Image analysed by the “${r.provider.model}” model (${r.provider.name}${r.provider.external ? ", external service" : ", on this server"}).`
          : "No AI model was used for this check."}{" "}
        Saved <time dateTime={r.generated_at}>{formatDate(r.generated_at)}</time>. No freshness score is
        calculated, and no trained freshness classifier is used.
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

import type { ChecklistItem } from "../../api/types";

export function ChecklistEditor({
  value, disabled, onChange,
}: {
  value: ChecklistItem[];
  disabled: boolean;
  onChange: (next: ChecklistItem[]) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <table className="nutrient-table">
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">✔</th><th scope="col">Item</th><th scope="col">Note</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        {value.map((item, i) => (
          <tr key={item.item_id}>
            <td>
              <input
                type="checkbox" checked={item.checked} disabled={disabled}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const next = [...value]; next[i] = { ...item, checked: e.target.checked }; onChange(next);
                }}
                aria-label={item.label}
              />
            </td>
            <td>{item.label}</td>
            <td>
              <input
                type="text" value={item.note ?? ""} maxLength={300} disabled={disabled}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const next = [...value]; next[i] = { ...item, note: e.target.value || null }; onChange(next);
                }}
                aria-label={`Note for ${item.label}`}
              />
            </td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import type { HygieneCertainty, HygieneFindingInput, HygieneSeverity } from "../../api/types";
import { CATEGORY_OPTIONS, CERTAINTY_LABELS, SEVERITY_LABELS } from "../../lib/hygiene";

export function FindingsEditor({
  findings, photos, onChange, onSave, onCancel, busy,
}: {
  findings: HygieneFindingInput[];
  photos: string[];
  onChange: (next: HygieneFindingInput[]) => void;
  onSave: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  function update(i: number, patch: Partial<HygieneFindingInput>) {
    const next = [...findings]; next[i] = { ...next[i], ...patch }; onChange(next);
  }
  function remove(i: number) { onChange(findings.filter((_, j) => j !== i)); }
  return (
    <div>
      <ul className="item-list">
        {findings.map((f, i) => (
          <li key={f.finding_id ?? `new-${i}`} className="item-row">
            <div className="row wrap">
              <label className="visually-hidden" htmlFor={`f-cat-${i}`}>Category</label>
              <select id={`f-cat-${i}`} value={f.category} onChange={(e) => update(i, { category: e.target.value as HygieneFindingInput["category"] })}>
                {CATEGORY_OPTIONS.map((c) => <option key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</option>)}
              </select>
              <label className="visually-hidden" htmlFor={`f-sev-${i}`}>Severity</label>
              <select id={`f-sev-${i}`} value={f.severity} onChange={(e) => update(i, { severity: e.target.value as HygieneSeverity })}>
                {(Object.keys(SEVERITY_LABELS) as HygieneSeverity[]).map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{SEVERITY_LABELS[s]}</option>)}
              </select>
              <label className="visually-hidden" htmlFor={`f-cer-${i}`}>Certainty</label>
              <select id={`f-cer-${i}`} value={f.certainty} onChange={(e) => update(i, { certainty: e.target.value as HygieneCertainty })}>
                {(Object.keys(CERTAINTY_LABELS) as HygieneCertainty[]).map((c) => <option key={c} value={c}>{CERTAINTY_LABELS[c]}</option>)}
              </select>
              <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => remove(i)}>Remove</button>
            </div>
            <label htmlFor={`f-desc-${i}`}>Description</label>
            <input id={`f-desc-${i}`} value={f.description} maxLength={400} onChange={(e) => update(i, { description: e.target.value })} />
            <label htmlFor={`f-loc-${i}`}>Where in the image</label>
            <input id={`f-loc-${i}`} value={f.location} maxLength={200} onChange={(e) => update(i, { location: e.target.value })} />
            {photos.length > 0 && (
              <>
                <label htmlFor={`f-photo-${i}`}>Evidence photo</label>
                <select id={`f-photo-${i}`} value={f.evidence_media_id ?? ""}
                  onChange={(e) => update(i, { evidence_media_id: e.target.value || null })}>
                  <option value="">No specific photo</option>
                  {photos.map((p, idx) => <option key={p} value={p}>Photo {idx + 1}</option>)}
                </select>
              </>
            )}
            <label htmlFor={`f-note-${i}`}>Your note (optional)</label>
            <input id={`f-note-${i}`} value={f.user_note ?? ""} maxLength={500} onChange={(e) => update(i, { user_note: e.target.value || null })} />
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <div className="row wrap">
        <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => {
          setAdding(true);
          onChange([...findings, {
            source: "user", category: "surface_cleanliness", severity: "medium",
            description: "", location: "", certainty: "clearly_visible",
            evidence_media_id: null, user_note: null,
          }]);
        }} disabled={adding}>Add your own finding</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={onSave} disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Saving…" : "Save findings"}</button>
        <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/hooks/useBlobUrl.ts
================================================================================

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

/** Fetch a protected binary and expose it as an object URL (revoked on cleanup). */
export function useBlobUrl(load: () => Promise<Blob>): { url: string | null; failed: boolean } {
  const [state, setState] = useState<{ url: string | null; failed: boolean }>({
    url: null,
    failed: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    let created: string | null = null;
    load().then(
      (blob) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        created = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        setState({ url: created, failed: false });
      },
      () => !cancelled && setState({ url: null, failed: true }),
    );
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      if (created) URL.revokeObjectURL(created);
    };
  }, [load]);

  return state;
}

================================================================================
FILE: frontend/src/hooks/useResource.ts
================================================================================

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

interface Settled<T> {
  source: () => Promise<T>;
  nonce: number;
  data: T | null;
  error: unknown;
}

export interface Resource<T> {
  data: T | null;
  error: unknown;
  loading: boolean;
  reload: () => void;
}

/**
 * Load data from the API. Pass a fetcher memoised with useCallback; it reruns whenever the
 * fetcher identity changes (e.g. a new page number) or reload() is called.
 * `loading` is derived, so a stale result is never shown for a newer request.
 */
export function useResource<T>(fetcher: () => Promise<T>): Resource<T> {
  const [nonce, setNonce] = useState(0);
  const [settled, setSettled] = useState<Settled<T> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    fetcher().then(
      (data) => !cancelled && setSettled({ source: fetcher, nonce, data, error: null }),
      (error: unknown) => !cancelled && setSettled({ source: fetcher, nonce, data: null, error }),
    );
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [fetcher, nonce]);

  const reload = useCallback(() => setNonce((n) => n + 1), []);
  const current = settled !== null && settled.source === fetcher && settled.nonce === nonce;
  return {
    data: current ? settled.data : (settled?.data ?? null), // keep old data visible while reloading
    error: current ? settled.error : null,
    loading: !current,
    reload,
  };
}

/** "78 kcal", or "52–104 kcal" when the value is an estimated range. */
export function formatAmount(low: number, high: number, unit: string): string {
  return low === high ? `${num.format(low)} ${unit}` : `${num.format(low)}–${num.format(high)} ${unit}`;
}

/** Local "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" for <input type="datetime-local">. */
export function toLocalInput(date: Date): string {
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`;
}

// ---- portion drafts (what the user is typing) ----
export type PortionMode = "none" | "weight" | "range" | "servings";

export interface PortionDraft {
  mode: PortionMode;
  amount: string;
  min: string;
  max: string;
  count: string;
  unit: WeightUnit;
}

export const emptyPortion = (): PortionDraft => ({
  mode: "weight",
  amount: "",
  min: "",
  max: "",
  count: "1",
  unit: "g",
});

export function draftFromPortion(p: PortionInput | null): PortionDraft {
  const base = emptyPortion();
  if (!p) return base;
  if (p.kind === "weight") return { ...base, mode: "weight", amount: String(p.amount), unit: p.unit };
  if (p.kind === "range") return { ...base, mode: "range", min: String(p.min_amount), max: String(p.max_amount), unit: p.unit };
  return { ...base, mode: "servings", count: String(p.count) };
}

const positive = (text: string): number | null => {
  const value = Number(text.trim());
  return text.trim() !== "" && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : null;
};

/** Returns the portion to send, null when none was entered, or an error message. */
export function portionFromDraft(d: PortionDraft): { portion: PortionInput | null; error: string | null } {
  if (d.mode === "none") return { portion: null, error: null };
  if (d.mode === "weight") {
    if (d.amount.trim() === "") return { portion: null, error: null };
    const amount = positive(d.amount);
    return amount === null
      ? { portion: null, error: "Enter a weight greater than zero." }
      : { portion: { kind: "weight", amount, unit: d.unit }, error: null };
  }
  if (d.mode === "range") {
    if (d.min.trim() === "" && d.max.trim() === "") return { portion: null, error: null };
    const min = positive(d.min);
    const max = positive(d.max);
    if (min === null || max === null) return { portion: null, error: "Enter both a minimum and a maximum above zero." };
    if (min >= max) return { portion: null, error: "The minimum must be smaller than the maximum." };
    return { portion: { kind: "range", min_amount: min, max_amount: max, unit: d.unit }, error: null };
  }
  const count = positive(d.count);
  return count === null
    ? { portion: null, error: "Enter a number of servings greater than zero." }
    : { portion: { kind: "servings", count }, error: null };
}

FILE: frontend/src/lib/format.ts

export function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  let value = bytes / 1024;
  let i = 0;
  while (value >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
    value /= 1024;
    i += 1;
  }
  return `${value >= 100 || Number.isInteger(value) ? Math.round(value) : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[i]}`;
}

export function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" }).format(
    new Date(iso),
  );
}
