import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  getCookingCapabilities, getConversation, listConversations, sendChat,
} from "../api/endpoints";
import type { ChatMessage, ConversationSummary, Recipe } from "../api/types";
import { FormError, errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { RecipeView } from "../components/cooking/RecipeView";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { Card, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";
import { formatDate } from "../lib/format";

interface LocalMessage extends ChatMessage { pending?: boolean }

export function CookingPage() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const caps = useResource(useCallback(() => getCookingCapabilities(), []));
  const list = useResource(useCallback(() => listConversations(1), []));
  const [conversationId, setConversationId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<LocalMessage[]>([]);
  const [recipes, setRecipes] = useState<Recipe[]>([]);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    const d = await getConversation(id);
    setConversationId(id);
    setMessages(d.messages as LocalMessage[]);
    // Fetch each referenced recipe (cheap, and lets us render its full detail)
    const recipeIds = Array.from(new Set(d.messages.map((m) => m.recipe_id).filter(Boolean) as string[]));
    const loaded = await Promise.all(recipeIds.map((rid) => import("../api/endpoints").then((m) => m.getRecipe(rid))));
    setRecipes(loaded);
    list.reload();
  }, [list]);

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: scrollRef.current.scrollHeight });
  }, [messages]);

  async function send(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    setError(null);
    setDraft("");
    const local: LocalMessage = {
      id: `local-${Date.now()}`, role: "user", content: text,
      recipe_id: null, warnings: [], created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    setMessages((m) => [...m, local]);
    setBusy(true);
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;
    try {
      const res = await sendChat(text, conversationId, controller.signal);
      setConversationId(res.conversation_id);
      setMessages((m) => [
        ...m.filter((x) => x.id !== local.id),
        res.user_message,
        res.assistant_message,
      ]);
      if (res.recipe) setRecipes((r) => [...r, res.recipe!]);
      list.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      setMessages((m) => m.filter((x) => x.id !== local.id));
      if (!(err instanceof DOMException && err.name === "AbortError")) {
        setError(errorMessage(err));
      }
    } finally {
      abortRef.current = null;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  if (caps.error) return <ErrorState error={caps.error} onRetry={caps.reload} />;
  if (!caps.data) return <Loading />;
  const { text } = caps.data;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Cooking assistant"
        description="Recipes, substitutions, and step-by-step help that respect your allergies and diet."
        actions={<Link className="button-link secondary" to="/recipes">All saved recipes</Link>}
      />
      {!text.configured && (
        <p className="alert info" role="note">
          The cooking assistant is not available: {text.message} Your saved recipes below still work.
        </p>
      )}
      {text.configured && text.external && (
        <p className="alert warn" role="note">
          Your messages will be sent to an external service ({text.provider}) that the server operator enabled.
        </p>
      )}
      {text.configured && (
        <p className="small-text muted">{caps.data.context_note}</p>
      )}

      <div className="cooking-layout">
        <Card title="Conversations" headingId="conv-heading">
          {list.error ? (
            <ErrorState error={list.error} onRetry={list.reload} />
          ) : !list.data ? (
            <Loading />
          ) : list.data.items.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="muted small-text">No conversations yet.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="conversation-list">
              {list.data.items.map((c: ConversationSummary) => (
                <li key={c.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={c.id === conversationId ? "conversation-active" : ""}
                    onClick={() => { void load(c.id); }}
                  >
                    <span className="conversation-title">{c.title}</span>
                    <span className="muted small-text">
                      {c.message_count} · {formatDate(c.updated_at)}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
          {conversationId && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="secondary small"
              onClick={() => { setConversationId(null); setMessages([]); setRecipes([]); }}
            >
              New conversation
            </button>
          )}
        </Card>

        <Card title={conversationId ? "Conversation" : "Ask anything"} headingId="chat-heading">
          <div ref={scrollRef} className="chat-scroll" aria-live="polite">
            {messages.length === 0 && (
              <p className="muted">
                Ask for a recipe, a substitution, or a beginner-friendly explanation. For example:
                “What can I cook with rice, lemon and salt?”
              </p>
            )}
            {messages.map((m) => (
              <div key={m.id} className={`chat-turn chat-${m.role}`}>
                <p className="chat-role">{m.role === "user" ? "You" : "Assistant"}</p>
                <p className="chat-body" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap" }}>{m.content}</p>
                {m.warnings.length > 0 && (
                  <ul className="chat-warnings small-text">
                    {m.warnings.map((w, i) => <li key={i}>{w}</li>)}
                  </ul>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
            {busy && (
              <div className="loading" role="status" aria-live="polite">
                <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span>Waiting for the assistant…</span>
                <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => abortRef.current?.abort()}>
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <FormError message={error} />
          <form onSubmit={send} noValidate>
            <label htmlFor="chat-input" className="visually-hidden">Message</label>
            <textarea
              id="chat-input"
              rows={3}
              maxLength={2000}
              value={draft}
              onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
              disabled={busy || !text.configured}
              placeholder={text.configured ? "Ask the assistant…" : "Configure a text model to use the assistant."}
            />
            <button type="submit" disabled={busy || !draft.trim() || !text.configured}>
              {busy ? "Sending…" : "Send"}
            </button>
          </form>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {recipes.map((r) => (
        <RecipeView key={r.id} recipe={r} onSaved={(next) => setRecipes(
          (all) => all.map((x) => (x.id === next.id ? next : x)),
        )} onDeleted={() => setRecipes((all) => all.filter((x) => x.id !== r.id))} />
      ))}
      {recipes.length > 0 && toast && null /* toasts render themselves */}
    </>
  );
}

function modelLine(label: string, m: AIStatus["ollama"]["text_model"]): string {

function Stat({ label, value, hint }: { label: string; value: string; hint: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="stat">
      <dt>{label}</dt>
      <dd>{value}</dd>

}

export function DashboardPage() {

    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={`Welcome, ${state.user?.display_name ?? ""}`}
        description="Your food intelligence workspace. Everything below reflects your own data."
      />

      <section aria-label="Your numbers">
        {summary.error ? (
          <ErrorState error={summary.error} onRetry={summary.reload} />
        ) : !s ? (
          <Loading label="Loading your summary…" />
        ) : (
          <dl className="stats">
            <Stat label="Photos in library" value={String(s.media.count)}
              hint={s.media.count === 0 ? "Nothing uploaded yet" : "Stored privately for you"} />
            <Stat label="Storage used" value={formatBytes(s.media.total_bytes)}
              hint={`of ${formatBytes(s.media.quota_bytes)}`} />
            <Stat label="Analyses" value={String(s.history.total)}
              hint={s.history.total === 0 ? "None yet" : "Across all modules"} />
          </dl>
        )}
      </section>

      <Card title="Modules" headingId="modules-heading">
        {modules.error ? (
          <ErrorState error={modules.error} onRetry={modules.reload} />
        ) : !modules.data ? (
          <Loading />
        ) : (
          <div className="module-grid">
            {modules.data.map((m) => (
              <ModuleCard key={m.key} module={m} count={s?.history.by_module[m.key]} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card title="Recent activity" headingId="recent-heading">
        {summary.error ? null : !s ? (
          <Loading />
        ) : s.recent.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="No analyses yet"
            description="When analysis modules are released, your results will appear here."
            action={<Link to="/media" className="button-link">Add photos to your library</Link>}
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            <HistoryList items={s.recent} modules={modules.data ?? []} />
            <p><Link to="/history">View all history</Link></p>
          </>
        )}
      </Card>

      <p className="small-text">
        Also: <Link to="/history">All history</Link> · <Link to="/modules">All modules</Link> · <Link to="/media">Media library</Link>
      </p>

      <Card title="Local AI status" headingId="ai-heading">
        {ai.error ? <ErrorState error={ai.error} onRetry={ai.reload} /> : null}
        {!ai.data && !ai.error ? <Loading label="Checking…" /> : null}
        {ollama && (
          <ul className="plain-list">
            <li>
              Ollama:{" "}
              {!ollama.enabled
                ? "disabled (set OLLAMA_ENABLED=true on the server to use a local model)"
                : ollama.reachable
                  ? "reachable"
                  : "not reachable"}
            </li>
            {ollama.error && <li>{ollama.error}</li>}
            <li>{modelLine("Text model", ollama.text_model)}</li>
            <li>{modelLine("Vision model", ollama.vision_model)}</li>
            <li>Paid or external AI fallback: none</li>
          </ul>
        )}
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/FoodPage.tsx
================================================================================

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { getFoodCapabilities, scanPhoto, uploadPhotoWithProgress } from "../api/endpoints";
import type { ScanResponse } from "../api/types";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../components/ConfirmDialog";
import { blankItem, draftFromObserved } from "../components/food/drafts";
import type { ItemDraft } from "../components/food/drafts";
import { MealBuilder } from "../components/food/MealBuilder";
import { FormError, errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { PhotoPicker } from "../components/PhotoPicker";
import { Card, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";

type Phase =
  | { name: "pick" }
  | { name: "uploading"; progress: number }
  | { name: "scanning" }
  | { name: "build"; items: ItemDraft[]; scan: ScanResponse | null };

const isAbort = (err: unknown) => err instanceof DOMException && err.name === "AbortError";

export function FoodPage() {
  const caps = useResource(useCallback(() => getFoodCapabilities(), []));
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>({ name: "pick" });
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pickerKey, setPickerKey] = useState(0); // bumping it resets the picker
  const [runError, setRunError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploadedId, setUploadedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmReset, setConfirmReset] = useState(false);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => () => abortRef.current?.abort(), []);

  function onPhotoChange(next: File | null) {
    setFile(next);
    setRunError(null);
    setUploadedId(null); // a different photo means a new upload
  }

  async function analyse() {
    if (!file) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;
    setRunError(null);
    try {
      let mediaId = uploadedId;
      if (!mediaId) {
        setPhase({ name: "uploading", progress: 0 });
        const media = await uploadPhotoWithProgress(file, (progress) => setPhase({ name: "uploading", progress }), controller.signal);
        mediaId = media.id;
        setUploadedId(mediaId);
      }
      setPhase({ name: "scanning" });
      const scan = await scanPhoto(mediaId, controller.signal);
      setPhase({ name: "build", items: scan.items.map(draftFromObserved), scan });
    } catch (err) {
      setPhase({ name: "pick" });
      if (!isAbort(err)) setRunError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      abortRef.current = null;
    }
  }

  function startManual() {
    setPhase({ name: "build", items: [blankItem()], scan: null });
  }

  function reset() {
    setPhase({ name: "pick" });
    setFile(null);
    setPickerKey((k) => k + 1);
    setUploadedId(null);
    setRunError(null);
    setConfirmReset(false);
  }

  if (caps.error) return <ErrorState error={caps.error} onRetry={caps.reload} />;
  if (!caps.data) return <Loading />;
  const { vision, nutrition } = caps.data;

  if (phase.name === "build") {
    const scan = phase.scan;
    return (
      <>
        <PageHeader
          title="Check your meal"
          description="Confirm what is on the plate, add portions, and save it to your meal log."
          actions={<button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setConfirmReset(true)}>Start over</button>}
        />
        {!nutrition.any_configured && (
          <p className="alert warn" role="note">
            No nutrition data source is set up on this server, so values cannot be calculated. See the setup
            notes (USDA_FDC_API_KEY, OPEN_FOOD_FACTS_ENABLED, or import a reference table).
          </p>
        )}
        <MealBuilder
          initialItems={phase.items}
          scan={scan ? {
            scanRef: scan.scan_ref, mediaId: scan.media_id, notes: scan.notes,
            uncertaintyNote: scan.uncertainty_note, model: scan.provider.model,
          } : null}
        />
        <ConfirmDialog open={confirmReset} title="Start over?"
          message="Your current foods and portions on this page will be discarded. Nothing has been saved yet."
          confirmLabel="Start over" onConfirm={reset} onCancel={() => setConfirmReset(false)} />
      </>
    );
  }

  const busy = phase.name === "uploading" || phase.name === "scanning";
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Analyse a meal"
        description="Photograph or upload your meal. A model suggests which foods it sees, you confirm them, and nutrition comes from trusted food-composition data."
      />

      {!vision.configured && (
        <p className="alert info" role="note">
          Photo recognition is not available: {vision.message ?? "no vision model is configured."} You can
          still enter foods yourself.
        </p>
      )}
      {vision.configured && vision.external && (
        <p className="alert warn" role="note">
          Your photo will be sent to an external service ({vision.provider}) that the server operator enabled.
        </p>
      )}

      <Card title="Photo" headingId="photo-heading">
        <PhotoPicker key={pickerKey} onChange={onPhotoChange} disabled={busy}
          hint={<>JPEG, PNG or WebP. Photos are re-encoded, stored privately in your library, and
            analysed {vision.configured && !vision.external ? "on this server" : "only if a recognition model is set up"}.
            On a phone, “Take a photo” opens the camera; elsewhere it opens a file chooser.</>} />

        <FormError message={runError} />

        {phase.name === "uploading" && (
          <div role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <progress max={1} value={phase.progress} aria-label="Upload progress" />
            <p className="small-text">Uploading… {Math.round(phase.progress * 100)}%</p>
          </div>
        )}
        {phase.name === "scanning" && (
          <div className="loading" role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>Analysing the photo. A local model on modest hardware can take a minute or more.</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="row wrap">
          {busy ? (
            <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => abortRef.current?.abort()}>Cancel</button>
          ) : (
            <button type="button" onClick={analyse} disabled={!file || !vision.configured}>
              {runError && uploadedId ? "Try analysing again" : "Analyse photo"}
            </button>
          )}
          <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={startManual} disabled={busy}>
            Enter foods without a photo
          </button>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/FreshnessDetailPage.tsx

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { deleteFreshness, getFreshness } from "../api/endpoints";
import { ApiError } from "../api/client";
import { AuthImage } from "../components/AuthImage";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../components/ConfirmDialog";
import { FreshnessResult } from "../components/freshness/FreshnessResult";
import { errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { Card, EmptyState, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";
import { formatDate } from "../lib/format";

export function FreshnessDetailPage() {
  const { id = "" } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const check = useResource(useCallback(() => getFreshness(id), [id]));

  async function remove() {
    try {
      await deleteFreshness(id);
      toast.success("Check deleted.");
      navigate("/freshness/history");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setConfirming(false);
    }
  }

  if (check.error instanceof ApiError && check.error.status === 404) {
    return <EmptyState title="Check not found" description="It may have been deleted."
      action={<Link to="/freshness/history">Back to past checks</Link>} />;
  }
  if (check.error) return <ErrorState error={check.error} onRetry={check.reload} />;
  if (!check.data) return <Loading />;
  const d = check.data;
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={d.food_name}
        description={<>{d.category_label} · <time dateTime={d.created_at}>{formatDate(d.created_at)}</time></>}
        actions={<>
          <Link className="button-link secondary" to="/freshness">New check</Link>
          <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}>Delete</button>
        </>} />
      {d.media_id && (
        <Card title="Photo" headingId="photo-h">
          <AuthImage mediaId={d.media_id} alt={`Photo of ${d.food_name}`} className="detail-photo" />
        </Card>
      )}
      <FreshnessResult detail={d} />
      <p><Link to="/freshness/history">← Past checks</Link></p>
      <ConfirmDialog open={confirming} title="Delete this check?"
        message="This check and its saved result will be permanently deleted."
        confirmLabel="Delete" onConfirm={remove} onCancel={() => setConfirming(false)} />
    </>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/FreshnessHistoryPage.tsx

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { deleteFreshness, listFreshness } from "../api/endpoints";
import type { FreshnessLabel, FreshnessSummary } from "../api/types";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../components/ConfirmDialog";
import { errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { Badge, EmptyState, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader, Pagination } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";
import { formatDate } from "../lib/format";
import { LABEL_FILTERS, LABEL_TONE } from "../lib/freshness";

export function FreshnessHistoryPage() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [label, setLabel] = useState<FreshnessLabel | "">("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<FreshnessSummary | null>(null);
  const list = useResource(useCallback(() => listFreshness(page, label || null), [page, label]));

  async function confirmDelete() {
    if (!pending) return;
    try {
      await deleteFreshness(pending.id);
      toast.success("Check deleted.");
      if (list.data && list.data.items.length === 1 && page > 1) setPage(page - 1);
      else list.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setPending(null);
    }
  }

  const data = list.data;
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Past freshness checks" description="Each result describes one image on one day. It is not a safety record."
        actions={<Link className="button-link" to="/freshness">New check</Link>} />
      <div className="toolbar">
        <label htmlFor="fresh-filter">Result</label>
        <select id="fresh-filter" value={label} onChange={(e) => { setLabel(e.target.value as FreshnessLabel | ""); setPage(1); }}>
          <option value="">All results</option>
          {LABEL_FILTERS.map((f) => <option key={f.value} value={f.value}>{f.label}</option>)}
        </select>
      </div>
      {list.error ? (
        <ErrorState error={list.error} onRetry={list.reload} />
      ) : !data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : data.items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title={label ? "No checks with that result" : "No freshness checks yet"}
          description="Run a check and it will be saved here."
          action={<Link to="/freshness">Start a check</Link>} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <ul className="history-list">
            {data.items.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id}>
                <div className="history-main">
                  <p className="history-title"><Link to={`/freshness/${c.id}`}>{c.food_name}</Link></p>
                  <p className="muted small-text">
                    {c.category_label} · <time dateTime={c.created_at}>{formatDate(c.created_at)}</time>
                    {c.image_analysed ? "" : " · photo not analysed"}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="history-side">
                  <Badge tone={LABEL_TONE[c.label]}>{c.label_text}</Badge>
                  <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => setPending(c)}
                    aria-label={`Delete check for ${c.food_name}`}>Delete</button>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <Pagination page={data.page} pages={data.pages} onChange={setPage} />
        </>
      )}
      <ConfirmDialog open={pending !== null} title="Delete this check?"
        message={`The saved check for “${pending?.food_name ?? ""}” will be permanently deleted.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete" onConfirm={confirmDelete} onCancel={() => setPending(null)} />
    </>
  );
}

================================================================================
FILE: frontend/src/pages/FreshnessPage.tsx
================================================================================

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { createFreshness, getFreshnessCapabilities, uploadPhotoWithProgress } from "../api/endpoints";
import { ApiError } from "../api/client";
import type { FreshnessRequest } from "../api/types";
import { FormError, errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { PhotoPicker } from "../components/PhotoPicker";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { Card, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";
import { localDate } from "../lib/freshness";

type Phase = { name: "idle" } | { name: "uploading"; progress: number } | { name: "working"; analysing: boolean };

const isAbort = (err: unknown) => err instanceof DOMException && err.name === "AbortError";
// Provider-side problems: the user can still get guidance without image analysis.
const PROVIDER_TROUBLE = new Set([429, 502, 503, 504]);

export function FreshnessPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const caps = useResource(useCallback(() => getFreshnessCapabilities(), []));
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>({ name: "idle" });
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [uploadedId, setUploadedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [offerGuidance, setOfferGuidance] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [storage, setStorage] = useState("unknown");
  const [packaging, setPackaging] = useState("unknown");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState<"hours" | "days">("hours");
  const [purchased, setPurchased] = useState("");
  const [useBy, setUseBy] = useState("");
  const [bestBefore, setBestBefore] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => () => abortRef.current?.abort(), []);

  function onPhotoChange(next: File | null) {
    setFile(next);
    setUploadedId(null);
    setError(null);
    setOfferGuidance(false);
  }

  function buildRequest(analyze: boolean, mediaId: string | null): FreshnessRequest | string {
    if (!name.trim()) return "Enter what food this is.";
    if (!category) return "Choose the type of food.";
    let storage_duration: FreshnessRequest["storage_duration"] = null;
    if (amount.trim() !== "") {
      const n = Number(amount);
      if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0) return "Storage time must be a whole number, zero or more.";
      storage_duration = { amount: n, unit };
    }
    return {
      media_id: mediaId,
      analyze_image: analyze,
      food_name: name.trim(),
      food_category: category,
      storage_condition: storage,
      packaging,
      storage_duration,
      purchased_on: purchased || null,
      use_by_date: useBy || null,
      best_before_date: bestBefore || null,
      assessed_on: localDate(),
      notes: notes.trim() || null,
    };
  }

  async function submit(analyze: boolean) {
    setError(null);
    setOfferGuidance(false);
    if (analyze && !file) return setError("Choose or take a photo to analyse, or ask for guidance only.");
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;
    try {
      let mediaId = uploadedId;
      if (analyze && !mediaId && file) {
        const early = buildRequest(true, "pending");
        if (typeof early === "string") return setError(early); // validate before uploading anything
        setPhase({ name: "uploading", progress: 0 });
        const media = await uploadPhotoWithProgress(file, (progress) => setPhase({ name: "uploading", progress }), controller.signal);
        mediaId = media.id;
        setUploadedId(mediaId);
      }
      const body = buildRequest(analyze, mediaId);
      if (typeof body === "string") return setError(body);
      setPhase({ name: "working", analysing: analyze });
      const saved = await createFreshness(body, controller.signal);
      toast.success("Check saved.");
      navigate(`/freshness/${saved.id}`);
    } catch (err) {
      if (isAbort(err)) {
        setError("Stopped waiting. If the analysis had already finished, it will be in your past checks.");
      } else {
        setError(errorMessage(err));
        if (analyze && err instanceof ApiError && PROVIDER_TROUBLE.has(err.status)) setOfferGuidance(true);
      }
    } finally {
      abortRef.current = null;
      setPhase((p) => (p.name === "idle" ? p : { name: "idle" }));
    }
  }

  function onSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    void submit(true);
  }

  if (caps.error) return <ErrorState error={caps.error} onRetry={caps.reload} />;
  if (!caps.data) return <Loading />;
  const { vision, categories, storage_conditions, packaging: packagingChoices } = caps.data;
  const busy = phase.name !== "idle";

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Freshness check"
        description="Describe the food and add a photo. You get what is visibly present in the image, plus food-safety guidance. It never tells you a food is safe."
        actions={<Link className="button-link secondary" to="/freshness/history">Past checks</Link>}
      />
      <p className="alert info" role="note">{caps.data.verdict_notice}</p>
      {!vision.configured && (
        <p className="alert info" role="note">
          Photo analysis is not available on this server: {vision.message ?? "no vision model is configured."} You
          can still get guidance from the details below.
        </p>
      )}
      {vision.configured && vision.external && (
        <p className="alert warn" role="note">
          Your photo will be sent to an external service ({vision.provider}) that the server operator enabled.
        </p>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
        <Card title="1. The food" headingId="food-heading">
          <label htmlFor="fresh-name">What food is it?</label>
          <input id="fresh-name" value={name} maxLength={80} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. strawberries, leftover rice" />
          <label htmlFor="fresh-category">Type of food</label>
          <select id="fresh-category" value={category} onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">Choose…</option>
            {categories.map((c) => <option key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</option>)}
          </select>
          <p className="hint">You confirm the food; the model is only asked about what it can see.</p>
        </Card>

        <Card title="2. Photo" headingId="photo-heading">
          <PhotoPicker onChange={onPhotoChange} disabled={busy}
            hint="Use bright, even light and a sharp close-up. JPEG, PNG or WebP. Photos are stored privately in your library." />
        </Card>

        <Card title="3. Storage details (optional)" headingId="storage-heading">
          <p className="hint">These help the guidance. Leave anything you do not know.</p>
          <div className="field-row">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="fresh-storage">Where was it kept?</label>
              <select id="fresh-storage" value={storage} onChange={(e) => setStorage(e.target.value)}>
                {storage_conditions.map((c) => <option key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="fresh-packaging">Packaging</label>
              <select id="fresh-packaging" value={packaging} onChange={(e) => setPackaging(e.target.value)}>
                {packagingChoices.map((c) => <option key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <label htmlFor="fresh-amount">How long has it been stored?</label>
          <div className="row">
            <input id="fresh-amount" inputMode="numeric" value={amount} onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 3" />
            <select aria-label="Storage time unit" value={unit} onChange={(e) => setUnit(e.target.value as "hours" | "days")}>
              <option value="hours">hours</option>
              <option value="days">days</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="field-row">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="fresh-bought">Bought on</label>
              <input id="fresh-bought" type="date" value={purchased} onChange={(e) => setPurchased(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="fresh-useby">Use-by date</label>
              <input id="fresh-useby" type="date" value={useBy} onChange={(e) => setUseBy(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="fresh-bb">Best-before date</label>
              <input id="fresh-bb" type="date" value={bestBefore} onChange={(e) => setBestBefore(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <label htmlFor="fresh-notes">Notes (optional)</label>
          <textarea id="fresh-notes" rows={2} maxLength={500} value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} />
        </Card>

        <FormError message={error} />
        {phase.name === "uploading" && (
          <div role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <progress max={1} value={phase.progress} aria-label="Upload progress" />
            <p className="small-text">Uploading… {Math.round(phase.progress * 100)}%</p>
          </div>
        )}
        {phase.name === "working" && (
          <div className="loading" role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>
              {phase.analysing
                ? "Looking at the photo. A local model on modest hardware can take a minute or more."
                : "Preparing guidance…"}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
        {offerGuidance && (
          <p className="alert info" role="note">
            The photo could not be analysed right now. You can still get guidance based on your details; it will be
            clearly marked as not based on the image.
          </p>
        )}

        <div className="stacked-actions">
          {busy ? (
            <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => abortRef.current?.abort()}>Cancel</button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <button type="submit" disabled={!file || !vision.configured}>Analyse photo</button>
              <button type="button" className={offerGuidance ? "" : "secondary"} onClick={() => void submit(false)}>
                Get guidance without analysing the photo
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </form>
    </>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/HistoryPage.tsx

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { deleteHistory, getModules, listHistory } from "../api/endpoints";
import type { HistoryItem, ModuleKey } from "../api/types";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../components/ConfirmDialog";
import { errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { HistoryList } from "../components/HistoryList";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { EmptyState, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader, Pagination } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";

export function HistoryPage() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [module, setModule] = useState<ModuleKey | "">("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<HistoryItem | null>(null);
  const modules = useResource(useCallback(() => getModules(), []));
  const history = useResource(useCallback(() => listHistory(page, module || null), [page, module]));
  const data = history.data;

  async function confirmDelete() {
    if (!pending) return;
    try {
      await deleteHistory(pending.id);
      toast.success("History entry deleted.");
      // If that was the last item on the page, step back one page.
      if (data && data.items.length === 1 && page > 1) setPage(page - 1);
      else history.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setPending(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="History" description="Everything you have analysed, newest first." />

      <div className="toolbar">
        <label htmlFor="module-filter">Module</label>
        <select id="module-filter" value={module}
          onChange={(e) => { setModule(e.target.value as ModuleKey | ""); setPage(1); }}>
          <option value="">All modules</option>
          {modules.data?.map((m) => <option key={m.key} value={m.key}>{m.title}</option>)}
        </select>
        {data && <span className="muted" aria-live="polite">{data.total} {data.total === 1 ? "entry" : "entries"}</span>}
      </div>

      {history.error ? (
        <ErrorState error={history.error} onRetry={history.reload} />
      ) : !data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : data.items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          title={module ? "No entries for this module" : "No history yet"}
          description="Analyses will be listed here once analysis modules are released. Nothing is added automatically."
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <HistoryList items={data.items} modules={modules.data ?? []} onDelete={setPending} />
          <Pagination page={data.page} pages={data.pages} onChange={setPage} />
        </>
      )}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={pending !== null}
        title="Delete this entry?"
        message={`“${pending?.title ?? ""}” will be permanently removed from your history.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        onConfirm={confirmDelete}
        onCancel={() => setPending(null)}
      />
    </>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/HygieneDetailPage.tsx

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  analyzeHygieneInspection, approveHygieneInspection, deleteHygieneInspection,
  fetchHygieneReportHtml, getHygieneInspection, rejectHygieneInspection,
  submitHygieneInspection, updateHygieneInspection,
} from "../api/endpoints";
import { ApiError } from "../api/client";
import type { HygieneFinding, HygieneFindingInput } from "../api/types";
import { AuthImage } from "../components/AuthImage";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../components/ConfirmDialog";
import { FindingsEditor } from "../components/hygiene/FindingsEditor";
import { ChecklistEditor } from "../components/hygiene/ChecklistEditor";
import { errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { Badge, Card, EmptyState, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";
import { formatDate } from "../lib/format";
import { SEVERITY_TONE, SOURCE_LABEL, STATUS_TONE } from "../lib/hygiene";

export function HygieneDetailPage() {
  const { id = "" } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState<null | "delete" | "analyze" | "approve" | "submit">(null);
  const [rejectNotes, setRejectNotes] = useState("");
  const [showReject, setShowReject] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draftFindings, setDraftFindings] = useState<HygieneFindingInput[]>([]);
  const inspection = useResource(useCallback(() => getHygieneInspection(id), [id]));

  const editable = inspection.data
    ? inspection.data.status === "draft" || inspection.data.status === "rejected"
    : false;

  function startEdit() {
    if (!inspection.data) return;
    setDraftFindings(inspection.data.result.findings.map((f) => ({
      finding_id: f.finding_id, source: f.source === "user" ? "user" : "model",
      category: f.category, severity: f.severity, description: f.description,
      location: f.location, certainty: f.certainty,
      evidence_media_id: f.evidence_media_id, evidence_description: f.evidence_description,
      user_note: f.user_note,
    })));
    setEditing(true);
  }

  async function saveEdits() {
    if (!inspection.data) return;
    setBusy("save");
    
    try {
      await updateHygieneInspection(inspection.data.id, {
        expected_revision: inspection.data.revision,
        findings: draftFindings,
      });
      setEditing(false);
      toast.success("Findings saved.");
      inspection.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    } 
  }

  async function runAnalysis() {
    setBusy("analyze");
    try {
      await analyzeHygieneInspection(id);
      toast.success("Analysis complete.");
      inspection.reload();
    } catch (err) { toast.error(errorMessage(err)); }
    finally { setBusy(null); setConfirm(null); }
  }

  async function submit() {
    setBusy("submit");
    try {
      await submitHygieneInspection(id);
      toast.success("Submitted for review.");
      inspection.reload();
    } catch (err) { toast.error(errorMessage(err)); }
    finally { setBusy(null); setConfirm(null); }
  }

  async function approve() {
    setBusy("approve");
    try {
      await approveHygieneInspection(id, null);
      toast.success("Approved.");
      inspection.reload();
    } catch (err) { toast.error(errorMessage(err)); }
    finally { setBusy(null); setConfirm(null); }
  }

  async function reject() {
    if (!rejectNotes.trim()) return toast.error("Add notes explaining what needs to change.");
    setBusy("reject");
    try {
      await rejectHygieneInspection(id, rejectNotes.trim());
      toast.success("Rejected; you can edit and resubmit.");
      setShowReject(false); setRejectNotes("");
      inspection.reload();
    } catch (err) { toast.error(errorMessage(err)); }
    finally { setBusy(null); }
  }

  async function remove() {
    try {
      await deleteHygieneInspection(id);
      toast.success("Inspection deleted.");
      navigate("/hygiene/history");
    } catch (err) { toast.error(errorMessage(err)); }
    finally { setConfirm(null); }
  }

  async function printReport() {
    try {
      const html = await fetchHygieneReportHtml(id);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: "text/html" }));
      const w = window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
      if (!w) toast.error("Pop-up blocked. Allow pop-ups to open the report.");
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);
    } catch (err) { toast.error(errorMessage(err)); }
  }

  if (inspection.error instanceof ApiError && inspection.error.status === 404) {
    return <EmptyState title="Inspection not found" description="It may have been deleted."
      action={<Link to="/hygiene/history">Back to inspections</Link>} />;
  }
  if (inspection.error) return <ErrorState error={inspection.error} onRetry={inspection.reload} />;
  if (!inspection.data) return <Loading />;
  const d = inspection.data;
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={d.location_name}
        description={<>{d.location_type_label}{d.area ? ` · ${d.area}` : ""} · <time dateTime={d.created_at}>{formatDate(d.created_at)}</time></>}
        actions={
          <div className="row wrap">
            <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={printReport}>Print / Save PDF</button>
            {d.status !== "approved" && <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => setConfirm("delete")}>Delete</button>}
          </div>
        } />
      <p className="verdict-row"><Badge tone={STATUS_TONE[d.status]}>{d.status_label}</Badge>
        <span className="muted small-text">{d.photo_count} photo{d.photo_count === 1 ? "" : "s"} · {d.finding_count} finding{d.finding_count === 1 ? "" : "s"}{d.highest_severity ? ` · highest: ${d.highest_severity}` : ""}</span></p>

      {d.review_notes && (
        <p className="alert info" role="note"><strong>Review notes:</strong> {d.review_notes}</p>
      )}
      {d.notes && <Card title="Notes" headingId="n-h"><p>{d.notes}</p></Card>}

      <Card title="Photos" headingId="photos-h">
        <ul className="media-grid">
          {d.media_ids.map((m) => (
            <li key={m} className="media-card">
              <AuthImage mediaId={m} alt="Inspection photo" className="media-thumb" />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Checklist" headingId="check-h">
        <p className="source-tag">Self-reported by the inspector. Not verified from photos.</p>
        <ChecklistEditor value={d.result.checklist} disabled={true} onChange={() => {}} />
      </Card>

      <Card title="Findings" headingId="find-h">
        <p className="source-tag">Each finding names its source. AI observations describe visible conditions only.</p>
        {editable && !editing && (
          <div className="row wrap">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirm("analyze")} disabled={busy !== null || d.photo_count === 0}>
              {d.result.analyzed_at ? "Re-run analysis" : "Run AI analysis"}
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={startEdit} disabled={busy !== null}>Edit findings</button>
          </div>
        )}
        {editable && editing && (
          <FindingsEditor
            findings={draftFindings}
            photos={d.media_ids}
            onChange={setDraftFindings}
            onSave={saveEdits}
            onCancel={() => setEditing(false)}
            busy={busy === "save"}
          />
        )}
        {!editing && (
          d.result.findings.length === 0
            ? <EmptyState title="No findings recorded" description={editable ? "Run the analysis or add your own." : "Nothing was reported."} />
            : <FindingsReadOnly findings={d.result.findings} />
        )}
        {d.result.model_limitations.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <h3>What the model could not assess</h3>
            <ul className="plain-list">{d.result.model_limitations.map((l, i) => <li key={i}>{l}</li>)}</ul>
          </>
        )}
        {d.result.model_notes && <p className="small-text muted">Model note: {d.result.model_notes}</p>}
        {d.result.withheld_text_count > 0 && (
          <p className="small-text muted">
            {d.result.withheld_text_count} model comment{d.result.withheld_text_count === 1 ? " was" : "s were"} withheld because
            {d.result.withheld_text_count === 1 ? " it" : " they"} contained a compliance or safety verdict.
          </p>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card title="What photos cannot establish" headingId="disc-h">
        <ul className="plain-list">{d.result.disclosures.map((x, i) => <li key={i}>{x}</li>)}</ul>
        <ul className="plain-list">{d.result.not_assessable.map((x, i) => <li key={i}>{x}</li>)}</ul>
      </Card>

      {editable && (
        <div className="stacked-actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirm("submit")} disabled={busy !== null || d.photo_count === 0}>
            Submit for review
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {d.status === "in_review" && (
        <div className="stacked-actions">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirm("approve")} disabled={busy !== null}>Approve</button>
          <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setShowReject(true)} disabled={busy !== null}>Reject…</button>
        </div>
      )}
      {d.status === "approved" && (
        <p className="small-text muted">Approved {d.reviewed_at ? <time dateTime={d.reviewed_at}>{formatDate(d.reviewed_at)}</time> : ""}. This record is now read-only.</p>
      )}

      {showReject && (
        <div className="overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="rej-h">
          <div className="dialog">
            <h2 id="rej-h">Reject inspection?</h2>
            <p>Explain what needs to change. The inspector can edit and resubmit.</p>
            <label htmlFor="rej-notes">Reason</label>
            <textarea id="rej-notes" rows={3} maxLength={1000} value={rejectNotes} onChange={(e) => setRejectNotes(e.target.value)} />
            <div className="dialog-actions">
              <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setShowReject(false)}>Cancel</button>
              <button type="button" className="danger" onClick={reject} disabled={busy !== null}>{busy === "reject" ? "Rejecting…" : "Reject"}</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <ConfirmDialog open={confirm === "delete"} title="Delete inspection?"
        message="The report and its findings will be permanently deleted." confirmLabel="Delete"
        onConfirm={remove} onCancel={() => setConfirm(null)} />
      <ConfirmDialog open={confirm === "analyze"} title="Run AI analysis?"
        message="The model will examine each photo. This can take a minute or more on modest hardware, and no compliance or safety verdict is ever produced."
        confirmLabel="Run analysis" onConfirm={runAnalysis} onCancel={() => setConfirm(null)} />
      <ConfirmDialog open={confirm === "submit"} title="Submit for review?"
        message="Findings will be locked while the inspection is in review." confirmLabel="Submit"
        onConfirm={submit} onCancel={() => setConfirm(null)} />
      <ConfirmDialog open={confirm === "approve"} title="Approve this inspection?"
        message="Approving makes the record read-only. It is a self-review; it does not certify compliance with any law or standard."
        confirmLabel="Approve" onConfirm={approve} onCancel={() => setConfirm(null)} />

      <p><Link to="/hygiene/history">← All inspections</Link></p>
    </>
  );
}

function FindingsReadOnly({ findings }: { findings: HygieneFinding[] }) {
  return (
    <ul className="observations">
      {findings.map((f) => (
        <li key={f.finding_id}>
          <p><strong>{f.category_label}</strong> · <Badge tone={SEVERITY_TONE[f.severity]}>{f.severity_label}</Badge>
            {" · "}<span className="muted small-text">{f.certainty_label} · {SOURCE_LABEL[f.source]}</span></p>
          <p>{f.description}{f.location ? ` (${f.location})` : ""}</p>
          {f.evidence_description && <p className="small-text muted">Evidence: {f.evidence_description}</p>}
          {f.user_note && <p className="small-text muted">Your note: {f.user_note}</p>}
          <p className="small-text"><strong>Suggested action:</strong> {f.suggested_action}</p>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";

FILE: frontend/src/pages/HygienePage.tsx

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { createHygieneInspection, getHygieneCapabilities, uploadPhotoWithProgress } from "../api/endpoints";
import type { HygieneLocationType } from "../api/types";
import { FormError, errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { Card, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";
import { ALLOWED_PHOTO_TYPES } from "../components/PhotoPicker";
import { formatBytes } from "../lib/format";

type PhotoDraft = { id: string; file: File; previewUrl: string };

let localKey = 0;
const nextKey = () => `p-${++localKey}`;

export function HygienePage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const caps = useResource(useCallback(() => getHygieneCapabilities(), []));
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<PhotoDraft[]>([]);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState<HygieneLocationType>("restaurant_kitchen");
  const [area, setArea] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<{ name: "idle" } | { name: "uploading"; progress: number; index: number } | { name: "creating" }>({ name: "idle" });

  function addFiles(files: FileList | null) {
    if (!files) return;
    setError(null);
    const next: PhotoDraft[] = [];
    for (const f of Array.from(files)) {
      if (!ALLOWED_PHOTO_TYPES.includes(f.type)) { setError("Only JPEG, PNG and WebP photos are accepted."); continue; }
      next.push({ id: nextKey(), file: f, previewUrl: URL.createObjectURL(f) });
    }
    setPhotos((prev) => [...prev, ...next].slice(0, caps.data?.max_photos ?? 8));
  }

  function removePhoto(id: string) {
    setPhotos((prev) => {
      const target = prev.find((p) => p.id === id);
      if (target) URL.revokeObjectURL(target.previewUrl);
      return prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id);
    });
  }

  async function onSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (!name.trim()) return setError("Enter the kitchen or location name.");
    if (photos.length === 0) return setError("Add at least one photo.");
    const controller = new AbortController();
    try {
      const mediaIds: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < photos.length; i++) {
        setPhase({ name: "uploading", progress: 0, index: i });
        const media = await uploadPhotoWithProgress(photos[i].file, (progress) => setPhase({ name: "uploading", progress, index: i }), controller.signal);
        mediaIds.push(media.id);
      }
      setPhase({ name: "creating" });
      const inspection = await createHygieneInspection({
        location_name: name.trim(),
        location_type: type,
        area: area.trim() || null,
        media_ids: mediaIds,
        notes: notes.trim() || null,
      });
      photos.forEach((p) => URL.revokeObjectURL(p.previewUrl));
      navigate(`/hygiene/${inspection.id}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorMessage(err));
      setPhase({ name: "idle" });
    }
  }

  if (caps.error) return <ErrorState error={caps.error} onRetry={caps.reload} />;
  if (!caps.data) return <Loading />;
  const { vision, location_types, max_photos } = caps.data;
  const busy = phase.name !== "idle";

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Kitchen hygiene inspection"
        description="Photograph a kitchen area and record visible hygiene concerns. Reports describe only what photos show — never safety, compliance, or pathogen absence."
        actions={<Link className="button-link secondary" to="/hygiene/history">Past inspections</Link>}
      />
      {!vision.configured && (
        <p className="alert info" role="note">
          Photo analysis is not available on this server: {vision.message ?? "no vision model is configured."} You can still
          record your own observations.
        </p>
      )}
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
        <Card title="1. Where" headingId="where-h">
          <label htmlFor="loc-name">Kitchen or location name</label>
          <input id="loc-name" value={name} maxLength={120} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Main street kitchen" />
          <label htmlFor="loc-type">Type of kitchen</label>
          <select id="loc-type" value={type} onChange={(e) => setType(e.target.value as HygieneLocationType)}>
            {location_types.map((c) => <option key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</option>)}
          </select>
          <label htmlFor="loc-area">Area (optional)</label>
          <input id="loc-area" value={area} maxLength={120} onChange={(e) => setArea(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. prep station, dishwashing" />
        </Card>

        <Card title={`2. Photos (up to ${max_photos})`} headingId="photos-h">
          <p className="hint">Bright, even light is best. Photos are stored privately to your account.</p>
          <input
            type="file" multiple accept={ALLOWED_PHOTO_TYPES.join(",")}
            onChange={(e) => { addFiles(e.target.files); e.target.value = ""; }}
            aria-label="Add photos" disabled={busy || photos.length >= max_photos}
          />
          {photos.length > 0 && (
            <ul className="media-grid" style={{ marginTop: ".75rem" }}>
              {photos.map((p) => (
                <li key={p.id} className="media-card">
                  <img src={p.previewUrl} alt="" className="media-thumb" />
                  <div className="media-meta"><p className="media-name">{p.file.name}</p><p className="muted small-text">{formatBytes(p.file.size)}</p></div>
                  <div className="media-actions">
                    <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => removePhoto(p.id)} disabled={busy}>Remove</button>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Card>

        <Card title="3. Notes (optional)" headingId="notes-h">
          <textarea id="h-notes" rows={3} maxLength={2000} value={notes} onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)} />
        </Card>

        <FormError message={error} />
        {phase.name === "uploading" && (
          <div role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <progress max={1} value={phase.progress} aria-label="Upload progress" />
            <p className="small-text">Uploading photo {phase.index + 1} of {photos.length} — {Math.round(phase.progress * 100)}%</p>
          </div>
        )}
        {phase.name === "creating" && (
          <div className="loading" role="status"><span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />Saving…</div>
        )}
        <button type="submit" disabled={busy || photos.length === 0 || !name.trim()}>
          {busy ? "Creating…" : "Create draft inspection"}
        </button>
      </form>
    </>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../auth/AuthContext";
import { FormError, errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";

export function LoginPage() {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await login(email, password); // PublicOnlyRoute redirects once the session is set
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorMessage(err));
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="auth-card">
      <h1>Sign in</h1>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
        <label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
        <input id="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" required value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
        <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>
        <input id="password" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" required value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
        <FormError message={error} />
        <button type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Signing in…" : "Sign in"}</button>
      </form>
      <p>New here? <Link to="/register">Create an account</Link></p>
    </main>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { deleteMeal, getMeal } from "../api/endpoints";
import { ApiError } from "../api/client";
import { AuthImage } from "../components/AuthImage";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../components/ConfirmDialog";
import { draftFromSaved } from "../components/food/drafts";
import { MealBuilder } from "../components/food/MealBuilder";
import { NutritionResults } from "../components/food/NutritionResults";
import { errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { Card, EmptyState, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";
import { categoryLabel } from "../lib/food";
import { formatDate } from "../lib/format";
import type { MealDetail } from "../api/types";

export function MealDetailPage() {
  const { id = "" } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const meal = useResource(useCallback(() => getMeal(id), [id]));

  async function remove() {
    try {
      await deleteMeal(id);
      toast.success("Meal deleted.");
      navigate("/meals");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setConfirming(false);
    }
  }

  if (meal.error instanceof ApiError && meal.error.status === 404) {
    return <EmptyState title="Meal not found" description="It may have been deleted."
      action={<Link to="/meals">Back to the meal log</Link>} />;
  }
  if (meal.error) return <ErrorState error={meal.error} onRetry={meal.reload} />;
  if (!meal.data) return <Loading />;
  const m = meal.data;
  const obs = m.result.model_observations;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title={m.items_label}
        description={<>{categoryLabel(m.category)} · <time dateTime={m.eaten_at}>{formatDate(m.eaten_at)}</time></>}
        actions={<>
          <Link className="button-link secondary" to={`/meals/${m.id}/edit`}>Edit</Link>
          <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}>Delete</button>
        </>} />
      {m.notes && <Card title="Notes" headingId="notes-h"><p>{m.notes}</p></Card>}
      {m.media_id && (
        <Card title="Photo" headingId="photo-h"><AuthImage mediaId={m.media_id} alt="Photo of this meal" className="detail-photo" /></Card>
      )}
      <Card title="Nutrition" headingId="nutrition-h"><NutritionResults calc={m.result} /></Card>
      {obs && (
        <Card title="What the photo model suggested" headingId="obs-h">
          <p className="small-text muted">
            Model-generated by “{obs.provider.model}” on <time dateTime={obs.generated_at}>{formatDate(obs.generated_at)}</time>.
            Kept for the record; it is not nutrition data. {obs.uncertainty_note}
          </p>
          {obs.items.length === 0 ? <p>The model did not name any foods.</p> : (
            <ul className="plain-list">
              {obs.items.map((o) => (
                <li key={o.observed_id}>{o.name}{o.ambiguous ? " (model unsure)" : ""}{o.description ? ` — ${o.description}` : ""}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}
      <p><Link to="/meals">← All meals</Link></p>
      <ConfirmDialog open={confirming} title="Delete this meal?"
        message="This meal and its saved analysis will be permanently deleted."
        confirmLabel="Delete" onConfirm={remove} onCancel={() => setConfirming(false)} />
    </>
  );
}

function MealEditor({ meal }: { meal: MealDetail }) {
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Edit meal" description="Change foods, portions or details. Totals are recalculated from the data sources." />
      <MealBuilder meal={meal} initialItems={meal.result.items.map(draftFromSaved)} />
      <p><Link to={`/meals/${meal.id}`}>← Cancel and go back</Link></p>
    </>
  );
}

export function MealEditPage() {
  const { id = "" } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const meal = useResource(useCallback(() => getMeal(id), [id]));
  if (meal.error) return <ErrorState error={meal.error} onRetry={meal.reload} />;
  if (!meal.data) return <Loading />;
  return <MealEditor meal={meal.data} />;
}

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { deleteMeal, listMeals } from "../api/endpoints";
import type { MealCategory, MealSummary } from "../api/types";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../components/ConfirmDialog";
import { errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { Badge, Card, EmptyState, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader, Pagination } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";
import { CATEGORIES, categoryLabel, formatAmount } from "../lib/food";
import { formatDate } from "../lib/format";

export function caloriesText(c: MealSummary["calories"]): string {
  if (c.low === null || c.high === null) return "Calories not available";
  return `${formatAmount(c.low, c.high, "kcal")}${c.complete ? "" : " (partial)"}`;
}

export function MealsPage() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<MealCategory | "">("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<MealSummary | null>(null);
  const meals = useResource(useCallback(() => listMeals(page, category || null), [page, category]));

  async function confirmDelete() {
    if (!pending) return;
    try {
      await deleteMeal(pending.id);
      toast.success("Meal deleted.");
      if (meals.data && meals.data.items.length === 1 && page > 1) setPage(page - 1);
      else meals.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setPending(null);
    }
  }

  const data = meals.data;
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Meal log" description="Meals you have analysed and saved."
        actions={<Link className="button-link" to="/food">Analyse a meal</Link>} />
      <div className="toolbar">
        <label htmlFor="meal-filter">Meal</label>
        <select id="meal-filter" value={category} onChange={(e) => { setCategory(e.target.value as MealCategory | ""); setPage(1); }}>
          <option value="">All meals</option>
          {CATEGORIES.map((c) => <option key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</option>)}
        </select>
      </div>
      {meals.error ? (
        <ErrorState error={meals.error} onRetry={meals.reload} />
      ) : !data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : data.items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title={category ? "No meals in this category" : "No meals saved yet"}
          description="Analyse a meal and save it, and it will appear here."
          action={<Link to="/food">Analyse a meal</Link>} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <ul className="history-list">
            {data.items.map((m) => (
              <li key={m.id}>
                <div className="history-main">
                  <p className="history-title"><Link to={`/meals/${m.id}`}>{m.items_label}</Link></p>
                  <p className="muted small-text">
                    {categoryLabel(m.category)} · <time dateTime={m.eaten_at}>{formatDate(m.eaten_at)}</time> · {m.item_count} item{m.item_count === 1 ? "" : "s"}
                  </p>
                  <p className="history-summary">{caloriesText(m.calories)}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="history-side">
                  <Badge>{categoryLabel(m.category)}</Badge>
                  <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => setPending(m)}
                    aria-label={`Delete ${m.items_label}`}>Delete</button>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <Pagination page={data.page} pages={data.pages} onChange={setPage} />
        </>
      )}
      <Card className="plain"><p className="small-text muted">Calorie figures are estimates from the portions and data sources you chose. “Partial” means some foods had no data.</p></Card>
      <ConfirmDialog open={pending !== null} title="Delete this meal?"
        message={`“${pending?.items_label ?? ""}” and its saved analysis will be permanently deleted.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete" onConfirm={confirmDelete} onCancel={() => setPending(null)} />
    </>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/MediaPage.tsx

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ChangeEvent, FormEvent } from "react";
import { deleteMedia, getDashboardSummary, getMediaBlob, listMedia, uploadMedia } from "../api/endpoints";
import type { MediaItem } from "../api/types";
import { AuthImage } from "../components/AuthImage";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "../components/ConfirmDialog";
import { FormError, errorMessage } from "../components/FormError";
import { useToast } from "../components/Toast";
import { Card, EmptyState, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader, Pagination } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";
import { formatBytes, formatDate } from "../lib/format";

const ALLOWED_TYPES = ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"];

export function MediaPage() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<MediaItem | null>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const summary = useResource(useCallback(() => getDashboardSummary(), []));
  const media = useResource(useCallback(() => listMedia(page), [page]));
  const maxBytes = summary.data?.media.max_upload_bytes;

  function onPick(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const picked = e.target.files?.[0] ?? null;
    setFormError(null);
    setFile(null);
    if (!picked) return;
    // Quick feedback only. The server re-validates everything and is the authority.
    if (!ALLOWED_TYPES.includes(picked.type)) {
      setFormError("Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.");
      return;
    }
    if (maxBytes && picked.size > maxBytes) {
      setFormError(`That file is ${formatBytes(picked.size)}. The limit is ${formatBytes(maxBytes)}.`);
      return;
    }
    setFile(picked);
  }

  async function onSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!file) return;
    setUploading(true);
    setFormError(null);
    try {
      await uploadMedia(file);
      toast.success("Photo uploaded.");
      setFile(null);
      if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
      if (page === 1) media.reload();
      else setPage(1);
      summary.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  }

  async function confirmDelete() {
    if (!pending) return;
    try {
      await deleteMedia(pending.id);
      toast.success("Photo deleted.");
      if (media.data && media.data.items.length === 1 && page > 1) setPage(page - 1);
      else media.reload();
      summary.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    } finally {
      setPending(null);
    }
  }

  async function download(item: MediaItem) {
    try {
      const blob = await getMediaBlob(item.id, true);
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = item.display_name;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(err));
    }
  }

  const s = summary.data;
  const data = media.data;
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Media library" description="Photos you upload are private to your account." />

      <Card title="Upload a photo" headingId="upload-heading">
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
          <label htmlFor="file">Image file</label>
          <input id="file" ref={inputRef} type="file" accept={ALLOWED_TYPES.join(",")} onChange={onPick}
            aria-describedby="file-help" />
          <p id="file-help" className="hint">
            JPEG, PNG or WebP{maxBytes ? `, up to ${formatBytes(maxBytes)}` : ""}. Images are re-encoded
            and location/camera metadata is removed.
          </p>
          <FormError message={formError} />
          <button type="submit" disabled={!file || uploading}>{uploading ? "Uploading…" : "Upload"}</button>
        </form>
        {s && (
          <div className="usage">
            <progress max={s.media.quota_bytes} value={s.media.total_bytes}
              aria-label="Storage used" />
            <p className="muted small-text">
              {formatBytes(s.media.total_bytes)} of {formatBytes(s.media.quota_bytes)} used
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <h2 className="section-title">Your photos</h2>
      {media.error ? (
        <ErrorState error={media.error} onRetry={media.reload} />
      ) : !data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : data.items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No photos yet" description="Upload your first photo above." />
      ) : (
        <>
          <ul className="media-grid">
            {data.items.map((item) => (
              <li key={item.id} className="media-card">
                <AuthImage mediaId={item.id} alt={item.display_name} className="media-thumb" />
                <div className="media-meta">
                  <p className="media-name" title={item.display_name}>{item.display_name}</p>
                  <p className="muted small-text">
                    {item.width}×{item.height} · {formatBytes(item.size_bytes)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="muted small-text">{formatDate(item.created_at)}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="media-actions">
                  <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => download(item)}
                    aria-label={`Download ${item.display_name}`}>Download</button>
                  <button type="button" className="secondary small" onClick={() => setPending(item)}
                    aria-label={`Delete ${item.display_name}`}>Delete</button>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <Pagination page={data.page} pages={data.pages} onChange={setPage} />
        </>
      )}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={pending !== null}
        title="Delete this photo?"
        message={`“${pending?.display_name ?? ""}” will be permanently deleted from your library.`}
        confirmLabel="Delete"
        onConfirm={confirmDelete}
        onCancel={() => setPending(null)}
      />
    </>
  );
}

import { useCallback } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { getModules, listHistory } from "../api/endpoints";
import type { ModuleInfo, ModuleKey } from "../api/types";
import { HistoryList } from "../components/HistoryList";
import { ModuleCard } from "../components/ModuleCard";
import { Badge, Card, EmptyState, ErrorState, Loading, PageHeader } from "../components/ui";
import { useResource } from "../hooks/useResource";

export function ModulesPage() {
  const modules = useResource(useCallback(() => getModules(), []));
  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Modules" description="The five areas FoodVerse AI is built around." />
      {modules.error ? (
        <ErrorState error={modules.error} onRetry={modules.reload} />
      ) : !modules.data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : (
        <div className="module-grid">
          {modules.data.map((m) => <ModuleCard key={m.key} module={m} />)}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/** Only mounted once the module is known, so history is never fetched unfiltered. */
function ModuleHistory({ moduleKey, modules }: { moduleKey: ModuleKey; modules: ModuleInfo[] }) {
  const history = useResource(useCallback(() => listHistory(1, moduleKey, 5), [moduleKey]));
  return (
    <Card title="Your history for this module" headingId="module-history">
      {history.error ? (
        <ErrorState error={history.error} onRetry={history.reload} />
      ) : !history.data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : history.data.items.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No entries yet" />
      ) : (
        <HistoryList items={history.data.items} modules={modules} />
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

export function ModuleDetailPage() {
  const { key } = useParams<{ key: string }>();
  const modules = useResource(useCallback(() => getModules(), []));
  const module = modules.data?.find((m) => m.key === key);

  if (modules.error) return <ErrorState error={modules.error} onRetry={modules.reload} />;
  if (!modules.data) return <Loading />;
  if (!module) {
    return (
      <EmptyState title="Module not found" description="That module does not exist."
        action={<Link to="/modules">Back to modules</Link>} />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={module.title}
        description={module.description}
        actions={module.available ? <Badge tone="ok">Available</Badge> : <Badge>Not available yet</Badge>}
      />
      {!module.available && (
        <div className="alert info" role="note">
          This module is not part of the current release, so there is nothing to run here yet.
          Nothing is simulated: results will only appear once the real feature ships.
        </div>
      )}
      <ModuleHistory moduleKey={module.key} modules={modules.data} />
      <p><Link to="/modules">← All modules</Link></p>
    </>
  );
}

FILE: frontend/src/pages/PreferencesPage.tsx
